reviews.text: Very pleasant dining experience. It's just off the lobby of the Caesars Republic hotel. The bar area was full and lively the night I was there, but the main dining area is around a corner and a little removed from the lounge hubbub. The lobster arancini were tasty (especially the sauce) but one of them had no lobster while another had a huge chunk, so I guess it balanced out in totality. The scallops needed a slightly harder sear, but the pea risotto underneath was A+. The service was helpful and pleasant, and the meal was very well-paced. I would definitely go back. It's easy and free to park in the deck just across the street if you don't want to valet.
reviews.author: Adam B.

reviews.text: Arrived here shortly after 5pm on a Monday, took a seat at the bar.  Took them 10 minutes to bring me their menus.  Ordered food plus a pizza to go. Entree came quickly and was absolutely delicious (lobster totellini) but the pizza took forever!  I had to ask where it was (that took another 10 min after i completely finished my entree) and then had to wait another 10 minutes again for the pizza to come, which is what i was trying to avoid in the first place by placing my order all up front!  It appeared to me their bartender (1) was overwhelmed from filling both orders from the bar patrons plus the restaurant customers!  For the added 3.8% (venue tax) this joint charges i find it not worth the pain of trying to wave down staff to get a drink or find out where my food is!
reviews.author: Drew G.

reviews.text: Very over priced for the quality of food. Service was good and facility very nice. Also there was a Venue service charge to boot.  Only have seen such a frivilous charge in cabo!
reviews.author: Kevin S.

reviews.text: Maybe the best service you will experience in the valley and not in a stuffy way. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. The food however does not live up to those Service standards. The meal and drink program are pretty mid compared to other Italian restaurants whether they are fine dining or mom and pop.
reviews.author: Greg F.

reviews.text: We adore Giada in Las Vegas and had to visit Luna. Service was impeccable and the food was as amazing as we had anticipated! of course we had the lemon spaghetti. Our server was wonderful and we appreciated Angelo stopping by to check on our needs. Go here and indulge yourself. Every moment is divine.
reviews.author: Bethany G.

reviews.text: Pesto pizza was delicious. Sat by the kitchen and the food coming out looked so good that I'm eager to come back.
reviews.author: Marco A.

reviews.text: Dinner at Luna was very good.  Melanie was our waitress and she was terrific. She was so nice, cheerful, knowledgeable, and professional.  She is an excellent representative for Luna.
reviews.author: Meredith H.

reviews.text: Food, service, atmosphere. Love the light bright lemon forward dishes. Water service was wonderful and wines were affordable.
reviews.author: Melissa M.

reviews.text:
I came here for dinner last night with a large group and we were seated in the private dining room. Sara provided amazing service throughout the evening and really helped make the experience enjoyable.

The food was delicious overall. I especially enjoyed the branzino. On its own, I found it a little too lemony, but once I added the topping, the flavors came together perfectly. The broccolini was also excellent--crisp, flavorful, and cooked just right. I wasn't a fan of the asparagus with balsamic, and the focaccia was a bit too greasy for my taste.

The cocktails were the weakest part of the meal for me, though I wasn't entirely surprised since they use some spirits I'm not particularly fond of, such as Empress gin. The Italian Paloma I received looked very different from the one another guest ordered. Hers was much pinker, while mine was very green. She enjoyed hers, but I really didn't like mine. The La Strada was just okay.

Overall, the excellent service and standout food made for a great evening.
reviews.author: Mandy T.

reviews.text:
Had a fantastic dinner last night at Luna!  our server was Brandi!  She was so personable, knowledgeable about the food and especially
the wine !  I'll definitely
go back but only if we get the fantastic service provided by Brandi!
reviews.author: Melody C.

reviews.text:
Service was initially slow. We waited 10 minutes before we saw someone to take a drink order. We waited a while for our wine. After that, service was better. It was not busy- only 5-6 tables had guests. 
We ordered an appetizer.- tuna crudo. It was good but not great. We took the servers suggestion and ordered the lemon pasta. It was heavy and needed brightness and freshness. We also had the mezzi rigatoni. By far the dish we disliked the most. It left an after taste which was very unpleasant. To me it had a dirt taste. 
Dessert- the beignet like desert stuffed with hazelnut was good and the accompanying caramel sauce was divine.
reviews.author: Karen F.

reviews.text: I used to go to this restaurant all the time. In my opinion the food preparation has gone downhill significantly. Unsure if there was a change in chefs, but my experience was below satisfactory.
reviews.author: Jena R.

reviews.text: The place is very nice and the food was decent, but I wouldn't say it's worth the price they charge. There are a dozen other Italian restaurants in the area that can out do this place. The service is what gave this place the 2 stars. It wasn't busy, but we rarely saw our server. Was about 15 min before she came back to get our drink order and 10 min just to pick up the credit card. They knocked over our wine bottle onto the floor and didn't say a single thing. They did clean it up though. The fact that you're forced to pay a 20% tip because it was 4 adults and 4 kids was upsetting. The service was not worth more than 10%. Would not go back and would not recommend this place.
reviews.author: brandi c.

reviews.text:
This is my 2nd visit to Luna.  After a disappointing meal 2 years ago shortly after they opened, we decided to give Luna another try. 

First, I want to emphasize how excellent our service was throughout our meal.  Our server Dara was very attentive as well as our bus boy, Nick. Both were super friendly and never left us waiting for service even after the restaurant became busy throughout the evening. 

We started with dirty martinis which were very good.  The issue I have is the martini was $17.  I was charged $2 for olives and another $4 for making it dirty.  Seriously?  Then the glasses of house cab wine were $30 each.  More than the cost of the bottle in the store. The drink prices are out of line. 

We ordered several appetizers including the shrimp, ravioli and bacon wrapped dates.  All were pretty good.  The shrimp was just basic. 

For dinner, we ordered the following: Signature lemon spaghetti. $39
My friends were excited to try the famous lemon spaghetti.  They said they liked it but both took one bite and left the rest in the plate. 

The Calabrese pizza $28. The crust was good but the pizza was so salty, ate one slice and couldn't finish it. 

Scallop risotto.  $49. This was tasty. But it was such a small portion.  I didn't feel it was worth the price. 

K4 Ranch petite filet. 6OZ. $66. Wow, such a disappointment.  My friend said it tasted like old meat and couldn't stomach it. 

The last insult to a terrible meal, a 3.5% venue admin fee plus a 20% automatic tip for a table of five.  I don't mind paying the gratuity as our service was excellent.  We also left additional gratuity. But a venue fee? Terrible. 

I so want to love Luna as I'm a huge fan of Giada, but the food is so disappointing.
reviews.author: Holly M.

reviews.text: Great service, food so-so. Group of 8 people 5 thought the food was average at best. Three really liked their food. Overly expensive and you pay an extra resort fee added to each check.  Lemon spaghetti was bland without much lemon taste. $600 + bill wasn't worth it. One and done here
reviews.author: Darryl C.

reviews.text:
Torn on leaving 3 stars, sadly that was generous if only thinking about the food. Had the ceasar salad. Just "okay", I enjoyed the citrus but the crispy capers weren't as good as I'd hoped, frying them took away their umami flavor ion my opinion.
The tripolini pasta dish was horribly salty, I mean horribly. Two of us got it and felt so. I'd suggest someone needs to taste this before serving it because there's absolutely no way it's supposed to taste that way. Only ate half and swelled up after eating it badly, definitely not eating the rest. 
Ambiance is absolutely stunning, felt very "strip, Las Vegas". 
Staff was very good, friendly and attentive.
reviews.author: Amelia Z.

reviews.text:
What happened?
Luna went from #1 to I'm not sure if I'll be back. 
If you never been to Luna, youll love it! The food is a 10 of 10.
I normally drive at least monthly for more then an hour for the this dining experience.  I also normally rate Luna 10+ for the overall experience. We  normally are greeted at the door with Luna knowing our name, the table set with our standard app and drinks from the bar awaiting. Sitting at the chef's table manager normally comes by several times checking on our table, sometimes sitting with us and joining in on our conversation.  The staff knew us and by going here monthly we knew them also. 
The dinner was an experience.  However,  on this date, it was like we were strangers in our own home. Food was a 10 but a 2 on dining experience.  And returning for us is questionable for I can can get great food a lot closer to my home. It appears none of the experience was present.  Everything changed. No one would say why? After traveling over an hour, my overall experience was subpar. 
But if you just want great food, Luna is a good choice.
reviews.author: Joe B.

reviews.text: Delicious food and cocktails! Phenomenal service. We got all of our food and drinks in short time. 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.author: Nick R.

reviews.text: HAPPY HOUR - probably the best happy hour we've experienced.  The menu is not a tone down version, but quality selections.  The food was great and the service was excellent.  Angelo (service manager) did us a favor for a special occasion.  Overall, I would go back again without hesitation.  Now that I tasted the quality of the good at happy hour, I would return in the future for the full menu.  You cannot go wrong.
reviews.author: Michael B.

reviews.text: OMG that lemon pasta....! We were in PHX for 4 days and went to Luna twice.  Yes it was that good! Nice specialty drink menu too!
reviews.author: Patty T.

reviews.text: Love this place ! Went last year for my birthday dinner then with the girls and it's a vibe very classy.... Wish the service was faster but they are all very kind. Drinks take long but are yummy
reviews.author: Jessica P.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful meal from start to finish! Food was fresh and delicious, and the service was great! Melanie took great care of us and Hosea was always moving!! Thank you for a wonderful evening!
reviews.author: Patty O.

reviews.text:
By far the WORST experience I've had at a fine dining restaurant
We visited Luna by Giada at Caesars Republic in Scottsdale last night for my aunt's birthday with a party of eight. We had a reservation for 7:00 PM and were seated around 7:20 PM, which was fine since we were still waiting for the rest of our group.
From the moment we sat down, our server told us she would get our drinks and courses in, and then we essentially never saw her again. Each course took nearly an hour to arrive at our table. It was a constant struggle to find someone just to get drink refills, condiments for our pizza and other food, or anything else we needed. We repeatedly had to track down other staff because our server never came back to check on us -- not once to see if the food was okay or if we needed anything.
The only person who checked on our table was the assistant manager or manager. He was kind enough to bring us a few free desserts and did mention that the restaurant/kitchen was behind, so at least that much was communicated. However, for our assigned server to completely disappear and not even come back to the table to make sure we were taken care of in the meantime felt COWARDLY and UNFAIR.
It was uncomfortable to even bring anything up to her because she had avoided our table so much -- I didn't want to say anything that might make things worse for her if she was already having a bad night. She showed no remorse and didn't seem to care at all about how the experience was going for us. But at the end of the day, it's just unfair to our party of eight. The painfully slow pacing and complete lack of attention made the entire evening uncomfortable and stressful instead of celebratory. None of us could enjoy ourselves, and it really ruined what should have been a happy night for my aunt's birthday.
Despite all of this, the bill still included the automatic 20% gratuity for our large party, and she was tipped out anyway. That felt very unfair after being essentially abandoned.
As someone who has worked in the service industry -- previously at the Global Ambassador and currently in elevated dining -- this was by far the worst experience I've had at a fine dining restaurant. This level of neglect is unacceptable, especially for a first-time visit to a restaurant associated with Giada De Laurentiis. The whole meal took four hours, and I didn't get home until midnight. I had to work the next morning and was extremely grateful that a coworker switched shifts with me, or I wouldn't have made it in.
I really wanted this to be a memorable, happy night, but the terrible service completely overshadowed everything. Unless Luna by Giada improves their staff training and ensures servers actually attend to their tables (especially larger parties), I will not be returning. Anyone considering dining here should know ahead of time how neglectful the service can be.
reviews.author: Kalea D.

reviews.text:
Unremarkable in every way

Service aloof. Food tasteless. Vibe confused.

Ahi appetizer. Flaccid and tasteless. Serious, Safeway sushi fish has more sparkle. Topped with olive tapenade but why? Chips were okay but why?

Lobster arancini. Tasteless and dense. Inspecting a cross section, I could see some lobster bits drowning in filler.

When the server finally checked in and I told him that the arancini's marinara dip was the best thing of everything, he seemed pleased. Telling.

This was second visit and likely our last. Which really sucks because we live across the street.
reviews.author: Doug B.

reviews.text: Took well over 10 minutes to be greeted by a server. Had a party of eight guests. Drink service was very slow. When apps were dropped did not get offered pepper for salad. Interesting a restaurant has a "restaurant fee." Food was good but based on length of dinner and service quality would not be back again.
reviews.author: Taylor N.

reviews.text:
Their brunch was one of the best I had for a while . I was pleasantly surprised . 
Their service was excellent . They were very attentive   .they had beautiful center pieces and great ambiance . I would certainly would go back and enjoy many more occasions over there .
reviews.author: Leila S.

reviews.text:
Great ambience, food and service!
This is a beautiful restaurant and the service is was wonderful. The lemon pasta was amazing!
reviews.author: Melissa G.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful experience at Luna. Our server was super friendly and gave us a great menu breakdown and recommendation. Parking is limited and you either need to valet or park in the mall parking lot, less you can grab a spot in the small parking lot. Walk through the hotel lobby and the restaurant is to the left. Very nice and simple ambiance and decor. They had indoor and patio seating. The food overall was amazing. The lemon pasta was yummy and we had the focaccia bread. We made it through dessert and the chocolate soufflé was delicious.
reviews.author: Valerie A.

reviews.text: Why are the women dressed like hooters upscale ? It must be so uncomfortable to wear these tight low cut white shirts and jeans and white shoes that get dirty easy! The service was great but Giada knows style and this is not it
reviews.author: Sue F.

reviews.text:
Wanted to love it, but had one of the worst dinner experiences in my life. 

Group of 7 celebrating a birthday. Ordered a round of drinks. I ordered the $18 white negroni, asked to substitute mezcal. my friend ordered a manhattan, asked to substitute for eagle rare. 

my drink came out to $31 before tax and tip. the server never asked if i had a preference on mezcal. their cheapest one on menu was $20. he decided i should have the $27 one (plus the $4 up charge for a negroni) 

my friends drink come out to FORTY FOUR DOLLARS. for EAGLE RARE. $44 for an eagle rare manhattan. no mention from our server. Eagle rare was not listed on the spirit list, but it is a $50-60 bottle. We drink this regularly for ~15ish at every other bar. 

i understand if you substitute spirits there is typically an up charge. However, this felt pretty extreme and honestly shady. No mention from our server simply says they wanted the tab to run up for the most gratuity. 

entrees took, no exaggeration, 50 minutes to hit the table. the bottle of wine we ordered took over 30 minutes to hit our table. Our reservation was for 7, and we didn't leave til 10 (and that's not because we were having a fun time) 

Food tasted fine once it hit. certainly not bad, but when factoring our experience in, we couldn't enjoy it. 

I have literally never reviewed a restaurant before. i've had plenty of experiences where things go wrong because they are slammed, overwhelmed, understaffed etc. this wasn't one of those. Just about an $800 tab of nothing but dissatisfaction. there's too many great places to spend money at this price point. Our friend was incredibly upset we spent her birthday, and our money, here. 

big thumbs down.
reviews.author: Kobe D.

reviews.text: Absolutely the best experience! The food was incredible. The service was the best-Informative, helpful, extremely knowledgeable and professional. The ambiance was beautiful. The full dining experience was 10/10!
reviews.author: Erin F.

reviews.text: This was our second visit to Luna and each time the wonderful, Kaitlyn, was our server! Love her energy and positivity! Also, the food was amazing, especially the gluten free pasta. The salted caramel gelato was out of this world! Can't wait to return!
reviews.author: Mary E.

reviews.text:
LOVE LOVE LOVED LUNA! 

Went for a fun, "MOMS NIGHT OUT!" Luna did not disappoint. Luna is on the main level of Caesars Republic Hotel. Upscale.

The servers were incredibly sweet and professional. We had at least 3-4 different people check in, take care of drink/waters. Run food. It was wonderful.

We ordered Fritto Misto for an appetizer (calamari, shrimp) and a citrus Cesar salad and the arugula salad. SO crispy, yummy and FLAVOR (lemon). 

I ordered the filet with broccoli. Medium. It was juicy and delicious! 

Definitely come!
reviews.author: Marissa D.

reviews.text: It was a Sunday evening, and my friend and I just had dinner in the area. We then realized that Luna was nearby! We had dined at Giada's restaurant in Vegas before and loved the dessert. So we decided to stop at Luna for dessert. It was not too busy around 7pm; there were plenty of tables available. We felt bad when the server started talking to us about the specials, but she quickly pivoted once we told her we were just there for the Tiramisu. She gave us a heads up that it won't be like a traditional Tiramisu. It was served in a double old-fashioned glass, and was rich and decadent from the chocolate cream. It was definitely different with the chocolate instead of espresso flavor, but still delicious and kept me going back for another spoonful. There were some crunchy bits inside - not sure what it was, but it was a nice contrast from the creaminess. This Tiramisu was vastly different from the one in Vegas too. So I'm definitely curious about the rest of the menu and want to come back for a meal.
reviews.author: Christine T.

reviews.text:
Don't charge to print the menu for the table if customer does not want to have to open an app to get to your menu. I never had that before.
No automatic "service fee" 
No automatic tip amount plus additional line for more tip (don't always catch the double tip).
Don't charge customer to use a credit card
No customer fees to support medical insurance and additional salary for your employees 
Recommend not "nickel and diming" customers at an expensive restaurant 
Food was good, but above is off putting and puts the servers and guests in an uncomfortable position.
reviews.author: Mark ..

reviews.text:
We came here for our anniversary dinner and it was phenomenal! From the mocktails to the appetizers, entrees, and desserts -- everything was absolutely amazing. The service was just as great. Our servers, the service team, and the manager were all incredibly attentive and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better.

We ended up ordering way too much food because everything looked so good, but it was totally worth it. As vegetarians, we were really happy to see so many veg options on the menu, and they were very accommodating as well.

The lemon spaghetti was honestly one of the best pasta dishes I've ever had -- so fresh and unique, nothing like I've had before. We also tried the cacio e pepe ravioli, which was fantastic, and the pasta alla vodka, which was good (a bit more classic), but still delicious.

The appetizers, desserts, and drinks were all outstanding. I would come back for the lemon spaghetti, ravioli, apps, and desserts 100 times over.

Such a great spot for a special occasion -- we'll definitely be back!
reviews.author: Prexa J.

reviews.text: Loved Melanie!:) servers are knowledgeable and kind. The food is consistent and intentional. Ambiance is beautiful.
reviews.author: Megan P.

reviews.text: Wonderful first experience at Luna by Giada! Loved our server, Melanie, for making us feel so welcome! Started off strong with the focaccia--each of us had a favorite dipping sauce (mine: olive oil). Great Caesar salad, but the caprese was extra special with the balsamic "pearls." We enjoyed lemon spaghetti, bucatini, scallops, pizza, and the highlight was the hot chocolate soufflé. Can't wait to return!
reviews.author: Stacey G.

reviews.text: Loved Luna!  Wonderful food and great service. Kaitlyn was our server and she was excellent and very attentive.
reviews.author: Mia D.

reviews.text: The staff was very kind and helpful. They were attentive to our needs. It was very loud and bright in the restaurant though which was not enjoyable. The food was fine but very over priced for food that wasn't as amazing as advertised.
reviews.author: Tania C.

reviews.text: Wonderful spot for a special occasion. Service was outstanding. I will be talking about the food for sometime. Everything was delicious.
reviews.author: Fred M.

reviews.text:
I understand now the "signature dish" which has the greatest profit margin: 
Lemon spaghetti with two shrimp for $39. Great marketing! I bought it. It's tasty but not for the price. 
Drinks: my husband ordered a vodka on the rocks with olives. 
$20 vodka, $4 for ice, $2 for two olives.
Don't overlook the administration fee on the bill: 3.7% must be for using a credit card. 
The prices aside: we were very rushed . Table turning at its best. Hadn't even got the drinks before we were asked what we wanted to order. We ordered an appetizer. Impatient waitress wanted our WHOLE order.  We said drinks first, then appetizer. Pushy waitress wanted us out of there. Demanded our entree order "this is the way we do it here"!  
Will never be back.
reviews.author: nancy k.

reviews.text: I rarely feel the need to come on Yelp and review restaurants but my experience tonight at Luna was just awful. My wife and I have been to Luna 4 times before and each time the  staff, service and food were excellent. However, right from our arrival this evening we realized this would not be the same as we experienced on other visits. The gentleman working at the front desk seemed completely overwhelmed by the Valentine's Day crowd. We had a 7:30 reservation and checked in at 7:20. He took my name and said it would be a few minutes. The ladies working with him in the front were much nicer and offered free champagne while we waited and told me again that it would only be a few minutes. At this point, I was okay with a short wait although it was obvious the restaurant was struggling to keep up with the holiday demand. After sitting in the lobby for 30 minutes, I walked back over to ask the lady who originally told me it would be just a few minutes, if she had an idea of how much longer it would be. Seeing this, the first gentleman, looking agitated, asked her what I was doing and she told him that I was waiting from earlier, he rudely asked my name as if I was bothering them, and when I told him, he said he had been texting me for 10 minutes for my table. I told him that I had no texts and I showed him my phone. I had been sitting about 10 feet from the desk the entire time and never once in that time was he at the desk, constantly running into the restaurant after guests or hostesses. I did not want to call him a liar but I do not believe he ever texted me before I returned to the desk. At this point, he ignored me and just handed the hostess a number and kind of waved me away to follow her. His whole energy and interaction was reason enough for a guest to feel unwanted and unvalued. The hostess then took us back, never apologizing for the wait or the attitude of the gentleman, which she clearly noticed and made a face about. We passed two tables for two inside the restaurant, to be taken to a table for 4 outside by the roadway. Once there and seeing this table, my wife and I decided we'd rather leave than be seated out here and the hostess did not offer us any other seating and just said "maybe another night would be less busy". Is there any reason for a reservation or does that mean nothing at this restaurant when they get busy? And is it okay for the person who is the first face of the restaurant for the customer to be as rude and obviously dishonest as that gentleman was tonight? As I said earlier, this wasn't our first visit to Luna but based on tonight's experience, it most likely will be our last. Ruining someone's Valentine's Day and showing no care for a customer (especially one who waited more than patiently and was never aggressive or rude and was polite to all the employees they encountered) or their experience in your establishment is a surefire to lose future business.
reviews.author: Dennis G.

reviews.text: Even with reservations at 9:00, we waited an hour before being called up to be sat. We checked in about 30 minutes in about the wait because we understood it was a busy day and the worker told us it would be a few minutes even though it was not. Then we waited another hour for the food to arrive at our table after being sat. When the food came it was cold and the steak was dry. After mentioning it to the server he tried telling us that "their high quality steaks are supposed to taste like that" and implied we are used to low quality which just is not true. Food was bad and service was worse.
reviews.author: Valerie S.

reviews.text: food is ok, service was bad, we came in today 2/14 at 6:30 to celebrate my birthday and valentine, my birthday is on valentine and we specified it in the reservation, however no greeting or mentioned by waitresses. after our focaccia appetizer our table was left with bread crumbs and no one seems to come and clean it up before placing entree down, feel like i was being ignored by the wait staff majority of the time and feel so un-celebrated, when i told the server its my bday she acted like i was joking and didn't even say happy birthday just walked off. pick luna by giada to celebrate our special occasion and left feeling ignored, i wouldn't come back base solely off of the service. ambiance is ok, we have a half in/outdoor table and i feel like at one point a small bug landed on my plate. will include a pic of a crumbs table below
reviews.author: Amie T.

reviews.text:
We went to an event at the restaurant and it was OK nothing  We decided to go to the bar for the restaurant  after dinner February 7, 2026 we asked the bartender what she would recommend she responded, "whatever you want," as she turned her back and walked away.Wow, she clearly didn't care.
We ordered martinis that we received, and they were lukewarm and not balanced appropriately. I turned to my husband as he had asked me a question in the Bartender tapped loudly with her nails on the bar top to get my attention asking me what kind of olives I wanted. Not sure if it was a bad night for her, but if you're in the service industry, you shouldn't be a jerk! We didn't finish our martinis when we left never to see them again. Scottsdale has too many good places to waste our time and good energy!
reviews.author: Rachel B.

reviews.text: Food was great and the service was very good too. Great place for us to spend Christmas dinner.
reviews.author: Robin L.

reviews.text: Just save your money and go to Italy, a plane ticket is cheaper than this place. Food tasted fine but $50 for pasta should just be illegal. Bread was the best thing and the only thing worth the $$$.
reviews.author: Emily R.

reviews.text: Great service, drinks and food! We sat at the bar and enjoyed cocktails (the white Negroni is a standout) and food (Cesar salad was so good I'm already craving it). Very nice design to the restaurant and really really great service! We will be back!
reviews.author: Brenna S.

reviews.text: This review comes after my second visit. The first time, it was phenomenal, service and food truly amazing albeit the restaurant is very loud and at times extremely challenging to hear dinner guests speak. On this visit, a special event in which Giada was supposed to be there, we had no sightings of her, which isn't a big deal, because that's not why we went. The service was once again wonderful, however the food failed to deliver. The calamari appetizer was very rubbery, cold and salty. The seasonal dish, butter squash ravioli was also served cold and tasteless, Trader Joe's has a premade version which is far superior. The fish of the night, a grouper, once again lacked flavor, but was unlike the others served hot. The Tiramisu, is served in a cup and not properly formed to truly enjoy a tasteful bite of the desert. Maybe I caught them on a bad night, maybe it's the new standard, I'd still give them another shot since my first experience went so well.
reviews.author: Michael G.

reviews.text: Super delicious food! First I got the crab aranchini and it was beautiful and tasty. I would have preferred it to be warmer though. The plate was hot but the insides were room temperature. The focaccia was really good too. I wish the butter wasn't salty. The herbs and oil went great with the bread. For my meal I got the classic lemon noodles. I absolutely loved the taste of these. I wish the top of the noodles were warmer though, the bottom ones were nice and hot. Also, the server never told me that the scallops were an up charge and the shrimp came with the meal. Honestly, I think I should've gotten all four pieces of shrimp and then the two scallops because that was what I paid for. For dessert I got the pumpkin souffle. I love soufflés and this one had the perfect texture. I wish that the ginger snap cookies looked more home made and were warmed. I didn't eat them. Over all I had a pretty great experience here, just some temperature issues. I would definitely come back for the lemon spaghetti though.
reviews.author: Phoenix Z.

reviews.text: Another delightful and delicious night at Luna. Our server Jay, went above and begin with our party of 8. He explained how all the dishes have Giadas 3 favorite ingredient, which are mine too; olive oil, parmesano reggiano and lemons. He articulated the menu clearly and sold us on the specials. It was my sisters birthday and my parents first time and they absolutely loved the food and the way Jay took care of us. We are looking forward to our next visit. Giada, Jay said you read all these, so give a shout out to him at your Scottsdale location!
reviews.author: Luis D.

reviews.text:
This experience was incredible. Our server Dara made the best recommendations and hooked us up with the best food and drinks! 
Even my friends baby had a great time and didn't make a sound 

Dara even walked us up to wolf to grab a night cap. 

Love it here! Will be back
reviews.author: Delaney H.

reviews.text: We loved our dinner and service! We ordered the lemon spaghetti and the scallop risotto. Also the focaccia bread appetizer was divine.  Only disappointment was I really hoped to taste more lemon in the lemon spaghetti- we both agreed we could hardly taste anything lemon. More like an Alfredo sauce. But still delicious! Highly recommend the Chocolate cloud dessert or shall I say experience. Do many flavors and beautifully displayed.
reviews.author: Sw G.

reviews.text:
The perfect spot for our New Year's Eve dinner in Scottsdale. We kicked things off with oysters and champagne, bright, briny, and exactly the right way to start the evening.

The mains were outstanding. The branzino was the star of the table, with a citrus pairing that was fresh, vibrant, and unforgettable. The salmon was equally well executed, and the shared sides of brussels sprouts and asparagus were the perfect complement. Bonus points for the comically oversized pepper grinder, a fun little touch that made the experience even better.

Exceptional service, beautifully prepared dishes, and a fantastic wine selection ranging from high-end labels to very approachable options. A flawless meal and a memorable way to ring in the new year. On my list to visit again soon.
reviews.author: Brian S.

reviews.text:
Located on bottom level of Caesars Republic Hilton Hotel by Scottsdale Fashion Square. Good ambiance. Very busy while we there but our service was outstanding. I had a meal that was not on the menu. It was a chef's special. It had a 6 ounce filet with two Scallops and a cheese ravioli, all on top of a serving of Yukon mashed potatoes. Steak was perfect as were the scallops. The ravioli was good and the mashed potatoes were a very small but good portion. Our server had me try an Italian Red wine blend from Sicily that I wish I would have gotten the name of. It paired perfectly with everything I ate. It was a little on the expensive side but I have never minded paying good money for good food. 
Wife and I shared an appetizer that was ok. It sounded really good. It was bacon wrapped dates with spicy sausage inside. For me, the sweet way over powered the rest of the ingredients. I love all three of those items but for me all I tasted was sweet. Our server was awesome, always on point and made outstanding recommendations. It was also my wife's birthday and they gave her a wonderful birthday cake that she said was very very good. 

Great experience for us and also loved that it was in the hotel we were staying in.
reviews.author: Brent M.

reviews.text: Always a fan favourite! Love their cocktails and they have some of the best dishes. The bacon wrapped dates are a must have and the pizza is amazing. Top tier customer service from the management to the servers. Love having them in the area.
reviews.author: Carter L.

reviews.text: Luna by Giada is pure magic. From the moment you walk in, everything feels elevated yet welcoming effortlessly stylish, warm, and full of heart. The atmosphere is stunning, the energy is vibrant, and every detail feels intentional. The food is chef's-kiss delicious beautifully crafted, comforting yet refined, and bursting with flavor. The service (Melanie) was attentive without being overbearing, making some fabulous recommendations and making the whole experience feel seamless and special. Luna by Giada isn't just a meal, it's a moment one you'll think about long after you leave. Can't wait to come back!
reviews.author: Andrea R.

reviews.text: Food OK but not outstanding.  Service was incredibly slow.  It took a full three hours for a dinner of appetizers, mains, and desert. We would not return
reviews.author: Britt W.

reviews.text:
Unfortunately it was not a good experience. Mediocre food and terrible ambiance. We were looking forward to this dinner for a few months and it was not what we anticipated. it was a waste of money for my mother's 80th birthday. Decent service but I wouldn't return.

*Also the AI generated "response "to this review is epic.
reviews.author: Sally P.

reviews.text: Our server Melanie was fantastic!! She was so friendly and personable! She explained the menu so well and described several of the dishes for us, including which ones she would recommend!! We will absolutely request her as our server next time!!
reviews.author: Brandi B.

reviews.text: Took the family for a holiday dinner. Food, service and atmosphere were excellent! Highest recommendation.
reviews.author: Chip G.

reviews.text: I was sorely disappointed in this restaurant. The staff was pleasant, ambiance was alright, the rest was subpar. No paper towels in the restrooms. None in the hotel lobby in the morning, none in the restaurant that night. We ordered the ribeye for $72. Served cold, was full of gristle and was tough. The potato square on my plate was also cold. We had the Branzino. Wasn't served hot and was salty. We had to repeatedly ask for water. Sometimes twice before receiving it and it was served warm in small cocktail glasses. The pitcher had no ice and neither did the glasses. We had two of the same cocktails and one was served about 2/3 of the way full. Same cocktail, different flavors. Nothing special at this place.
reviews.author: Angela B.

reviews.text: Luna restaurant is inside of our Scottsdale hotel so we stopped here for dinner one night and sat at the bar. There were 3 bartenders behind the bar, and only 1 was attentive. We watched the other 2 mingle all around the bar with everyone but us. But any who's, drinks were cool and my pasta dish was delicious but VERYYY salty. It was so good I just kept pushing through it and drinking a lot of water to balance it all out.
reviews.author: Erica R.

reviews.text:
Fantastic food! Outstanding service from our waitress Kendall. Explained and described the menu. 
The restaurant was beautiful . 
Great choice for a Christmas Eve dinner!!
reviews.author: Jimmy M.

reviews.text: Food was good, but not worth the price. We ordered extra shrimp but didnt expect it to be $10/shrimp! It should have been mentioned when the waitress offered extra... i didnt think it was going to be almost the same price as the meal.
reviews.author: Alice C.

reviews.text:
We had dinner at Luna by Giada and it was so good. Definitely five stars. We started with the focaccia bread which was warm, perfectly seasoned, and a great way to kick off the meal. I ordered the signature lemon spaghetti with sautéed shrimp and it was bright, fresh, and full of flavor without being too heavy. My boyfriend got the pan seared wild salmon with parmesan gnocchi and it was cooked perfectly. The salmon was tender and the gnocchi was rich and comforting.
The atmosphere was classy but still relaxed, and the service was friendly and attentive. Between the food, the vibe, and the overall experience, this place absolutely earned the five stars. We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Jay P.

reviews.text:
Time to update and refresh the menu. Have graced Luna with my presence numerous times. The menu is starting to be the same old same old. 
Need some new inspiration to repeat a trip. There are a  gazilion Italian dishes, let's see some new renditions. 

Place is nice to be at, patio is under utilized. Not sure why, but is usually bereft of patrons.
reviews.author: THE F.

reviews.text: Let's start with the impeccable service!!! They truly provided the five star experience, specifically Jay. He was so knowledgeable, transparent, and personable. He gave honest answers and made incredible recommendations. The cocktail he recommended was the Isabella, an Italian twist on a margarita. Amazing!!! You MUST get the noble focaccia bread to start. The crab arancini was tasty but smaller than I anticipated. The table loved the Branzino. I can't give a fair assessment because I'm not a fan of fish. The stars of the show for me were the lemon pasta and Filet special. Everything was great and we feasted like a family! A dabble of everything and to end it, the tiramisu was amazing!!! Honestly, many dishes are lemon forward and I'm all for it! The ambiance is so inviting and we ended the evening with roof top drinks and scoping out Wolf by Lisa Vanderpump!
reviews.author: Danielle V.

reviews.text: 3.5-4 stars! The ambiance is super fun here we loved the Christmas decor! Service started out wonderful but unfortunately fell flat. They completely forgot my friends order and nobody came by to check in- after 20 minutes of everybody already finishing up their meal we finally had to flag somebody down to let them know my friend didn't get her pasta. They offered to make one complimentary as they felt bad. But then on the check they charged her/ they were kind to take it off. But also strange that we denied dessert and they said they are happy to give a complementary one for my friends birthday...only to once again on the receipt be charged $5 for a birthday dessert?! They said it was complimentary so that was also strange. My risotto was delicious but on the saltier side. Just expected with how pricey this place is we would've had a better experience :/
reviews.author: Jaslean A.

reviews.text: Zigguly  and Aeamon are amazing. They listen to you request and provide a product and services that is above the rest. Thank you!!
reviews.author: Meghan W.

reviews.text: Jay is very helpfull with explaining all the menu. Food is very good expecially the lobster .
reviews.author: Cenisa G.

reviews.text: We have been to Luna several times and are always impressed. Kendall has been our server the last couple times and she is always fantastic. The inside is open but not too noisy. I had a classic Negroni this time and it was perfectly balanced. The focaccia and lemon spaghetti are always spot on and delicious. We got to meet Giada during our visit and she was so kind. She took a good amount of time to talk with my son and sign his cookbook. The manager Paul has come around every time we have been in and is great at making the experience personable. Long story short, great and personable service, tasty cocktails, incredible food, and a fun ambiance.
reviews.author: Mike Z.

reviews.text: The 3 stars is only because of the service. The food is super Americanized. Nothing was authentic. Lemon pasta was literally drowning in sauce?! Everything was way too heavy. Came to meet Giada because she would be here "all evening" but it seems she left before 8pm. I've made her recipes at home this does not compare. Disappointed is an understatement but the staff was very attentive...at least. *eyeroll*
reviews.author: Sarah T.

reviews.text: You all know the food here. The place to eat. Giada really rocks the lemon   Top notch. Service was EXCELLENT !  Brandy was extremely knowledgeable, she spent an enormous amount of time answering all our questions and even made some great suggestions,Jose kept our water full, Ethan brought us bread and he too was so friendly.
reviews.author: Jenna M.

reviews.text: Our last night in Scottsdale. This trip was made special by the experience we had at Luna. Kendall and Kaitlyn made our evenings great memories. Thanks to all the others Nick and Nico. Chefs and staff
reviews.author: George M.

reviews.text: If you're looking for a dining experience this is this place to go. Everything is fresh (fish flown in daily) and steak is local. Chef and staff is personable and welcoming
reviews.author: Chelsea K.

reviews.text: We obviously came for the amazing food, which lives up to every expectation. But we stayed for Jay - who transcended the evening into a n lm incredible culinary experience.
reviews.author: Alvaro

reviews.text: I have never had lobster so light, soft and airy and the gluten free pasta was, dare I say, perfect. I will absolutely be back for more!
reviews.author: Taylor H.

reviews.text:
We had a reservation for 4 at 8:15 pm and didn't get seated till 8:50 pm. It seemed like there was some kind of event happening at the hotel but the restaurant didn't seem very busy for a Saturday night. There were many empty tables that could have been used.

It was my friend's birthday and that's why we were going out for dinner. When we first checked in, the hostess even asked whose birthday it was and greeted her. It genuinely seemed like there was no communication between staff because when we sat down after waiting 35 mins to be seated, our waitress asked us if we were celebrating anything and we had let her know it was her birthday. We then waited another 15 mins before a new waiter came by and asked us the same thing along with what we wanted to drink. We were also confused why we all of sudden we had a new person taking care of us. 15 more mins went by and the manger came to our table asking if we've been taken care of yet and we had let him know that we haven't been. 10 mins later we finally got another waitress who then proceeded to ask us the same thing, "are you guys celebrating anything tonight?". This got super awkward because we went out with the intention of celebrating my friend and treating her to a nice dinner but ultimately felt like this restaurant did not care about our service. 

The manger came by to check on us again and he was very nice and told us that he would take care of us and handle everything to make it right. Our waitress had overheard that and when she was taking our order she mentioned how portions were smaller and encouraged us to order food because she said "since we're taking off some of the items did you guys want to order anything else". We knew the entire bill would not be completely covered but we definitely thought some appetizers would be especially since she encouraged us to order more of them. 

After we go our food we were honestly not very impressed with how much everything came out to be. With the overpriced food, drinks, and poor service, we were tired and wanted to leave so we asked for the bill. Our server asked if we wanted any dessert and we told her no and then she made a weird comment about how she already had a free birthday surprise coming. We told her that if that was the case we will take that and the bill. When she came back with the bill she let us know that they took off a couple of drinks and the dessert. This bothered us because the manger said they would make it right and then to make it seem like they did more, the waitress told us the FREE birthday dessert was taken off of the bill. 

To make matters worse, there were multiple people who clearly had too much to drink. There was a group sitting behind where we had been waiting initially to be seated and he spilled his drink and is alcohol got all over my dress. None of the workers came over to help with this situation. Then across from where we were sitting there was a couple arguing and screaming at each other. As entertaining as it was, this clearly made the couples and groups next to them uncomfortable and it looked like no staff cared enough to kick them out. There were also so many servers dropping glasses everywhere. This all made the entire ambiance seem trashy. 

Overall, there are so many other restaurants in the area that radiate a beautiful atmosphere (Cala, Etta, Elephante, Olive and Ivy, etc.) AND they won't overcharge you for mediocre food.
reviews.author: Lindsey S.

reviews.text: This was a return visit after a disappointing first try in the spring.  Paul, the general manager asked us to give them another try and we were glad we did!  Starting with the focaccia bread the meal was excellent!  The service was terrific and we had a terrific time. Warning, it is quite lively so quiet conversation can be difficult.  We didn't love the chocolate almond cake but maybe it just wasn't what we expected. A special shout out to the children piccata which two of our group had and raved about.
reviews.author: Jim P.

reviews.text: Great pasta but Strip not cooked consistent and taste wasn't there. One side is cooked more than the other and broccoli dry. Great drinks tho.
reviews.author: Levi A.

reviews.text: This one was smack down the middle.  The stars that were given were for the cleanliness, the wait staff attention and the food being edible.  It was the first time here and I had never even heard of this place until my husband made reservations on a Friday night.  None were needed because there were so many open tables the entire time we were there.  We never waited for anything and someone always coming to give us something, so very attentive, maybe I would dare to say a little too much.  The ambiance was mixed.  It was clean and decorated fine but it's inside a hotel and very open. It very much felt you were in a hotel and sitting in a loud cafeteria they tried to make fancy.  Every plate says Luna on it and fancy red crystal water cups on plain tables with no table cloth. and it's like a cheap fancy. Not sure how to describe it.  Weird vibe.  Anyway, one strange thing that I have never had happe Ed when we ordered or appetizers I wasn't sure what to get for my main.  So we put the order in for 2 appetizers and she says to us, "are you also ready to put in your main course? The kitchen likes when we give them customers full order all at once so they know. "  We might have looked a little puzzled and said, ok because then she said, I know they just like it all at once.  So we place out order for stuffed dates and a sushi like salmon.  The dates were over cooked and extremely bland. I was worried I wouldn't like the gorgonzola sauce but it had barely any flavor and the spicy sausage wasn't spicy, it had zero flavor.  I don't eat salmon but my husband said that was good and actually looked very appealing. Our main course was a meatless pasta vodka that was ok, nothing I would have to my friends about.  Had a slight lemon flavor to it, definitely not horrible but definitely not worth the price.  They claim it's homemade pasta everyday but didn't have the texture of fresh pasta but who knows.  My husband got the salmon and he said it was bland and it looked bland.  He is a pretty simple food guy, so for him to say something is bland is probably very bland to a normal person.  The cocktail list was a bit underwhelming, nothing stood out.  Stick with wine or a simple cocktail. Didn't want to venture into desserts because the food was blah but we did get a nice slice of cake/cookie type cannoli thing that was extremely sweet but nice they sent it.   Very surprised that chef Giada has her name attached all over this.  Probably go elsewhere for this price point in the area with something that checks all the boxes.
reviews.author: Erin R.

reviews.text: Very overpriced for quality of food. Servers were attentive in the beginning but then fizzled out. Took an hour to get our main course. They are much better places in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Kelly A.

reviews.text: How could I forget to write a review on my favorite spot while I was in Scottsdale. Luna by Giada was conveniently in our hotel so of course it became our go to spot to sit at basically every day we were there. We never fully sat in the restaurant but we did sit at the bar and enjoyed food and drinks. There were a ton of things on the menu I would have tried but we were always there for a quick bite. We did share the meatballs and a pizza one day which were both so good. I love a woodfired pizza so it was perfect! The bartending staff were top notch. There were 2 girls that always helped us and I wish I remembered their names now because they were the best and made it so much fun to stay there and stop for a drink throughout the weekend. This restaurant is in a hotel but definitely worth stopping in for some tasty Italian food.
reviews.author: Hannah N.

reviews.text: Delicious food, great cocktails and a fun outdoor patio. Loved everything we ordered. The lemon pasta with prawns was delicious!
reviews.author: Kaitlin G.

reviews.text: Jay is the man!! Great job. Very attentive to all of our needs before we know we needed it.
reviews.author: Joseph C.

reviews.text:
Experiencing an exclusive meet and greet dinner. Tickets were priced out at 295$ per person. This was a gift for my birthday. Let me just say well worth the ticket price and experience. Attentive service, food stations were unlimited (giving me high end luxury buffet vibe) I was star struck when giada served me pasta  been a fan since the 90's. The ambiance is classy and upscale. Making for a great special occasion experience. 
The food was outstanding! I can't complain about one thing. Would I do this experience again. Absolutely! Beats a flight to Vegas when you have all this in beautiful AZ.
reviews.author: Asa P.

reviews.text:
5 star all the way around.  We have been to all the high end restaurants in the valley.  This one was very impressive.  We enjoy top notch cuisine and wait staff.  In both categories, this restaurant is exceptional.  It started with Amanda, our server.  Her knowledge of the cocktails was immediately noted. I had the French 75 and loved it. My husband had the bourbon Moderno and enjoyed it.  Amanda recommended the caprese salad with the addition of prosciutto.  It was incredible. There was a subtle sauce with tomatoes and basil on top, and the beautiful prosciutto placed on each side. The prosciutto was high quality, lively flavor and not salty.  We also had the crab arancini, crispy and the flavor was perfect. I'd order it again it was so good. 
For dinner we had the lobster ravioli and the  scallop risotto (4 plump scallops).  The sauces were perfect, beautiful seasoning, nothing too strong or too salty,  we both said we'd order these again and recommend these dishes. Back to the staff. The service of Amanda and her staff who supported her was impeccable. As soon as a plate or glass was empty, it was quietly whipped away.  Amanda checked in frequently but subtly. Our water glasses were always kept full.  This is a 10 star experience.  Last but not least, the interior design of the restaurant is classy.  I loved the fabric (or was it fabric?) stretched over the middle of the ceiling with the little lights like starts.  Even the gorgeous cut crystal water glasses was beautiful.  I loved this experience.
reviews.author: Sandra P.

reviews.text:
Last night we attended a special tasting event at Luna and it was a night to remember! 
Every employee we interacted with was so friendly, provided good conversation, and had big smiles. You could tell they actually wanted to be there which made the experience even better. Now the food options available were killer. Salad in a cheese wheel along with pasta was the highlight, especially the freshly made ricotta. White lemon pizza melted in your mouth and lemon was a perfect hint of citrus. I also enjoyed the dessert bites as well. 
Kendall (waitress) and Elisa (helper) deserve a shout out because they were so kind and just on top of everything! Can't wait to go back and sit in Kendall's section :)
reviews.author: Lauren D.

reviews.text:
We took a client for dinner and everything was amazing, especially our server Brandee. She made us feel so welcome, really like a part of their family. The food was excellent; Brandee suggested some menu options that I normally would not order and we were so happy we went with her suggestions. The lemon pasta, bacon wrapped dates, and scallop risotto were excellent. I thought I liked tiramisu, now I know I love it when I'm at Lunas.

Good service is so important and the service here is great! We never wanted for anything, fresh silverware with every course, water was never empty, just the perfect amount of check-ins from Brandee and other staff. Felt I was eating with family.

Definitely recommend and I see many dinners at Luna in my future.
reviews.author: Cristy W.

reviews.text: Absolutely incredible food. Great space, bright and open like Giada's food. You owe it to yourself to get the bacon wrapped dates, as they will change your life. Wife ordered the lemon spaghetti, which was amazing - just enough lemon without being overbearing. I love pork chops but never order them out - did so here for the prosciutto covered shop and, again, amazing flavors and cooked perfectly.
reviews.author: Jonathan D.

reviews.text: Our waiter Jay was awesome! The food was exceptional! We shared the steak lobster and ravioli. The bread was wonderful as well. We will definitely be back. Added  was the incredible sunset view from the terrace upstairs
reviews.author: Brigitte M.

reviews.text:
The service was friendly and prompt. The food was delicious ! 
Wonderful place to celebrate my birthday w my bestie!
reviews.author: Ommar H.

reviews.text: We were charged $20 for two extra shrimps. The only thing that was good was salmon crudo
reviews.author: Bita V.

reviews.text:
The service at Luna was great and the lemon pasta tasted good, but the prices were way too high for what you get. We added shrimp to our pasta for $20 and only received two shrimp -- that's $10 per shrimp. For how expensive the menu already is, that felt unreasonable.

What really sealed it for me was the 3.5% credit card fee added to the bill. When you're already spending over $120 per person, it's frustrating to see a restaurant tack on extra charges like that.

Overall, the staff was kind and attentive, but between the pricing and the added fees, I wouldn't come back. There are better options in Scottsdale at this price point.
reviews.author: Kimmy H.

reviews.text: Let me start by saying the atmosphere is just stunning, very beautiful. Wonderful selection of cocktails and wine lots of different food options including pasta, pizza, and main dishes. We started with the focaccia, Arancini, Caprese, and Caesar salad. The focaccia is a must try! For my entree I got the signature lemon spaghetti. The flavor was wonderful and the presentation is beautiful, but the pasta was clumped together. Our server was top tier! Overall, I liked it and would try it again.
reviews.author: Brenna C.

reviews.text: I would rate this some of the best Italian in Scottsdale. The staff gets to the restaurant before 8am to start making the noodles from scratch. The flavors were excellent. My favorite was the sausage pizza and the lemon spaghetti. The servers were attentive nonstop and very knowledgeable of the menu.
reviews.author: Reagan W.

reviews.text:
Dinner Saturday 7/26/25. 

Service was VERY good. Well above 99% of restaurants we have visited. Jay did an excellent job. 

Food was good.  lemon pasta was on point. 

Ambiance was a little trendy and louder than what we prefer.
reviews.author: Troy S.

reviews.text:
Upon walking in, the decor and ambiance is excellent! Right down to the constellation designs on the ceiling above.Beautiful colors and setting. 
Being told there was a wait for a pre-booked reservation was off-putting, but the staff was quick to acknowledge and accommodate. Our waiter, Jay, was delightfully polite and knowledgeable about the menu. From start to finish, Giada has amazed once again with her use of Lemon, Parmesano-Reggiani,  and fresh herb and spice. Any "foodie" would be amiss, if they didn't partake in this experience!
Plenty of portion, plenty of flavor and lasting memory.
reviews.author: Kc R.

reviews.text: All around great hotel and staff is wonderful! Ziggy at Luna went above and beyond made great drinks and even hooked us up with creamer for our coffee in our room! Also Cindy at check in was amazing and Aidan was super helpful. thank you to you all. our first stay here looking forward to the next visit!
reviews.author: Gina F.

reviews.text: Let's start off by saying the food was pretty good but definitely not worth the price. Any decent Italian restaurant could have made the same quality of food. The place had club music that gets cranked up insanely loud at a certain time. The service was the worst part, with the server being condescending and having micro-aggressions. The food and overall experience definitely does not justify the extremely inflated price. It seems that the fact that they are in a nice hotel and affluent area they can charge a lot more. There's an admin fee that is added onto your bill which makes zero sense. I had very high hopes but I just can't recommend it. I'd go anywhere else next time.
reviews.author: Raymond ..

reviews.text:
The wife and I chose this place at the spur of the moment while passing through Scottsdale. We wanted to hit up her place while we were in Vegas, but other things seemed to occupy us while we were there and never had the chance. At any rate, we took the opportunity and decided to have an early dinner to beat the crowd. I'm glad we did because we literally had the place to ourselves. 

The service was stellar, the ambiance was relaxed, bright, airy, and with a truly Tuscan feel. The live singer was so good we thought it was a pre-recorded playlist until we saw him singing by the bar. 

I ordered the chicken piccata and the wife ordered the lobster pasta. Both excellent choices. I had their signature bourbon cocktail, which was ok. 

The server was attentive and offered enough conversation to find out that my wife was celebrating her birthday. At the end of the meal, our server was thoughtful enough  to bring out a piece of candle topped Tiramisu that was absolutely divine.  

Overall our experience was great!  When you combine great food with great service, it is a recipe for greatness. Definitely food ninja worthy! 

Yelping for the good of humanity. Yelp on my peeps, Yelp on!
reviews.author: Rey D.

reviews.text: I decided to come in during happy hour and they were also playing live music. It is a great place to stop in for a delicious espresso martini. It is a very fun and lively spot and I really enjoyed it!! I sat at the bar and the bartenders were very attentive!
reviews.author: Navneet K.

reviews.text: The service was exceptional from start to finish. Our servers/bar tenders Ziggy and Isaiah were knowledgeable, attentive without being intrusive, and genuinely passionate about the menu. Every recommendation was spot on. We sure will be back!
reviews.author: Sam K.

reviews.text: Food was awesome! Our dinning experience was great, kind of felt like we were in Vegas on the strip. Our server Melanie was so attentive to our needs, and super friendly. 10 out out of 10...recommend!!!
reviews.author: Michael A.

reviews.text: Delicious! Loved every dish we had, and they graciously split each dish that my gf and i shared. The waitstaff was all super nice too and made the experience.
reviews.author: Lo S.

reviews.text:
Their Signature Lemon Spaghetti was really good. I was a bit hesitant to order it since we make a lot of pasta at home but the spaghetti was cooked al dente and the sauce was super lemony. Definitely ask for a lot of fresh cracked black pepper! It complements the lemon flavor so well. Our waitress recommended adding on the for lobster was an extra $60 but it was actually $65 when we got our check. We were celebrating our anniversary so we decided to splurge but it wasn't worth honestly.

I was so looking forward to getting the Chocolate Hazelnut Soufflé for dessert but they didn't have it available. They did have a seasonal Limoncello Soufflé but it was a bit heavy on the egg flavor. Pretty disappointed with the dessert.
reviews.author: Kylie C.

reviews.text:
Coming into the restaurant it was very elegant. The decor, lighting and furniture. 

The service was very nice and pleasant however the way the waitress was dress i felt did not suit the restaurant. She was very exposed. 

Next the music. They were playing pop rap. Which also did not suit. It was also very loud which is not what I expect coming to a nice restaurant. 
I personally ordered the crab arancini, scallops risotto and then lemon souffle. 
The crab arancini was delicious. The risotto was salty. Finally the souffle was the worst of all. Very eggy and offputting and honestly didn't taste of anything 
There were 7 of us that went. Everyone ordered an entree and half ordered desserts and half ordered appetizers. No drinks but bottled water. The bill was $592 before tip.
This is so overpriced. If I wanted to pay that price point I rather a place like cafe monarch. Where the ambiance matches that price. If I wanted nice Italian food I rather go to north italia. All in all very disappointing
reviews.author: Melissa D.

reviews.text: Had high hopes, but it was terrible. The ambience was great and the wine was decent, but the food was incredibly salty. We had the bucatini which tasted like salt. We had the meatballs which had so much breadcrumb. You couldn't taste the meat and it was so dry because of the breadcrumbs that it fell apart. It had so much Parmesan cheese that all you tasted was salt. The scallop risotto incredibly salty, and the lobster ravioli was so small. You couldn't even taste the lobster and the ravioli was so thick. It was too chewy. The cookies for dessert  were just average.would not go back.
reviews.author: Linda B.

reviews.text: Ziggy and Isaiah were incredible! As an individual with allergies, I was so happy with all of my options and the knowledgable staff! 10/10 would recommend!
reviews.author: Julia A.

reviews.text: Amazing food and service.  Waited a long time to experience this restaurant and I recommend you won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: Helen K.

reviews.text:
Tried Luna for the first time. Underwhelmed for sure.  Let's start with ambiance while located in Scottsdale it does not have a Scottsdale vibe.  More of a Las Vegas buffet feel. No table cloths and the staff wears jeans.  Nothing wrong with that look but when you are charging super high prices for normally inexpensive food (pasta) 
I would expect more.   Food was at best ok had 2 pasta dishes which were just ok.  Ordered smashed potatoes for $17 and they were not smashed and were just a few fingerling potatoes with the skins left on and a heavy dose of lemon juice.  Not great and again at the high end for a side dish.   Had an order of bread which was the highlight of the dinner. Due to it being our anniversary they provided a canola cake free of charge. Nice gesture but cake was super dry and almost stale.  Drinks were ok but at $21 a piece should be.   Only reason I am giving 3 stars is the service was great and our server very nice.   I think Giada may need to stop by and check this place out not helping her brand in my opinion.  
Very disappointed and will not be back given the countless number of high scale high quality restaurants in Scottsdale but give it a try as just my opinion.
reviews.author: Bill S.

reviews.text: Really Good service , and food was delicious , nice ambience ! My only criticism is takes a while to get the food out and place wasn't packed at all ! Keep in mind prices aren't the best , we added 6 shrimps to a Luna tower and for those 6 shrimps it cost $60 , 10$ per shrimp Yikes !
reviews.author: Danna S.

reviews.text:
Stopped in for an early dinner and it was my first time in and I am a fan. The overall look and vibe is amazing. The hostess promptly greeted me and I was allowed to sit without my party being there. My awesome waitress, Kendall was TOP TIER! She was personable and also knew the dishes very well KUDOS to Luna for the awesome hire. 

I ordered the Bucatini and it was a solid 3 out of 5 I think the spicy sausage add on made it too salty. The focaccia bread was 5/5 and the tiramisu was   delish. 

Thank you to Paul the manager for being amazing as well for the intro to the chef(s). 

Cant wait to return!!
reviews.author: MoShai G.

reviews.text:
Great service and delicious food! 
From the beginning to the end of the dinner... everything was amazing. The server we had was very friendly and knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Olga I.

reviews.text:
We wanted to like this place. The ambiance is nice, and we didn't feel packed in, but it was noisy. We tried a few appetizers, the focaccia was outstanding, but nothing else was memorable.  The lemon pizza was chewy with a terrible texture, and the lemon flavor overpowered everything. We each ordered a pasta, but only one arrived al dente; the rest were rubbery. My bucatini was bland. 

I would go back for a glass of wine and some focaccia, but I wouldn't get anything else.
reviews.author: Lisa C.

reviews.text:
Tough review to give, because the experience was split right down the middle. There were definitely some highs and lows and in the end, the misses made it a "could've been better" review. Would I return... "yes",  as I was telling some friends but I'd be very specific with my reservation and ordering. 

Made a reservation for 2 as part of my birthday celebration weekend. We arrived on time, but they were running behind. We were told to head upstairs to the SEVEN Bar for a cocktail and would be notified when our table was ready. This was one of the lows...

We got to SEVEN and let the host know. Honestly, it felt like I was being ignored at the bar while trying to order just two cocktails. The vibe itself was good & I gave a shout out to the band groovin, but the service was disappointing. I was overlooked, plain and simple. By the time the drinks finally came, my phone went off and it was time to head back downstairs. Let me say, not the best suggestion for a wait.

We were seated across from the kitchen at a table off the main walkway, not ideal as I had to deal with all the foot traffic and a view of the oven in the kitchen. Our server was okay. Not bad, but the vibe was off... kind of like "I'm here, but not really here." That was the energy both of us picked up on and we kept going back to it with the level of service. 

We started with the Focaccia, based on the server's recommendation. It came with 3 flavor sauces, basil pesto, olive oil with balsamic, and a lemon mascarpone butter that was dope!!! I wanted to put it on everything. From there, we added the Caprese Salad (decent) and the Fritto Misto (calamari, shrimp, and sweet drop peppers). The sauce was good, but there was a bit too much batter for my taste on the seafood.

For dinner, we had the Branzino and I ordered the Agnolotti pasta, which is a pork and veal combo pasta. The server suggested adding lobster, so I decided to splurge. Wanting to try a bit of everything, we also added the Corn & Sausage side.

The server crew was helpful overall, but we constantly had to wait on water refills. Also, the Lemon Spaghetti (a top pick, supposedly) didn't look that appealing when I saw other plates going out, so I passed on it. 

Unfortunately, my lobster didn't come out with the meal. I had to  raise my hand like I was back in school to get someone's attention. Once I did, the manager responded quickly and worked to make it right. Eventually, the lobster came out a la carte, but by then I was already halfway through my pasta dinner. It might've been a good mix, but I didn't get to enjoy it the way it was intended.

The pasta itself was good, and there were no complaints from the Branzino fan across from me. The corn and sausage  was good, but I wouldn't order again as it felt a little out of place with the rest of the meal.

I do appreciate the response from the team to try and resolve by removing from our bill, but I also had to remind them at the end, which made it awkward as it was overlooked. 

To close out, I had the Happy Birthday Cookie Platter. It was a nice touch, but that signature experience I was hoping for just wasn't there. A letdown, especially on a night that was meant to be special & memorable.
reviews.author: Omari D.

reviews.text: Been here twice.  Thought I would give it another shot, after my first attempt after it opened wasn't great.   Had a business dinner there the second time, and that was a bad idea.  It's extremely loud and there was no way we were going to get much done, so that was a fail.  I wouldn't go there to have an intimate date or any meaningful conversation.  The food, on both occasions was terrible.  Service is good, but a tad over the top and borderline annoying....far too much fuss and interruption.  The interior is pleasant enough, but the whole vibe is corporate dining hell.....but the bottomline the food is just kinda gross....overly salty at times, and just plain bland at others.  Expected more given the branding.
reviews.author: Slipknotnyc S.

reviews.text: 10/10 experience dining at Luna this Sunday night. Ask for Ziggy at the bar, he was very friendly and offered high quality suggestions. The Sicilian focaccia and arancini hit the spot, the seafood tower and petite filet were both top tier. Not to mention the restaurant looks amazing at sunset. Highly recommend Luna by Giada to anyone looking for a unique and memorable dining experience.
reviews.author: Skyler F.

reviews.text: Jay was an amazing server he knew the menu in and out and made great suggestions would come back again!!!!
reviews.author: Kassady F.

reviews.text: I cannot tell you how much I love Luna. The food is amazing I've been several times and only had a bad experience once and they totally made up for it and were very apologetic and that's all you could ask for, everybody has a bad night unfortunately we showed to one of them, but every other night has been amazing and can't even compare. You should definitely go to Luna everything is so good but especially the focaccia bread
reviews.author: Kamesha L.

reviews.text:
If I could describe this place with one word, it would be: exceptional. 
The hostess was super sweet and welcoming. When we sat down, the waitress was on top of every single thing. She gave us the best recommendations and I am glad we trusted her. 
The filet was probably one of the best I've ever had. It was cooked to perfection and flavor was AMAZING! We also tried the lemon pasta and it was better than what I expected. The sauce was one I have never tried before. It was super creamy and didn't have an over powering taste of lemon. The last thing we tried was the soufflé. This was made perfectly airy (not many restaurants can nail this dessert but of course they did here!) 
The staff is one of the best, the actual restaurant is nicely designed and the food was 10/10.
reviews.author: Sabrina J.

reviews.text: WOW...awesome culinary experience in an upscale, modern deco atmosphere. Often in these upper echelon establishments in hotels, the service is dismal and a buzz-kill...not at Luna!  Our Bartender, Michael, is first class!  BTW, the White Negroni absolutely blew me away!  I'm a traditional Italian man who loves his traditional Negroni, but the White (clear) version will now be served on my Italian home as well. Okay, so just so you know, the food it amazing. My wife and I shared the meat pizza and it was so good I had to know what ingredients the chef uses to create such a masterpiece (so I can duplicate it at home as well)...the "00 Flour" is the secret weapon.  I highly recommend happy hour due to the incredibly discounted prices. Also, check out the rooftop bar / restaurant on the Seventh Floor called "Seven". There's a great bar menu that will please the palette and a cocktail menu that is sure to please. You can even take your drinks and food to the upper deck for an open air experience looking out over The Phoenician Resort and the east side of Camelback Mountain. But watch your step!    We'll be back soon Michele!
reviews.author: Dan F.

reviews.text: Food was very good and ambiance was romantic. Only gripe may be that the portions are on the smaller size for the price but it's definitely worth a visit for the experience and flavors!
reviews.author: Angela K.

reviews.text:
Nice evening with great food
And service. Ambiance was a little
Loud with a birthday party next to us. Jay was fabulous!
reviews.author: Mark G.

reviews.text: First time at this restaurant. Great service from Sarah K  and all the food was delicious. Atmosphere was calming n I appreciated that there is space between the tables. You are not sitting on top of the other guests. We were celebrating a birthday n Sarah delivered a tasty bday cookie n ice cream. Lovely end to a great dinner! Thank you!
reviews.author: Maureen D.

reviews.text:
I've dined at many places, but my experience at Luna ranks among the worst -- not because of the food (which I never even got to try), but because of the abysmal customer service and outright incompetence of management, particularly from the so-called General Manager, Paul.

Upon arrival, we were greeted not with hospitality, but with confusion and indifference. There were clearly multiple open tables, yet we were told by the hostess staff that seating was being handled "by the computer" -- a nonsensical excuse that seemed more like a way to avoid accountability than a system designed for efficiency. No logic, no flexibility, no service.

When we asked for clarification, Paul stepped in -- not to help, but to escalate the situation by smugly offering us seats at the bar. That's right: while empty tables sat untouched, the General Manager thought the best solution was to downgrade our experience and essentially dismiss our concerns. According to him, there were no pre-assigned seats, just random assignments from some mystery system. Translation: we don't care where you sit, and we're not going to help you.

Luna wants to present itself as a refined dining experience, but the truth is it's run like a poorly managed chain with zero regard for the guest. If Paul is the one leading the team, it's no wonder the front-of-house is so disorganized and indifferent.

Save yourself the frustration. Luna may have trendy decor and a curated menu, but no amount of ambiance can make up for being treated like an inconvenience. Until they learn the basics of hospitality -- or hire someone who actually knows how to manage a dining room -- this place deserves to be skipped, not celebrated.
reviews.author: David B.

reviews.text: Food was delicious!!! And our server Natalie was phenomenal - so kind and helpful, she  gave suggestions on what to get from a variety of very delicious and unique plates; we were blown away by how good everything was. It was our honeymoon as well and we were treated with a dessert to celebrate. We aren't from phoenix but would definitely go back multiple times if we could.
reviews.author: Maria G.

reviews.text: Famous Lemon Spaghetti was a big failure. It looked fancy, but had no lemon flavor at all. It was Spaghetti fettuccine basically for $39. No bread given and the two shrimp were rubbery and overcooked. Pepper shaker though was very nice touch.
reviews.author: Brad W.

reviews.text:
This restaurant is a perfect example of why to stay away from "celebrity chef" restaurants. The food was.... Good. Not exceptional or outstanding. It was... good. Now factor in the cost and the food becomes terrible. I have no issue paying dearly for anything exceptional but when I pay dearly and get... "meh," that is a horse of another color.
