Food runner brings two caprese salads to the table that looked like two VERY different  salads in portion size, appearance, ingredients and everything. Doesn't even notice until she sets them down and I say....
"These don't look anything alike?" Then of course this was corrected.... Moving to the meal... chicken picatta, pretty good if you think picking a bone out of your $42 deep fried chicken breast that doesn't even come with any pasta is ok. Never had chicken picatta with no pasta. I guess there's a first for everything. You'd think that after paying $42 for $3 worth of chicken you could get a 75 cent pile of pasta too! Oh wait... NeverMind. This is a "celebrity chefs" restaurant. I guess we should all be thankful. My daughter ordered a bowl of pasta that was as bland as a nursing home Thursday night menu. Table bread? Yep. $15.  This place is so spectacularly average but exceptionally overpriced. Luna is gonna be a hard pass for me.
reviews.author: Erin O.

reviews.text:
Luna By Giada delivers a truly lovely dining experience. The food is delicious--thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor, with each dish showcasing Giada's signature Italian flair. The cocktails are especially impressive, crafted with creativity and balance that elevate the entire meal.

The decor is gorgeous--elegant and romantic, with soft lighting and stylish touches that make it perfect for a date night or special occasion. Service was excellent as well--friendly, attentive, and professional from start to finish.

All in all, we had a fantastic time and would absolutely recommend Luna By Giada for anyone looking for a beautiful atmosphere paired with great food and drinks.
reviews.author: Joselynn B.

reviews.text: Such an unexpected surprise! Jay was our waiter and he was terrific...so knowledgeable and full of great suggestions and personality! One of the best Caesar salads we've ever had.  Highly recommend the Focaccia bread and lemon spaghetti. All of the ingredients are flown in from select parts of the country like flour, meat, seafood, cheese...all are premium quality and perfectly pared. My husband got the Nodi Marini Ala Vodka (which was also delicious). Their pizzas and other entrees all looked delicious too! We will be back for sure! Our new favorite restaurant!
reviews.author: Rachelle G.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful evening at Luna made even by the great service provided to us by Natalie and Jett. They were very friendly, attentive and professional. They made the meal even more memorable.
reviews.author: Doty S.

reviews.text: Went to celebrate Mother's Day with the family enjoy the Delicious food,  excellent service !! great ambiance and the best soufflé
reviews.author: Norma C.

reviews.text:
Our waiter , Jay , was fantastic .
Our meal was great . 
We've been to both locations several times and the only thing I that was missing for me, was meatballs .
We find out tonight that Giada added meatballs .
They were great as well .

The atmosphere is wonderful.

We will continue to come back and it remains one of our favorite restaurants .

Thank You !!
reviews.author: James M.

reviews.text: Food was OK, but overpriced for the quality. Shrimp and scallops were overcooked. Service was fair. Waitress and multiple bus boys very attentive and friendly, but to the point of disruption. Multiple times drinks (wine and water) were spilled by waitress and other staff on the table. They kept pouring water and wine even when asked to stop. They poured our sparking water into glasses that already were filled with tap water.  My Knife was dirty, had to request new silverware. Atmosphere was nice, but was VERY put off by waitresses ill fitting and food stained shirt and vest. The uniform was not becoming to any of the staff. Also, requested to move tables twice. Restaurant was initially empty, yet they sat us (2 women friends) at 6 person booth/chair table (very uncomfortable) despite a significant number of empty 2 tops.  Would not return or recommend.
reviews.author: Laura D.

reviews.text: My family and I were visiting Phoenix for an annual business conference. During that week, my son's 18th birthday and my 21st wedding anniversary were on the same day and we chose this restaurant to celebrate. We had been attending meetings all day and found the location later in the evening and they fit all four of us in at a beautiful table minute and were extremely gracious and accommodating. We felt very welcome, enjoyed the ambience and the food was spectacular! Melanie was our server and she went out of her way to make the evening special, along with her team. She made enjoyable wine, selections, and entrée recommendations.  She surprised us  birthday dessert for our son, and we all had an incredible meal! We will definitely visit again! Highly, highly recommend!
reviews.author: Kimberly k.

reviews.text:
The staff was great!

The pasta is house made. The foccacia bread was delicious. The steak with the little quail egg on top was lovely. The side lemon potatoes was my favorite savory bite.  The chocolate almond cake was decadent, and the lemon cookie was a table favorite. Be sure to have a coffee after the meal! It was an incredible experience.
reviews.author: Christine C.

reviews.text:
I am always weary of chef restaurants...this wasn't an exception. Let me start by saying I was here for a birthday dinner for a friend and there was a total of 13 people. The service was excellent in regard to this. Even those who came late still didn't have to wait long for their food and my water glass was constantly being refilled. The atmosphere is really beautiful, and there is plenty a rom around the tables which was appreciated. Now the food, the real reason we come. The stuffed dates are to die for and 100% would come here just to get an order of those. 
The lemon pasta, the signature dish....honestly I was super disappointed I was expecting lemon flavor. There was barely a whisper of lemon, and $20 for two extra shrimp to be added made me wanna drop kick someone. $20?! That is just absurd. The cocktail message in a bottle, it was a solid drink for $21. Overall, just felt kinda eh about this place. Maybe better environment for a few cocktail and appetizers or a pizza. But it's gonna be a high bill.
reviews.author: Scarlett M.

reviews.text: Melanie gave an amazing dining experience; 100/10 hospitality. The food tasted amazing, atmosphere was clam, and overall experience of the restaurant was great.
reviews.author: Jonathan C.

reviews.text: Overpriced but delicious. The vibes were nice for a date night. We sat at the bar so service was good.
reviews.author: Makayla B.

reviews.text:
We had dinner out last night with our wonderful friends Joe and Diana; they turned us onto Luna by Giada!  We know of Giada by her extraordinary presence on The Food Network, and clearly her restaurant embraces her exquisite palate and attention to every last detail!

Our server Natalie went above and beyond, offering us attentive kindness that I just haven't seen in any other restaurant, and her supporting staff took care of us as if we were the most important guests in the restaurant!  We even enjoyed the company of the General Manager, Paul, who graciously spent time with us making us all feel so at home we're already planning our return. 

And that's not to diminish the food in any way!  Everything from the bacon wrapped dates to the scallop mushroom risotto, from the lemon spaghetti to our array of desserts left us near speechless with joy!  It was truly a beautiful and unforgettable experience we will be sharing with many of our friends as we come back again and again!
reviews.author: Peter F.

reviews.text: One of my favorite restaurants in the area. If you love lemon and seafood, it's great. They are also accommodating and can do all their pastas as gluten free. I had their signature lemon pasta and it was excellent.
reviews.author: Celeste W.

reviews.text: The food was boring.  The service lacking.  A basic hotel food joint with a fancy name.  Very disappointed as we were celebrating our 45 wedding anniversary.  We will never return or recommend!
reviews.author: Susan R.

reviews.text:
Has a great experience at Luna! We sat outside to enjoy the final few weeks of patio weather. All of the pasta in made in house, starting at 7 AM daily. All fish is flown in fresh daily.

Our server Jay and Alonso were very attentive.

We had the signature lemon spaghetti and loved it! The arugula salad was also a favorite.
reviews.author: Meghan C.

reviews.text: This would be my second time dining at Luna by Giada and both times the food and service exceeded expectations.  For appetizers we opted for the bacon wrapped dates, orzo meatballs (new addition to menu) and arugula salad.  And for my entree I did their classic lemon spaghetti and the pork chop saltimboca.  The bacon wrapped dates left more to be desired this time around and their meatballs were good but not the best I've ever had.  The arugula salad was a nice compliment to round out the appetizers.  What really stole the show was their classic lemon spaghetti dish and pork chop entree.  The lemon  spaghetti had just the right amount of cream without overdoing it on the lemon aspect of it.  You also get a couple pieces of very good shrimp to go along with the lemon spaghetti.  The pork chop saltimboca was above average but might have to pass on it next time due to its very high price of $66.  Overall I would recommend Luna by Giada.  If you are looking for high quality food with prompt service and cozy ambiance then this is the place to be.
reviews.author: Gianluca D.

reviews.text: Our event was a huge success thanks to the amazing team at Luna. Great food, service and ambiance. Thanks to Paul, Kenny, Christian and their super talented amazing head chef!
reviews.author: Sandeep G.

reviews.text: Food was very good. Lemon pasta was my favorite with the sausage. The Focaccia bread was next level. Big fan!! Wasn't too pumped about them seating us in the very back by the bathroom. Especially since walked past open tables. Overall a good experience and I would go back!!
reviews.author: Giovann M.

reviews.text:
It was our last night in AZ and a Saturday. Seeing the reviews went ahead and made reservations.


We arrived and were sat somewhat promptly. We were greeted almost immediately with water and beverage options and about two minutes later by someone offering appetizers and bar drinks. We declined and our server arrived about 10 minutes later. She took our order and our food took a little longer than normal due to there being a lot of prom groups for the evening.

My friend ordered the meatballs which were delicious! I truly have not tasted a better meatball and my aunt by marriage is Italian so I have had authentic homemade... these were 10/10. 

My daughter ordered the lemon pizza which was also really good. She enjoyed.

I ordered the filet mignon. It was excellent both by taste and tenderness. 

The sides are al a cart should you choose to order one although my filet was served on a bed of potato.

The chocolate "cake" was just okay, I would not order again. 

My friend and her daughter who consider themselves tiramisu connoisseurs raved about this tiramisu. 

The manager was very visible and stopped by our table two times.

If in the area again, I would most definitely return.
reviews.author: Shevon M.

reviews.text: Walking in the atmosphere of the place was very nice and lively greeted by kind hosts. The waiter was sweet and helped us decide what to order. We ordered their famous lemon pasta, Margherita pizza, and crab arancini. The crab arancini had a lot more crab meat than I thought there was going to be and the Parmesan cheese really balanced it out. Their most unique dish was definitely the lemon pasta as the flavor was a bit too strong for me but the shrimp was very good. Other people in the party really enjoyed the lemon pasta though. The Margherita pizza was one of my favorites as the crust was nice and fluffy. Lastly for dessert the soufflé was nice and light, only complaint is for it to be bigger :).
reviews.author: Kelley C.

reviews.text:
Absolutely delicious.

Service was fantastic, Sarah didn't miss a step.

Food was world class; bold flavors yet everything you want in traditional Italian food.
Margherita pizza, lemon spaghetti, Cesar salad, all delicious!

The cherry on top; it's kid friendly too.

See you next time we're in town!
reviews.author: Katie M.

reviews.text: Amazing food...coastal Italian. Hints of lemon and an abundance of flavors. Light yet fulfilling entrees. Great ambiance. The music was just a pinch too much but that's just me looking at giving constructive feedback. Our server, Melanie, was top shelf. She was very attentive to our table and we never wanted for a thing. My son went as far as to call Luna's the "best Italian food I've ever eaten". You can't go wrong here.
reviews.author: Joe L.

reviews.text: Service mediocre at best at the bar. Bartenders were having fun with each other...which is great but it came to expense of the customers. Additionally the restaurant is not wallet friendly so I would expect WAY more attentive service. Noted, I came at 7pm on a Monday night and the restaurant had more staff than clients. Do better...or was I being judged on my appearance hence the negative experience. Debatable bur do better. The bar back was a sweet heart though...give him my full $25 tip (post cooks)
reviews.author: Hanna T.

reviews.text: Mia was wonderful.  We came here after it first open and tried it again a few months later. Not what we thought it would be. Came back tonight and what a change they've made. Food outstanding, drinks, great, and the service attentive in first class. We will be back and will bring our friends.
reviews.author: Scott B.

reviews.text: We had such a memorable dining experience at Luna! Melanie was our server and she went above and beyond catering to our family's every need. We started off with the Sicilian focaccia (loved the sauces) and crab arancini; then ordered Branzino (that celery puree was delicious) and Signature Lemon Spaghetti! Dessert was the chocolate hazelnut soufflé- wow! We will definitely be back! Very special!
reviews.author: Carly G.

reviews.text: The food was very good.   Appetizers in particular were perfect.  The entrees were very good but after such amazing appetizers, not as great as we anticipated they would be.  The service was okay but lots of little things that never came unless we asked a second time but given how busy they were, I guess okay.  Lots of energy in the place , beautiful decor and it had a good overall vibe.  While a very good meal, not really the experience we were hoping for.
reviews.author: Mary K.

reviews.text:
I've been wanting to come here ever since I heard Giada was opening a restaurant in Scottsdale a year ago. Visiting company from out of town gave me the perfect opportunity to come try for my birthday. 
 Our hostess gave us a brief introduction while showing us to our table. She walked us by the pizza oven which Giada calls a Ferrari because it cooks the pizza in 90 seconds. She sat us in the Jay room which is named after Giadas daughter.

Beautiful atmosphere with lots of natural light and pretty table settings. I knew I wanted to try the lemon pizza. Our waitress recommended adding a prosciutto and while good it cost an extra $16 in addition to the $28 for the lemon pizza. I was amazed at the pop of lemon flavor and how well it paired with cheese of the pizza. It was recommended to get the pizza well done but this did result in the pizza crust being a little charred. I would just get the pizza cooked as is next time. 
Our waitress recommended the Branzino fish for our entree which we also split. Our waitress compared it to a Thanksgiving meal and while it didn't remind me of this I did enjoy the fresh fish with bursts of pomegranate seeds and other accompanying flavors. I tried one bite with skin like our waitress suggested and it was all right but I still preferred it with the skin removed. 
  I paired my food with a mixed white wine that our waitress suggested, Greco Di Tufo which I enjoyed. They aren't currently serving the lemon soufflé so I skipped dessert. Overall it was a very satisfying meal and I look forward to coming back and trying the lemon pasta and lemon soufflé when it is back in season. 

Giada also has a breakfast/brunch restaurant Pronto located in the same building.
reviews.author: Harmony D.

reviews.text: We attended this restaurant with a group of 12 people during a bachelorette trip. We were able to get a reservation quickly. We sat outside on the patio. Unfortunately the heaters did not work and the employees were not able to fix them. Our waiter was very friendly. We were slightly disappointed that he did not check to make sure the food arrived correctly. The steak was cooked very well for being cooked for medium well. The steak was a little spicy. The scallop risotto was delicious. The drinks were also delicious just a little pricey. The tiramisu was very good and many could have shared.
reviews.author: Brooke L.

reviews.text: Great food - wait staff was attentive and supportive. Food was magnificent. Can't wait to go back!
reviews.author: Jerry P.

reviews.text: My husband and I went to celebrate at Luna. The restaurant is beautiful and has a great view of the city. The food was good, but the service we received from Lynette was exceptional! She helped create dinner into an experience. Her recommendations for the menu did not disappoint. Days later we are still raving about our visit to Luna. Will definitely be back soon!
reviews.author: monet b.

reviews.text: The food was good. Unfortunately when we walked in, they told us it would be a 20 minute wait, at most being 25 minutes. After almost an hour waiting, they sat my boyfriend (6'4) and me (5'11) at the shortest table in the restaurant at the point where neither of our legs could fit and we had to adjust to crunch them under this tiny table. In addition, our waitress was not the friendliest and felt as if she talked down to us as we were clearly the youngest couple in there. Overall, a disappointing experience but the food made it a bit better.
reviews.author: Maia M.

reviews.text:
Service was serviced but not attentive at all from Melanie. The busers really did a good job with their observations and needs. 
I think I was more frustrated at a couple small things. Me and another friend ordered a bottle as we were asked if we would have 2 glasses, then we should order a bottle. So when the bottle arrived, I tasted it and said It was a go. She went to the other side of the table and started pouring other people that didn't order the wine, mine was still empty as I only tasted it yet was the one who ordered it. So anyway, she ended up pouring four glasses. I would have appreciated she pour our 2 and set it down and we offer as she kind of made them just have it based off of availability. 

We got presented with another tables food twice... one actually got placed down in front of us and had to get sent back as the adjoining entree was not ours. 
With my meal I had no wine as she never came back. I finally ordered a by the glass post meal (as the bottle had been poured by her). 

Then she was so sweet with all of our dessert orders to send out 2 ice creams/cookie- idk why- .... She must have forgotten about her diary free customer (when they have sorbetto). Who watched everyone indulge. 

Ambiance is ok, it was so loud we tried to scoot in close to hear each other and yell. Someone sitting 2 over and across from me at the same table couldn't hear me. People were dressed hotel lobby. 

Food was delicious. Focaccia was excellent. Pepper grinder was funny! Wouldn't go back for the price. 

 I made a big deal about nothing. I was not impressed. Have fun
reviews.author: T.K. M.

reviews.text:
Was greeted nicely when walked in. 
Plenty of smiles. We were given option of indoor or outdoor seating. 
Sat on Patio as it was a beautiful night ( patio heaters available) Waitress Sarah was very good. And the Food was great. Manager walked around and made sure everyone was good. Nice touch 
THANKS Giada and team !!
reviews.author: Gerardo L.

reviews.text: Biggest DISAPPOINTMENT in a long while!!  Food literally was not nearly as good as moderately priced Italian food in the area.  The waitress acted like the special was a big deal.  It was merely an added on portion of a crab leg, and a meager one at that, for the price of $125.00!!  Natalie, our waitress, started out enthusiastically, in order to oversell us the "overpriced special."  Than we never saw her again until check time.  I am not exaggerating!  The entree was merely pasta with a red sauce, then you thrown in chili oil and ricotta cheeks on the side.  Nothing you would ever crave or out of the ordinary.  Service very disappointing. The restaurant was beautiful, not too loud.  The restrooms are an issue though.  You have only two stalls for both women and men. Wait was long while your food was getting cold.   Trust me, this is just a fashionable place to go, but the only thing going for it is the location.  Save your $$$$$.  Way overpriced!
reviews.author: Sandi S.

reviews.text: Melanie was incredible! She was so attentive and so accommodating. The food was so delicious. We love you, Melanie!
reviews.author: Ian S.

reviews.text: Great food, excellent service and nice ambiance. A good addition to Scottsdale fashion square are.
reviews.author: Khaldoun B.

reviews.text: Everything Giada touches turns to gold...literally the cheesecake had gold flakes on it! Delicious dining, excellent cocktails, and caring and attentive servers. Jay, our server was excellent! He took his time walking us through all the cocktails and menu items and ensured that our dinner was an experience, not just a meal. 12/10 recommend Luna for any occasion. It is also a beautiful restaurant and enjoy watching the chefs at work.
reviews.author: Rachel J.

reviews.text: Everything we had was absolutely fantastic! Service was incredible, Jay was amazing! Start to finish, so good!
reviews.author: Allie D.

reviews.text: Our server was amazing! The food is out of this world. Dessert was to die for. Melanie made our night. Incredible experience! Thank you!
reviews.author: Jodi S.

reviews.text: Yet another amazing meal. Lively ambiance, food was so good and Melanie was great server. She offered great suggestions and every one was on point.
reviews.author: Betsey C.

reviews.text: We have been several times and this was the best service we've had so far. Melanie was so attentive and took such good care of our table tonight. The food was everything we were hoping for. Several of us had the Giada's Trio for dinner and it did not disappoint. We had a table for 8 right in the center of everything and with perfect access to see the sunset on a beautiful evening.
reviews.author: Rebecca T.

reviews.text: The restaurant is absolutely stunning! I love the modern minimalist look but yet so cozy. The device was impeccable and my server recommended I order the lobster tail to pair with my pasta and it's was perfect. I loved the pasta so much and took my leftovers home which was still good reheated the next day. The lobster and shrimp were cooked perfectly and the pasta sauce on top was so good!! The focaccia bread was great because it was overly filling! Loved coming here and can't wait to come back soon!
reviews.author: Tabitha S.

reviews.text:
Visited Luna twice recently and both experiences were slightly different. 

One visit was a Tuesday evening which was chill, quiet and relaxing. You could actually hear each other in a conversation. While the next visit was a Friday which was busy and loud. 

Of the items we ordered, we liked the branzino and risotto the best. The citrus caesar was delicious. We also had the Lemon Spaghetti was good but as described, heavy on the lemon side and not my preference. 

The almond choclate cake was also delicious. 

The veranda upstairs has a pretty view! Must stop to check it out when there!
reviews.author: Nisha J.

reviews.text:
I wish I had taken photos!  I am not sure I understand the people complaining about price.  Check the menu before you go, it is a high end meal.  The service was excellent, and waitress was great!  Drinks were great, and had plenty of alcohol in them.

Started with the crab aracini, salad, lemon spaghetti with two extra shrimp, the pork chop, and tiramisu!  

The best meal I have had.  I cannot say enough, it was as excellent and we would definitely come back and will!
reviews.author: Valeri C.

reviews.text: This place was amazing. We'll be going back again for sure! The food was so delicious and our waitress was very friendly. The place was beautiful!
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Brandi was an excellent server!  food was amazing, and the experience was enhanced by the attentive staff. We'll be back!
reviews.author: Nancy S.

reviews.text: We love this restaurant and now our friends do, too. Elegant, fabulous food and wonderful service from Melanie.
reviews.author: MaryAnn M.

reviews.text:
First time here. Beautiful property . Restaurant was super busy. 
Greeted by Shereese with enthusiasm! 
I will say... she was the highlight of the entire dining experience. 
Started with cocktails.  For $21 a drink... I would have loved to taste some liquor.  Yes.. it was good... but not for the price.  3 sips.... All ice.  Done. 
Appetizers were okay. Came out very quickly so I know that they were all premade. Again... nothing special.  Presentation was very nice. 
Both couples ordered bottles of wine.  Actually the best part of the alcohol situation. 
Dinners were okay.  The lemon spaghetti with 2 small shrimp.  It's good... but for $38 it should have more protein.  The Risotto with 2 scallops... so lame.  Ordered 1 extra scallop... $20 a piece... that is such a joke. 
Dessert was wonderful. The cookies and tiramisu were incredible. 
Will I return? No.  Unless someone else is buying.  Too many incredible restaurants in the area to visit. 
Best part... visiting with my cousin.  Second best... our server.... She was wonderful. 
Food.... Meh... nothing special.
reviews.author: Sue S.

reviews.text:
I've been wanting to try this restaurant since it opened. Some friends asked if we wanted to go and I was excited to finally give it a try. What a disappointment.

I will say that the restaurant is quite beautiful, and it was very busy. It is located in the Caesars Republic hotel which is very modern and fancy. It has another restaurant on the 7th floor and a terrace on the 8th floor with a nice view of the city.

The food and drinks were mostly underwhelming and overpriced. I got the Bella Luna which was recommended by our server. $21 for a drink I could have made at home. The caprese salad was not bad but $23 for a tiny salad is not worth it. My husband enjoyed his acorn squash soup and son said the filet was good. The sausage pizza was something I could get at our local pizza shop. $30 for a small pizza like that is ridiculous. I was looking forward to trying the signature dish  lemon spaghetti but it came out cold and the shrimp was crunchy and undercooked. The nodi marini alla vodka also came out cold. $38 + $16 for chicken for a small dish like that is insane, and it really wasn't anything special. For dessert, the tiramisu was way too sweet and did not have an authentic taste.

I still can't believe we dropped so much on a bad meal and on top of that they charged a 3.5% service fee and added 23% gratuity to our bill. Our server was ok but nothing special and we were brought cold food. Not to mention they didn't even offer us the pepper.  Honestly, they are ripping people off at this restaurant. Seriously, up your game if you're going to charge people this much for food and drinks. I'm sad to say we were very disappointed by Giada's restaurant and we will not be returning it recommending it to anyone.
reviews.author: Reena R.

reviews.text: We had the pleasure of coming across this restaurant when visiting Arizona!! The staff was so friendly and inviting and the food was absolutely delicious!!! Our waiter Tucker & the Manager Michael went above and beyond for us and our little ones. Every single pizza we had was delicious! The lemon pizza and the lemon pasta were definitely my favorite! Great spot for a date night because the vibe and the ambiance was amazing!
reviews.author: Sara Y.

reviews.text: Quality of food. waitress Amanda was nice but learned more about her than the food. 4 of us ordered each something different & only one of us liked the food. II's like she tried to make something different (deconstructed) but the taste was just not there...soooo sad even our comped Giana's famous chocolate chip cookies were not good Not worth the money for sure
reviews.author: Ruth R.

reviews.text: What a great place! Food was great, the focaccia bread was amazing , lemon spaghetti wow is all I can say. Lobster, scallops shrimp were spot on. Service was great! The bar staff were great as well. Live music two nights in a row. Both were very good.
reviews.author: Sheila M.

reviews.text: We're visiting Arizona for my sons hockey tournament and we wanted Italian food after their game, quick Yelp search for top spot and Luna by Giada came up.. great choice for food , ambiance was incredible and food was amazing. Most important the staff , Logan the manager and tucker our waiter weee fantastic. Michael , the owner , personally thanked us for the visit!! Great quality , authentic Italian food. Their   pizza and pasta was unique and amazing. This is a must try place , every time I come back to Arizona I will for sure be back here .. thank you Michael and team for amazing experience for 12+ people !!
reviews.author: David B.

reviews.text: We had dinner here for Valentine's night and it did not disappoint. I've been lucky enough to eat at a few celebrity chef restaurants before, but this evening may have risen to the top! The food was absolutely incredible- I had the Agnolotti and can honestly say I've never eaten anything quite like it before. It was phenomenal!! It was a very busy evening obvi, but our server Kaitlyn made us feel like the only ones she was taking care of. I strongly recommend this place for a special night out!
reviews.author: Olin E.

reviews.text: Kaitlyn, our sever, was fantastic - super knowledgeable and friendly. The sausage pizza was wonderful!
reviews.author: Dion P.

reviews.text:
Delicious food, I didn't love the cheesecake dessert

Gilbert was incredibly attentive, excellent service.

Very good ambiance
reviews.author: Gloria M.

reviews.text: I grew up watching Giada, so I was eager for Luna. We waited an hour despite having reservations. The risotto and scallops were good, but the meal didn't shine. The oyster crudo was fresh, and tiramisu were decent; they  comped the dessert for our wait. Staff was kind, and the decor down to the lighting was beautiful. I'd skip dinner but might try lunch?
reviews.author: Abi L.

reviews.text:
Our service was amazing... Drinks were really great not a Gin girl but sister in law and husband order the Bella Luna and it was the best Gin drink,  I have had, first time ordering espresso martini was trying to be fancy and it was strong and I have nothing to compare it to so it was good my friend said it was ok... now on to the service and food- We are travelers... I was really impressed with our server it's been a while since I have had a waitress that knew how to suggest different items in a way that made me feel like I wanted to go out of my comfort zone. Sharice took pride in knowing the menu and expressed with such emotion that it felt like it was her family recipes. You could tell she not only enjoyed the food at Luna but also loved working there as the food was placed on the table she checked over to make sure everything was how Giada would want it and one wasn't she expressed apologies and fixed it before it was placed... we were all raving about her after, felt like nothing could knock her game!!! The ambiance we were in the main dining and it was nice lighting great chairs comfortable but a little loud, but felt like home with lots people in the kitchen so I loved it. There was 6 people with us and so I got to try a lot of the menu... Appetizers- starting with the focaccia don't pass on it amazing you won't be disappointed and the crab balls (not the name) we're good wish it had more crab and less risotto rice, husband ordered Oysters they were tasty cocktail sauce was once of a kind great flavor and balanced taste Arugula salad pancetta was crispy and flavors were popping love it, Caprese salad I am a burrata girl and this one had a more burrata type of Mozzarella so I was happy tomatoes weren't the best but all the flavors came together beautifully on this dish... oh make them use the biggest pepper grinder it's fun to watch it's bigger than half the waiters and waitress there... lol 
main dishes I order the pasta with Vodka sauce and added scallops per Sharice suggestion... tasted delightful together wish I would've gotten bigger scallops for the price but was prepared well.  and I also never had Branzino and since Sharice said you can't go wrong I ordered that as well to try. Man was I happy the size again not the biggest but the flavor made up for it... (ended up eating the Branzino and took the pasta home) others ordered the lemon spaghetti (sauce and shrimp was great and presentation beautiful) salmon (really good highly suggest and I'm from PNW) and crab pasta (had sweet flavor, and if that's your thing get it) my sister in law loved it, our friend ordered Risotto she loved it I am picky on Risotto and I would say it was good but not the best I have had. My husband not a lemon fan so per Sharice suggestion ordered the lemon spaghetti with scratch Alfredo instead add scallops and that sauce wow tasted amazing... desserts we had cookies, soufflé, cheesecake and "Tiramisu"... all tasted great presentation on soufflé was cool and the sauce on top yummy soufflé itself texture was sub par flavor made me take a second bite. My fav was the cheesecake and the tiramisu oh and ricotta cookie wow so you can't go wrong on the desserts!! Overall experience service was above expectation, any food that maybe wasn't the best we have had was overlooked because the service was so good!!! Sharice is a keeper and knows how to make you feel like a million bucks at a restaurant!!  Sorry no pictures of the food we dug right it!!!
reviews.author: Dominique J.

reviews.text:
Luna by Giada is a great choice if you're looking for an aesthetic spot in Scottsdale. 

Located inside a gorgeous new hotel, this place has all the vibes--chic décor, plenty of seating (both indoor & outdoor), and a menu that'll have you drooling. 

We weren't super hungry when we went, but we had to try the lemon pasta  and lemon pizza --both were absolutely delicious! The flavors were bright, fresh, and perfectly balanced. We also sipped on a mocktail  that was just as amazing! Oh, and shoutout to our server, who was seriously the best. 

The rest of the menu looked so good that we're already planning to come back with a bigger appetite.  If you're in Scottsdale and want a fun, stylish spot with great food, definitely check out Luna by Giada!
reviews.author: Michele G.

reviews.text: Every thing about this place is so beautiful from the decor to the presentation of the food and drinks   We came for happy hour and ended up eating our entire meal in the lounge area because the vibe and music were so happening. Service is on point and so friendly   We tried several different dishes and everything was so delicious. The pizza is outstanding and the pasta dishes shouldn't be missed  I loved the vegetarian bolognese.
reviews.author: Mary Ann P.

reviews.text: I'll separate service and food reviews. Food was ok. The Cesar salad was very good. The focaccia was also good. We had the chicken piccata and the lemon spaghetti. Both were ok. I've had way better piccata. The spaghetti noodles were good, but the lemon sauce was not as good as I was hoping. For the prices, the food was only average. The service was disappointing. Our server left us when we weren't quite ready to order. It was probably 15 minutes or so before she came back. I watched her on her phone for awhile. Also, individuals would walk by our table several times, looks at dirty plates and the wine menu, after we had wine, and then keep walking. More then once I had to ask people to take things. Finally, in very small print on the bottom of the menu, which is inline with other items so it blends in, is a notation of a 3.5% 'entrance to venue' fee. Beware of the charge. This is not Caesar's Casino Vegas, it's a hotel in Scottsdale. I had high hopes, I walked away very disappointed and over charged for the quality. I won't go back and I would not recommend it.
reviews.author: Scott M.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our first visit to Luna and were in great hands all evening.  Jay provided the highest level of service including descriptions of all our meals, recommended pairings and was attentive throughout.  The food was divine and we tried many new things like the lemon spaghetti and corn and sausage side.

We will be back!
reviews.author: PC R.

reviews.text: great food and great service.  Brandi was excellent and took great care of our group of 12.
reviews.author: Hunter A.

reviews.text: Our server Brandi was awesome!  Super friendly, great recommendations and amazing attention to detail.  Delicious food too!
reviews.author: Kim B.

reviews.text:
Service was marginal at best.   Received appetizers well before drinks.  They took care of the initial drinks but really?
Very loud atmosphere.
Caprese salad was excellent.  Oysters crudo was very good.
Pork chop saltimbocca was delicious.  Tasty.  Perfectly prepared.
Lemon pasta with shrimp was disappointing.  Pasta seemed very undercooked.  
3.5% venue admin fee tack on......
reviews.author: Larry D.

reviews.text: The food was such a cool experience. Shereese was an absolute gem and did such a good job at explaining all of the food items and what to get. would wait an hour plus in line for this food and definitely would come back!!
reviews.author: Michael M.

reviews.text: Lemon. Lemon. Lemon. If you love lemon, this is the place for you. Homemade pasta, authentic dishes. Dessert is a must. Service is impeccable. You will love it. If going with friends, appetizers and drinks galore is the way to go. Have fun!
reviews.author: Jill W.

reviews.text:
Let's start with the service, Amanda was super attentive, she is by far one of the best servers I have had the chance to interact with. Giada is very fortunate to have this young woman on her team.

The Lemmon spaghetti was great, tangy and creamy. We had this dish as the chef's special with Lobster, the butter sauce was amazing according to my party!  Luna ribeye was cooked to perfection, my husband was gloating about it. We had it as a special as well, the giant ravioli was good but the potatoes were great. Crab arancini was tasty and crunchy- sauce gave it the perfect balance. Fritto mixto was my favorite, again the sauce was perfect pairing. Now for the Desserts... chocolate soufflé- presentation was great, taste was yummy and warm. We added some gelato to it and that made it great! Ricotta cheesecake- the cookie on this was amazing, the texture was crunchy like it should be and the cheese has the perfect amount of ricotta so the texture of the cake isn't compromised. And lastly we also had the tiramisu- OMG the best we have had, perfect texture on all levels, perfect punches of flavors. 

Drinks were delicious, on the pricey side but expected in Scottsdale. We had the Isabella- was good amount of tequila, tart and semisweet and fico prugna - was on the sweeter side but didn't disappoint with its fig and thyme. 

The setting was warm, although it was an open concept you felt one with your party. The huge pepper shakers were a fun addition!
 
Only gripe was the venue admin fee, what was that about?
reviews.author: Edith C.

reviews.text: Seated right away and very comfortable setting. Our waitress- Melanie was outstanding. She was on point and when asked question about 2 different dishes she explained them both and help with making the decision. That right there is gold. I would recommend here over & over. Luna's wise choice on her. Food was delicious. From Lemon Pizza, Lemon Spaghetti sauce was to die for. Chicken Picatta & lemon sauce was so good. Brussels sprouts best ever tasted. Then dessert all sweet treats that anyone would want seconds on.  Well done Luna's .
reviews.author: Tanya S.

reviews.text: We arrived at Luna on time for our 7:15 pm reservation only to wait 45 minutes to be seated. We raised our concern a few times only to be met with "well, there are still people sitting at the table meant for you." Our out-of-town guests were frustrated by the lack of professionalism and consideration, as this was meant to be a special occasion dinner. Paul, the manager promised he would make it right. Our waitress, while nice, was incompetent. She rarely checked to see if we needed anything, and on a few occasions forgot our drinks leaving us waiting 30 minutes to get a refill. The arancini was great, the one appetizer we wanted. The others they brought as a "sorry for your trouble" were not average, at best. We ended up being charged for all of them. The entrees were brought out at various times, and my lemon pasta was cold and the sauce was watery. The cheesecake was gritty and flavorless. It's really sad to have this experience because I am a Giada fan, but this entire experience was a total let down at very high price. Don't waste your time and money. There a hundreds of excellent restaurants in Scottsdale. This restaurant needs to get it together - especially in a town known for hospitality, exceptional food, drinks and ambiance. Sadly, I would give them a fail all around. Giada should intervene.
reviews.author: Kristi C.

reviews.text: First class experience from start to finish.  The pasta was al dente, the steak was tender and perfectly cooked, and the bread and corn were favorites of ours. The bar staff were wonderful, attentive and personable. The employees were the icing on the cheesecake (which was also amazing). Paul was an amazing gm, came by to make sure we had everything we needed and to make sure we were satisfied. He was easy to talk to and was super helpful with recommendations.
reviews.author: Renee U.

reviews.text: This was our first time here and we were super excited to eat at chef Giada's restaurant to celebrate an anniversary.  The ambience was very nice and the service was excellent, but the items were way overpriced for what we ordered and got. $21 drink?  $32 small pizza?  Also my fiancé got extremely sick from the crab pasta dish...bad batch perhaps. Way too much lemon in everything!...even the cheesecake. The graham cracker crust tasted stale and lemony.
reviews.author: Michael D.

reviews.text: It was a nice experience. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Ordered the citrus salad which was excellent every bite was so flavorful. The scallop risotto was mediocre at best. The short rib Tripolini was delicious.
reviews.author: Dawn Y.

reviews.text:
We had the BEST experience at Luna by Giada. I truly think our server, Melanie was excellent. She was full of suggestions and made our night really fun! We shared so many items. Don't skip out on ordering the focaccia, caprese, Ceasar salad and the bacon wrapped dates! Wow! Perfect flavor and serving size. For dinners - two of us for the lemon pasta one added lobster and one subbed shrimp for Chicken. The presentation was incredible! We shared the lemon pizza and was so flavorful and YUM. OMG the desserts ...tiramisu was so good and the cheesecake! 

Ask for Melanie, she was the BEST!
reviews.author: Meghan P.

reviews.text: Food was delicious and Sarah K was more than helpful and delightful!!! We will be coming back.
reviews.author: Candace G.

reviews.text: I'm a big fan of Giada and I was very excited to go and celebrate my birthday at her restaurant. There were some disappointments, but I will say the ambience was really nice and the service for the most part was great. The one thing that was mind-boggling to me (related to service) was that the server removed my food to box it in a to go for me (great). Someone else brought out the food in a brown bag and placed it directly on the floor (really?). When you pay the prices at this restaurant do you really want your leftovers on the floor? I get it's in a bag but still directly on the floor for these prices.  I immediately picked up the bag and placed it on the table (I'm not a fan of placing food in a bag on a public floor). Our server brought over a freestanding hook and politely placed my bag on the hook (I noticed this stand was used by other guests to hang their purses). As for the food, steak was well done vs medium as requested. The staff was really nice and they did not charge for the meal but it was still disappointing. I ordered the pork chop and it was good. I will say overall the desserts were phenomenal and they did not disappoint .  The focaccia bread (wow) best I've ever had.  The enormous red pepper grinder gave us a chuckle.  Again let me just add that the staff did make up for our experience and accepted our feedback/observations so I thank them for this. As a local, I have mixed feelings on if I will return again maybe after they have been opened a bit longer.
reviews.author: M D.

reviews.text:
Wow, wow, wow. Luna was everything I was hoping it to be, plus more. It's a beautiful restaurant inside the hotel. Definitely make a reservation because they fill up.
Service was incredible. Our water glasses never got below halfway before they were refilled. Everyone was so attentive. Our main server was excellent! I had questions about everything and he was super informative and so helpful.  
Now the food... Amazing! The Caesar salad was light with a little bit of citrus flavor. The pastas were perfectly cooked and tasted amazing. You have to get the lemon spaghetti!  As for dessert, we asked what they recommended. They suggested the cheesecake and it did not disappoint. It was light for a cheesecake and so delicious. 
Oh really good cocktails and great wine selection as well. Can't wait to go back and try their Aperitivo hour.
reviews.author: Adrianna S.

reviews.text:
We visit the Phoenix/Scottsdale area once a month so we've been meaning to visit this place. My wife is big on famous chef's and we make it a point to visit our favorite chef's restaurants to see if they live up to the hype as well as supporting their business. 

The restaurant is located inside of the Ceasars Republic hotel near the fashion square mall. The ambiance is very posh with a lot of patrons dressed up as well as casual. Before we opened the door, we got the vibe of sophistication and style by walking past a Ferrari parked on the sidewalk. One of many exotic rides in the small parking lot where we utilized the valet option. 

We made reservations and found ourselves waiting an extra 10-25 minutes to be seated along with a few other couples with the same problem. We were all patient and just enjoyed the sleek and modern scenery while others killed time at the bar feet away. The hosts were nice and professional. We couldn't help but notice the tiny black dresses/skirts that most of the young women were wearing, to no complaints to anyone present.  Once it was ready, the host/manager Kenny walked us to our table while giving us a rundown of the hotel and other attractions that it holds. Kenny also gave us the rundown on the open kitchen and the history of the building and restaurant. He was very professional and a great introduction to the experience. Kinda reminded me of cousin Richie from the bear show, super chill yet on top of his game. We checked out the menu and knew we had plenty of options to choose from. Always a good sign when you don't have to force a choice with uncertainty.  

We got a half dozen oysters, fried calamari and shrimp with an order of facoccia bread. All were fresh and tasty. The shrimp outshined calamari but that's the only thing I'd mention. For entrees, I got the branzino that came with endives and celery puree. It was magical with the perfect skin texture. My love interest ordered the Filet, medium rare that comes with a quail egg and she added a few scallops to go with it. The Filet was ideal and the scallops were just as good, coming from somebody that helped myself to 2 of the 4 lol. 

For dessert, we got the souffle with hazelnut topping and the lemon cheesecake. The cheesecake hit the spot while the souffle was a mind trick where it looked like a cake yet tasted like scrambled eggs. I won't take any points away because, that's pretty normal for souffle and I can't blame anybody but us for expecting different. The hazelnut sauce was good enough to break even in taste. 

Everything about the food lived up to our high expectations and the service was second to none. Our waitress Natalie was very attentive and friendly. She never made us feel that she was in a rush but she was still zooming around handling her rounds along with everybody working here. The system they have in this business is flawless and efficient. I even have to add that the entire restaurant was FULL of beautiful people. From the waitresses,hosts, servers etc. You'd think there was a strict policy and screening in order to work here where no exceptions are made lol. All in all, I really like this place and you won't even break the bank eating here. I'd come every month if there weren't other restaurants owned byfood network celebs in town, but I'll definitely be back! The game ball goes to Natalie, Kenny and the youngster Juan for the best customer service!!
reviews.author: Thomas R.

reviews.text: Good ambiance and great service. The signature lemon spaghetti is great. Food is overpriced for the amount you're getting.
reviews.author: Sake C.

reviews.text: Overpromised and underdelivered. While the Sicilian Focaccia was good, it may have been the highlight of the night. I ordered the Lobster Bucatini and Nodi Marini Alla Vodka. Both tasted overcooked, not al dente. For the price, I expected the pasta to be a bit better cooked. The tiramisu dessert was a bit too heavy with chocolate taste overtaking the dish, no taste of the actual espresso. Hopefully, the al dente issue gets fixed. The atmosphere was nice for a good night out.
reviews.author: Francesca M.

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved the rooms, drinks, bar, atmosphere and food! We went to eat on Christmas and it was truly a beautiful night. We sat in a "star" room and we absolutely loved it.

Service was not our favorite. (Only thing lacking) If you work in a high end restaurant, in Scottsdale, on Christmas we are going to tip well you above the average 20%. We asked the server what he recommends and he said he was "hurting himself" by telling us the cheaper option. There were a ton of little comments regarding tips and we get it (it's Christmas, but we're also just here for a good time). So he forgot our utensils, my drink and double charged us for an appetizer but the manager gave us a free dessert so that was great  The busser was phenomenal and took care of us! He is 5 stars alone. 

You have to come try out all the amazing appetizers, food, and dessert! We sat at the bar and grabbed a few drinks after and the service was phenomenal. We will be back and request dinner at the bar :) 

Thanks for an amazing Christmas!
reviews.author: Vanessa M.

reviews.text: Melanie was amazing! Warm, welcoming, and made sure we had a great time as a family. We will be back!
reviews.author: Alexa P.

reviews.text: Melanie was the BEST! We had an incredible experience at dinner tonight and will be coming back.
reviews.author: Grace V.

reviews.text: I will say that when the food finally came out, it was good but the entire experience was trash. Service was so terrible and slow. I have never seen such terrible service. GIADA should be ashamed and embarrassed to have her name on this establishment. Never again.
reviews.author: Santino N.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic time with friends at Luna by Giada!
There were six of us girls and from the time we had our cocktail at the bar (Sanata, very delicious) to the dinning room with our Amazing waitress Amanda, we had a fun and memorable time!  The scallops and ressoto were fabulous!  We had a few starters that didn't disappoint, just delicious. Desserts were just as amazing.  This whole experience was captivating and having an excellent server like Amanda made our experience top notch!
The managing staff were top notch too!  Overall, excellent experience for the end of our 2024 year.
reviews.author: Rebecca O.

reviews.text: We had the pleasure of meeting "Amanda" our amazing waitress who was the best EVER! The food and desserts were out of this world, but the level of "care" and "great service" was comparable to none. She was kind, energetic beyond expectations, attentive, accommodating and truly gave our group a memory of a lifetime that we won't forget. THANK YOU, AMANDA, keep on shining and may God bless you in all of your interactions with all of the people that come through this wonderful restaurant! THANK YOU!
reviews.author: Info S.

reviews.text: Top notch everything. Our server, Jay, was great! All the food was fantastic for our birthday celebration for my mom's 81st birthday. They did their best to accommodate our desire for a quieter table which was also nice.
reviews.author: Amanda D.

reviews.text: Food was great, especially love the lemon shrimp, pasta, and the focaccia bread. The service was unbelievable.  Great ambience too. I highly recommend.
reviews.author: Melanie P.

reviews.text: Jay was awesome. His recommendations were on point! I appreciate that he voided things out for us and advised on the best experience!
reviews.author: Tracy D.

reviews.text: Tried the Crabmeat Aracini this time.   It was so good and the seasonal soup with apples was excellent!   Shari'ce our server was great and very attentive!   We sat outside this time on the patio with the holiday lights and the weather was perfect that night.
reviews.author: Susan P.

reviews.text: We went for the Sunday brunch and were not disappointed!  Rather than having dozens and dozens of mediocre selections,  there was a more limited but superbly curated range of choices.   Huge tiger shrimp,  lovely small and very tasty oysters along with crab claws and smoked salmon with perfect condiments made for a beautiful seafood display.   Tender beef sirloin roast and delicious roast salmon were on offer at the carving table.  Omelets and waffles were made to order.  Salads were beautifully composed and at the peak of freshness.   Hot entrée items were constantly refreshed.   The service is meticulous with plates and used silverware whisked away and replaced.   Beverages were refilled and our needs were very well met.  Worth every penny!
reviews.author: Brian B.

reviews.text: Heard a lot of things about this restaurant. Beautiful restaurant and open kitchen was amazing. The food was fair and it took way too long to get served. Server was responsive and kept apologizing for the slow service
reviews.author: mike d.

reviews.text:
This place was some of the best Italian I have ever had! 

Our server was amazing she was so attentive and made sure that my meal was as dairy free as possible. She was one of the best servers I have ever had and I believe her name is Amanda? 

Everything was jammed pack full of flavor. I had the rigatoni pasta and the citrus Caesar salad. The hint of citrus in their food was the perfect balance of acid and tang. The Caesar salad was the best at this balance. 

For my pasta I ordered scallops and they were so tender and cooked perfectly and went great with the rigatoni. 

The restaurant was a bit loud so hard to have conversations across our large table. However the decor and design of the restaurant was very modern and pretty. 

Needless to say we rolled out of there as we were so full. I can't wait to go back and try more dishes!
reviews.author: Cameo L.

reviews.text:
We loved our Christmas dinner at Luna as always the lemon spaghetti and scallop risotto were fabulous but the best thing was our waiter Jay who was beyond wonderful ! He was perfectly attentive and upbeat and made our evening more fun ! 
We will be back :)
reviews.author: Susanne D.

reviews.text: Beautiful spot, great bar setup. Seven upstairs had beautiful views but I ended up scooting back to the lobby bar as there were more people there at 5:30 in a Friday. The grapefruit juice was so fresh! I ordered the Oyster Crudo and Signature Lemon Spaghetti, subbed scallops for shrimp. So delish and no upcharge which was delightful.  Just decadent, and the crispy capers, the best part!  My bartenders Lexy and Dava were lovely, attentive and so sweet. Everyone was truly great!
reviews.author: Elicia N.

reviews.text:
Hands down, so impressed. This restaurant was better than I could've imagined. 

I HIGHLY recommend doing family style and just sharing a bunch of appetizers as well as entrees with your fam. The food is heavenly and you just wouldn't expect such interesting pairings, but they work. 

What we tried & loved:
Brussel sprouts, focaccia, branzino, lemon spaghetti, chicken piccata, and gelato!

Service was amazing. We made reservations ahead of time because this was a surprise for my mum's birthday. I really enjoyed how classy all of the staff would treat us and how nice the inside of the restaurant was. I only wish I came during a time that Giada was actually visiting (lol)!
reviews.author: Nicole B.

reviews.text:
For my 65th birthday on Christmas Day, I decided to shake things up. After two years of excellent celebrations at Mastro's, I was excited to try Giada De Laurentiis's latest venture, Luna by Giada in Scottsdale. Unfortunately, the experience fell short of expectations in almost every way. We arrived at 7PM, valet parking our car to avoid being late. Valet charges were $12 for restaurant guests or $40 for hotel guests. My valet experience at the end of the evening added another layer of frustration--but more on that later. 

The hotel housing Luna is undeniably impressive, with its striking architecture and luxurious proximity to Scottsdale Fashion Square. My family and I had fasted all day, eager for a memorable meal. After checking in, we were told there would be a 10-minute wait and that we'd be texted when our table was ready. We headed to the bar and ordered three cocktails while waiting ($75 with tip). From my vantage point to the restaurant, I noticed a large, empty eight-seat table, presumably reserved. We asked the bartender about the menu options and she recommended several items that sounded delicious. Her favorite was the Tripolini. She also mentioned the Lemon Pizza, Rigatoni, and the Petite Filet. 

I received a text message at 7:26 that our table was ready. A very nice young lady walked us into the restaurant and as we passed the wine wall she stopped to give us a very tacky tour of the entrance to the restaurant, she told us how many wine bottles they had on the wine wall and then she turned to the opposite wall, which was adorned with Giada Merchandise our hostess indicated we could order these items online. She stopped us again to talk about the pizza oven and how hot it gets and then she sat us down at the same empty table that I saw from the bar when we arrived at 7PM. Now I'm being seated 31 minutes late, I've been given a tour I didn't want, Giada's team tried to sell me pasta on a shelf, which in retrospect I should have bought and gone home and cooked for everybody, it would have been better than what we ordered.

So now I'm hangry and irritated on my birthday. Our waitress came to the table at 7:47 and offered us either sparkling water or bottled still water, no option for tap water. We chose still water (I did not know it was $10 a bottle). At 8:00 she took our wine and food order. This is a full hour past our reservation!!! 

We ordered for the table 2 Sicilian Focaccia with lemon-mascarpone butter, basil pesto and olive oil. This was the best thing on the menu and I highly recommend you lather this in the lemon butter it's delicious. I also ordered the lemon pizza for the table and as Dave Portnoy would say, it's a 5.2. 

We also ordered the Crab Arancini and were told there were five per order, when they brought it out there were only 4 on the plate, my daughter pointed out there was suppose to be five so they took the plate back to the kitchen and returned with five. Everyone seemed to like this dish as well but one of the Arancini was cold, I believe it was the one they added to the plate because it was the only one with no parmesan shavings on it. 

Three of us ordered the signature dish, Lemon Spaghetti with sauteed shrimp, mascarpone cheese, basil and crispy capers ($39), It was luke warm and the jumbo shrimp was overcooked on all three orders. I ordered the Caesar salad and there was way too much parmesan cheese on it, very dry. My son-in-law ordered the Agnolotti ($41) and my daughter ordered the Bucatini Alla Nerano  ($38) these were similarly underwhelming. Protein add-ons came with excessive surcharges of $9 to $20 and market price for lobster--making the already high prices feel even more unreasonable. I have not been to Olive Garden for 30 years but the food was very similar in quality and there were no unlimited salad and breadsticks. Our waitress frequently calling me "friend" and addressing my wife and daughters as "My Lady" or "My Ladies." Her enthusiasm felt misplaced and disconnected from the upscale ambiance Luna aspires to achieve. We joked that her former employer was possibly Medieval Times. With three drinks, one bottle of wine and a tip, the bill exceeded $700--steep for what felt like a glorified chain restaurant experience. The manager came to our table near the end of our meal and asked if everything was ok and I didn't want to make a bad evening any worse so I kept my mouth shut.

Lastly, the valet. Upon retrieving my car, I was told the fee was $26, despite the posted $12 rate for Luna guests. When I pointed this out, the valet conceded, saying, "Oh yeah, $12 plus a tip." This blatant attempt to overcharge ended the evening on a sour note. Giada should stick to the food network not restaurants!

Overall, Luna by Giada was a massive letdown. Between the lackluster food, overpriced menu, subpar service, and money hungry valet, this was a birthday dinner to forget. With so many incredible dining options nearby (Maple and Ash), I recommend skipping Luna.
reviews.author: Daniel H.

reviews.text: We had a great Christmas dinner! We ordered crab arancini, bread and bacon wrapped dates! Jay did an excellent job giving us great recommendations and great service! We had the lemon pasta, pizza, rigatoni, and nodi pasta! All were very good would recommend for a nice date night or group dinner.
reviews.author: Nathaniel E.

reviews.text: Dinner was absolutely outstanding. We came on Christmas Eve for the Feast of the Seven Fishes and it was incredible. The service was wonderful and our server Caitlyn was very sweet and attentive.
reviews.author: Jenn B.

reviews.text: Teresa was awesome! We had a wonderful experience here thanks to her. She was very knowledgeable about the menu, friendly, and patient with my very loud group.
reviews.author: Daniel H.

reviews.text:
Jay was an awesome server!!
Our food was delicious and delivered in a timely manner. Our table was conducive for great conversation with six people. Always look forward to a delicious Giada dinner!
reviews.author: Debra S.

reviews.text: Great service , great food and great ambiance! We will definitely come back! I love Giada and support her any way I can!
reviews.author: Sally R.

reviews.text: The food was not that good and it was expensive. The food is better at Oregano's for 1/4 the cost. The obnoxious was decent and the service was great though. Im picky with fine dining and would have rather gone to Ocean 44 for excellent food, service and way boujee for the same price.
reviews.author: Ricky O.

reviews.text: Kaitlyn was amazing! Food was delicious and she took such great care of our family on a special occasion. 10/10
reviews.author: Isabella J.

reviews.text: Wow. This place is a 10/10. The food, ambiance and service is insane. We come from out of town and Luna by Giada is our first stop for dinner when we arrive in Scottsdale. Jay and Brody were so engaging and friendly! They were icing on the cake. I hesitate to rave too much because I'm afraid I won't be able to get a reservation next time! Well done.
reviews.author: Marijka S.

reviews.text: Great experience! After drinks at the horribly run Seven just upstairs in this Caesar's hotel, I had low expectations for Luna. Yes, I know they are managed completely separately, but still housed in the same established. Our patio table was comfortable with heaters, with perfect lighting creating lovely ambiance overlooking the gigantic Xmas tree. Our young server was friendly and efficient and helpful as we pondered the menu. She cheerfully brought us wine tasters in the cutest miniature glassware. I was delighted to see the wine list include several good choices of Italian at reasonable high end prices ($16/glass, which has become the new normal). I chose Greco di Tufo. My lemon spaghetti was DELICIOSO! Piled high in that swirl I can't seem to replicate at home, piping hot and lemony salty cheesy al dente. YUM!!! Came with two perfect jumbo prawns. Pricey at $39 but well worth it. I'll be back soon.
reviews.author: Brenda B.

reviews.text: Jay was an excellence server!  His personality  was up beat and his knowledge of the menu was very helpful.
reviews.author: Julia S.

reviews.text: It was an important night to me and our server Jay made it even more special. Huge thank you to him. The food was fantastic and drinks just as great!
reviews.author: Sam W.

reviews.text: The restaurant gets a 4 but the server a 5! Restaurant is beautiful, a little noisy, but the overall atmosphere is great. Like being in Las Vegas as a nice hotel restaurant but you are actually in Arizona. There are many food and beverage choices and lots of lemon dishes. The main reason for the four stars is that it took over an hr from being seated to being given entrees. The kitchen got quite backed up after some cooking staff were sent home. Our server did apologize and made sure we were well taken care off. The lemon spaghetti was quite interesting but not piping hot. The shrimp was well cooked. The pizza on the other hand was quite warm and fresh out of the oven. And the tiramisu was a perfect way to end the night! Would highly recommend this place and am definitely open to returning for a nice celebration for locals or visitors!
reviews.author: Mel Y.

reviews.text:
I'm so lazy this is my first review, I just really wanted to give credit where credit is due. We had the absolute BEST server MELANIE at Luna tonight 12/12/24. Melanie was just the right amount of attentive and just a genuine sweet person. The drinks, wine, and food was as expected from a brand like Giada. However we had the special and I was pleasantly shocked by how perfectly the steak was cooked, I mean it just melted in your mouth like butta. 
Lastly this is the perfect setting for a romantic date with your special person. Thank you Giada and Luna staff for the perfect night!
reviews.author: Amie G.

reviews.text: We had the most lovely experience.  Ask for Ziggy, he's so knowledgeable and kind.  He really made our evening :)
reviews.author: Molly B.

reviews.text:
I have never experienced service like I have at Luna. After reserving a spot for two- from the hostess tour, to the knowledge of the food runners, down to the impeccable service of Sarah P, I am confident that this is the most remarkable place in Arizona. The General Manager introduced himself and thanked us for coming in - was a very comforting gesture. The food is remarkable- waitress recommended the specialized lemon spaghetti and it did not disappoint. The almond cake was rich in flavor and the perfect pairing for our espresso martinis. Thank you for hosting us and making our night unforgettable. 

Once again, thank you Sarah P for all your suggestions and fabulous service. Well done!
reviews.author: Presley G.

reviews.text: First time dining here and will definitely be back. Atmosphere and food was amazing. Jay was very attentive and helped us make the best selections for our tastes. We had the focaccia bread, signature spaghetti, brussels sprouts and gelato. Everything was wonderful but the spaghetti was the stand
reviews.author: Gabrielle V.

reviews.text: We celebrated my wife's birthday. Everything was exceptional. The service, restaurant decor and the food was outstanding. Our hostess made sure we were well taken care of. I had the lemon pasta with scallops added on. My wife had the risotto and scallops. Both excellent dishes. I would recommend Luna for any occasion.  You will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Jimmy V.

reviews.text:
I have always been a fan of Giada's, dating back to when she first started on the Food Network.  I've made her pasta dishes and have always loved how she incorporated lemon in many of her dishes.  
I've been to her restaurant in Las Vegas and loved the food there, but her Scottsdale location tops it.  It was so fresh and delicious.  My top favorites were the caprese salad and crab arancini.  Probably the best caprese salad I've ever had and I'm Italian and very picky about caprese.  Again, the notes of lemon made this so fresh and delicious.  All of it was delicious!  My husband loved his dish and the lemon pasta with lobster and shrimp was so tasty.  We even had the tiramisu on top of the anniversary dessert they gave us, and it was the most unique, yet delicious, tiramisu we've ever had.  My husband isn't the biggest dessert eater and he kept commenting how good it was....and he ate the whole thing.  We will definitely be back!  They had a beautiful room for private dining and I may just do a future birthday party there.
reviews.author: Happy Y.

reviews.text: Great restaurant, atmosphere and service was amazing.  The food was so good especially dessert.  Jay was our server and he was very attentive and friendly..
reviews.author: Kathy S.

reviews.text:
Absolutely amazing service and the food was incredible. Our server Brandy was super kind and very attentive.

We will definitely be coming again
reviews.author: Kolbu K.

reviews.text: Valet was overwhelmed and did not inform me I would receive a text to get my car.  Valet was not busy at that time so should have been easy.  Restaurant is beautiful and comfortable.  Big! Server was too effusive and descriptive.  Server talked over us on wine choice.  Cocktails, appetizers, entrees were extremely slow coming out. Yes, we wanted to have an experience but not 3.5 hours.  We waited an hour between appetizers and entrees!! All of our food was terrific, hot, and delicious! Lemon spaghetti is a must! Server inattentive to our needs. Food presentation was very well done.
reviews.author: Debbie E.

reviews.text: Totally awesome!! Amazing service. Incredible food! Camus world!! #Lynette #Amanda  #Rossi #Melonie
reviews.author: Kraig Q.

reviews.text: The service was amazing thanks to Melanie, Lynette, Brandi, Rossi and Jose were amazing
reviews.author: Rita B.

reviews.text:
Food was great & Kendall provided terrific customer service!
We were visiting from California and this was our best meal in n Scottsdale. I will definitely recommend to anyone that I hear is traveling to Scottsdale.
Thank you, Kendall for the great service!
reviews.author: Lori G.

reviews.text:
Luna is one of the sought after restaurant in Scottsdale. We finally got the reservation during Thanksgiving weekend so we had very high expectations. Luna is located inside newly opened Caesars Republic Hotel by the Fashion Square Mall in Scottsdale.

Ambiance is good and it's quiet a large restaurant with various seating arrangement as well as private dining area for business meeting or private parties. The only negative was acoustics inside the restaurant because it was hard to hear others on your own table. Hope they fix it. 

Our server was excellent and explained everything from special of the day to what's popular as well as any allergy in our group. We ordered drinks including NA beer, Martini's and cocktail and it was excellent. 

Starter as showed in the photos included soup, Crab Arancini and Lemon Pizza. It was yummy. 

We ordered famous lemon spaghetti, Chicken Panznell, Pan Seared Salmon and Mezzi Rigatoni as our main entrees. It was outstanding.

For desert we had Tiramisu, Cake and Cappuccino. Again, excellent recommendation by our server. 

Presentation and service exceeded our expectations. Price wise it's very expensive but worth it. Overall, we had an excellent experience at Luna.
reviews.author: Abhay K.

reviews.text: I was really excited to stay at the new Caesars Republic hotel in Scottsdale. And, we enjoyed our dinner at Luna! The minute I arrived, the two female hosts were very friendly and accommodating to me and our two doggies Tony and Teddy!. And yes, the food was delicious. A fried chicken piccata with piccata sauce on the side to drizzle onto it was so good! But, what really made the experience more significant was our server, Michael. He was attentive, accommodating, friendly, kind, and professional! I've been in the service business for several decades. And it's this kind of service, atmosphere, and food that brings people back!
reviews.author: Louis A.

reviews.text:
Service: rushed, transactional, inattentive.
Food: nothing spectacular considering the prices, 39$ for a spaghetti dish is wild idc if there are 2 shrimp on the plate. Shrimp is cheap. 

Water glasses look cool, but no way of seeing where the water level is at for the server or assistant to know to refill water. Didn't really think that through. 

Also there is a "venue fee" on the check 3.5% of the bill. Basically scamming you. We have to help with overhead costs? You get that from the over priced mid food. 

Had to wait for my check, the number one worst complaint from diners whilst going out to eat at a restaurant. 

Wouldn't go back.
reviews.author: Emrah B.

reviews.text: Amazing dinner. We came for Thanksgiving and it was such a great menu. Great service too!  Thank you Jay!  Can't wait to come again.
reviews.author: Noelle W.

reviews.text: We had Shareese, Kaitlyn, and Jose take care of us tonight and were having trouble describing what an incredible experience we had. The food was beyond expectations but the attention to detail and kindness and engagement from every single staff member really pushed the experience over the top. We definitely monopolized our servers because we loved talking to them so much. Their recommendations were all spot on and we adored every single dish and drink we had. By the end we were making plans to visit our waitress in two days for apertivos. Don't be intimidated by the celebrity chef status- the food is comforting and familiar but of the highest quality. Highly recommend for anyone looking to have an amazing night. A beautiful restaurant and environment- makes you feel right at home.
reviews.author: Casey K.

reviews.text: My girlfriend and I came here, and we thought Kaitlyn was the most amazing and kind waitress!! Loved the food!
reviews.author: Noah R.

reviews.text: This is the second time we go. First was so so but it had only been opened for a month. We wanted to give a second chance. We'll disappointed again. I ordered the Branzino it was dry and almost like a jerkey!  We orders the signature dish the lemon spaghetti it was a lot of lemon the sauce was like water and no flavor but the lemon. Now for the price. I ordered a martini and the charge for the olives! This does not make sense. We have been to Giada in Vegas and always enjoyed it. Thanks to the manager for trying to make it better, This was a total disappointment and will jot be returning.
reviews.author: Hugo H.

reviews.text: Shereese was amazing.  Our first time at Luna's was perfect and the food was delicious!  Shereese made us feel very welcomed.  We will be back soon.
reviews.author: Elaine W.

reviews.text: Jay was a great server & amazing food! The lemon pizza and lemon pasta were to die for.
reviews.author: Lexi A.

reviews.text: Wow! Thank you Giada for bringing a delicious restaurant to Scottsdale Arizona. The restaurant was stunning from entrance to table setting to food presentation to delicious taste.  Jay our server was knowledgeable and friendly, offering suggestions and all were spot on! We will be back soon
reviews.author: Deana B.

reviews.text: service and ambiance was fantastic. the signature lemon pasta was fantastic! our friend had the chicken piccata and he said it lacked flavor. the soup was good but not served hot and the portion was extremely small, probably less than 1/2 cup. the chocolate soufflé was fantastic and the focaccia was the best i have ever had. one warning - when we received the check a 3.5% venue/admin fee was added to the bill. when we asked about it we were told the hotel charges a resort fee. i have only seen this if you actually stay at a resort and are charged that at check-in. we were then told upon request they will remove it and they did. i wonder how many people have paid that and never knew it could be removed. i would definitely go back and try the other dishes.
reviews.author: Anne O.

reviews.text: Great food and service. Jay was an amazing server, made great recommendations. Jay's impeccable service made for a perfect evening.
reviews.author: Donna L.

reviews.text: The food is always great and our server Jay was fantastic. He understood the menu very well and helped us narrow down our decisions. This was my second visit to Luna and I'm sure I'll be back again.
reviews.author: Tristan M.

reviews.text: Great experience, the Jade room is where it's at if you're looking for a less noisy ambience. The food was delicious , Thank you to our waiter Jay for the great service.
reviews.author: Miles D.

reviews.text: This meal was wonderful. I'm a huge fan of lemon so I was particularly excited for the lemon spaghetti but to be honest the agnolotti my friend ordered was even better although I still loved my meal. It normally comes with shrimp but I don't like shrimp, so our server Brandi was kind enough to swap them out for scallops and it was perfection. I'd also selected a second dish for my husband to get (food tax for me of course) and she helped steer us to a better option. If we weren't running a race the next day we would've totally gotten some wine or cocktails; the list looked awesome but alas being responsible prior to running (before you get on me about the vast amount of food we consumed though, hello carb loading!). We also got the focaccia to split and the lemon pizza and omg both were so good. I have extra lemon pizza leftovers for late night snacking or morning munchies. The lemon marscapone side was my favorite with the focaccia. Luna by Giada is also in great location, nestled inside the Caesars Republic. While we were waiting for our table we took a ton of very dorky photos outside with all the beautiful Christmas lights and decorations.
