Since Brandi knew we were planning to split the pizza amongst four people she specifically let us know to keep our bread plates to the right of our knives to avoid having them taken away. She also asked the kitchen to double cut the pizza so they'd be extra thin slices which was great. Thank you, Brandi, for taking great care of us!
reviews.author: Xixi H.

reviews.text: Jay was a great server, and very attentive and quick to answer any questions about the menu.
reviews.author: Bernardo B.

reviews.text: Delicious food. Great ambience. Fantastic cocktails. highly recommend. Sarah K and Paul are remarkable highly recommended. lemon ricotta marscapone cheesecake made me wish to have that first. Rich and decadent.
reviews.author: Kimberley S.

reviews.text: Our server, Jay, was so helpful wi the menu and had the most contagious upbeat personality. loved the food and atmosphere. It was fun to get dressed up to go to a bea restaurant. Foccacia bread, burrata salad, lemon pasta & chicken piccata were excellent!
reviews.author: Theresa H.

reviews.text: Melanie was amazing.  She made stellar recommendations on the menu - including the cocktail that tastes like a caprese salad.   Definitely ask for her to be your server and also for a table with a view of the kitchen.
reviews.author: Andrea C.

reviews.text: This was our first visit to Luna! We absolutely loved our servers, Jay and Isiah! They were friendly and professional! The Lemon Spaghetti wnd the Bacon wrapped dates were amazing and the service was even better! We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Kristy W.

reviews.text: It was a Birthday, and everyone made it a special occasion for my wife. We shared a Caesar salad, amazing with the delicious warm bread, the meals, my wife ordered the salmon, and I had the pizza. The service was amazing, Teresa was perfect. The restaurant is beautiful, not easy on the C.C..
reviews.author: denny b.

reviews.text: We had Sarah K as our server and she was amazing - we are on vacation and stopped in, she gave a great wine recommendation and the food was delicious. We got the lemon pasta  with gluten free noodles and the risotto (Sarah gave the recommendation of adding crab which was so great in the dish) Definitely one of the best dinner experiences we've had here in Scottsdale !! We will be back for sure !!
reviews.author: Kalli W.

reviews.text: Luna by Giada was a magnificent experience that I shared with my 19th anniversary with my husband. Melanie provided us with exceptional top-notch service and I recommend that you ask for her. we will be returning again to dine at Luna by Giada.
reviews.author: Sl H.

reviews.text: The service and staff were exceptional! They definitely go out of their way and provide amazing service! The fried calamari and shrimp were delicious. The drinks were OK, but I really expected the main courses to be more flavorful. The pasta was tasteless, the lemon potatoes were really good and the chicken piccata was missing flavor as well. Overall, the staff and service made it very enjoyable.
reviews.author: Jennifer R.

reviews.text: Came out for my bday dinner with my sisters and had an absolute wonderful time. Jay took care of us. He was very thorough and profesh with the menu. Non of us had ever been here before so as a first timer we had an absolute great time. Thank you Jay  will definitely be back! The arancini's were delicious. Highly recommend the Branzino, salmon and the scallop risotto were fire.
reviews.author: Farifteh A.

reviews.text: food was amazing, Jay (waiter) was amazing! patio was beautiful- thank you for the amazing experience! Order the lemon spaghetti- it's great!!

reviews.text:
I recently dined at this new hotel restaurant in downtown Scottsdale and was shocked at the prices they charge for very basic dishes. $50 bucks for a basic pasta with vodka sauce with a bit of chopped sausage.  While the food was ok not stellar, paying nearly $50 for a bowl of pasta with a basic vodka sauce was excessive. 
The Caprese salad was also a disappointment--puréed buffalo mozzarella with smallish cherry tomatoes only a couple of pieces of basil, the calamari was soggy....both for$28 each. Way overpriced for what we received.  ,The food overall was ok but was over-salted, and definitely unimpressive and very much overpriced.  Nothing worse than feeling Im being ripped off.

The menu was quite limited, and despite the upscale decor, it felt like they were charging 3 times what a typical restaurant would for similar offerings. Adding insult to injury, valet parking cost $12 in a small parking lot, and it seemed many patrons didn't tip, given the likely low wages for the valet staff. After spending $350 on four bowls of pasta, a couple of diet sodas,  2 apetizers  and one cocktail, plus a $20 valet bill, it was clear that this place is overrated, overpriced, and under-delivers.

In summary, we wont be going back to Luna. Way way over priced for what they deliver.    For the price they're charging, there should at least be white tablecloths and linen. Also,  dont add insult to injury.  Have a valet...but for the love of god don't rip customers off further by charging them $12 and not giving it to the guys running the valet.  Really left feeling underwhelmed, ripped off then seeing the valet charge an additional $12 that was going to the restaurant and not the guys working the door really irked me.  take care of the little guys in your organization and dont rip clients off.  Pomo would have been a better meal at 1/3 the price.  Parking is free too!!  Pass on this hoyty toyty way over priced place

I see Jennifer the manager responding to some reviews with typical canned responses...Hey Jen...Lower your prices, the experience isnt nearly worth what you charge.   improve the quality.....also...put a free valet out front and let us take care of the guys parking the cars the $12 you charge doesnt go to them and many won't tip them because the $12 is usually viewed as excessive and unfortunately goes to  your greedy ownership.  
Almost $45 for a past with a red sauce....goodness check out prices here..charge a premium but dont be overly greedy.

reviews.text: Fantastic customer service and food was terrific. Started off a bit rocky, sat us down and had a mishap with not assigning our table a server. We waited  too long, no two ways about it. reviews.text:
This restaurant has been on my list for awhile after going to her establishment in Vegas on the strip! So when I found out they were opening another restaurant in Scottsdale I was excited! As I knew this newish restaurant would be popular I booked a seat for four several month in advance with my preferences! 

The restaurant is located within a hotel near the Scottsdale mall perimeter. It's a little hidden but any map app will direct you to the restaurant. The hotel restaurant has valet parking but a covered lot across the way exists too. Self parking is free and very convenient.

The restaurant opens at 5pm. We booked our seating for 6pm so part of our party enjoyed cocktails at the super modern bar upon entrance. As we just got in for reservations, we checked in with desk outside of restaurant. The check in process was a bit awkward as we had to wait for about ten minutes to be seated. We just stood awkwardly not knowing what we were supposed to do after checking in. Finally we were greeted and taken to our table. The rest of our party at the bar were shown to our table as well!

We were promptly greeted at our table by the staff. We were introduced to their cocktails and wine menus. The restaurant, as you would expected has a lengthy wine menu and speciality cocktails. Shortly after our waitress provided us a wealth of information on each of the courses and some of her favorites! All sounded lovely! We started with some fresh focaccia with dipping sauces. A bit small for four people so if you are a big bread eater you might need two. We then tried the dates. There were five decent size dates which were very good in flavoring. The next course was salad: I started with a traditional Cesar. Salad had a lot of Parmesan and croutons. I usually skip croutons but these were very fresh and yummy. Only miss was lack of anchovy taste. As for dinner, I had the lemon spaghetti as this is their signature item on the menu! Unfortunately the entree was not spot on as the two shrimp provided with the dish were overcooked thus dry! Too bad as they were good size shrimp. The other person in our group had the same issue with their shrimp. The best entree of the group was the steak which was cooked perfectly. Our other friend had pizza and it was nothing special and it was dry. Another miss. For dessert we sampled two desserts off the menu: lemon soufflé and a chocolate cheesecake like dessert. Both were good but not great! So as for we had highs and lows! For this price should be perfect: especially as it's Giada's restaurant.

Service was good! One of our favorite servers was Jose and his big pepper grinder! Thanks Jose for posing for me with the grinder!

As for atmosphere: restaurant is super modern. A place to be seen! On a Saturday night, as you would expect, the restaurant was packed! Make sure you dress to impressed.

reviews.text: Disappointing experience at this new restaurant. The ambiance and service is nice but the food, not so much. We had the caprese salad as appetizer. It was good, nothing spectacular for $23 for tomatoes and a little cheese and basil. I had the signature lemon spaghetti and was very disappointed. The two tiger shrimp served on the side were good but the pasta was swimming in sauce. A pool of it. Just way way way too much. It felt like a mound of spaghetti was sitting in a soup of marscapone. Sad. My friend had the pesto pasta with gluten free pasta. So shocked. How can a restaurant of this caliber serve completely overcooked pasta that basically falls apart and can't even be picked up with a fork? Cmon learn how to properly cook GF pasta! Good flavor but horrible pasta which made the dish very unenjoyable. For dessert the server told us about their delicious lemon soufflé and assured us it was GF. We were excited because she had described it so well and it sounded scrumptious ! A few minutes later she came back to our table and apologized and said they used to make it with almond flour but had switched to wheat flour. Wow. So disappointing. NO OTHER desserts other than boring old gelato were GF so no dessert for us. Overall, not an enjoyable or delicious meal and quite expensive. There's quite a lot of other Italian places in the Valley that are much better.

reviews.text:
After dinner my friend and I swung over here for a birthday dessert. Not knowing what we were walking into, sat at the bar and got a menu. Friend got a glass of wine and we picked two things- the tiramisu and the limoncello Soufflé. 

I'd eat 1,000 of those soufflés if I could. It was incredible. Literally made my night. Don't get me wrong, the tiramisu was delicious too, but the soufflé stole the show. 

The bar was pleasant to sit at, I think there was one other guy there, the dining room to the back of us looked packed. But the bartender.. he was coming off as arrogant. I'm not sure why, thought he was cool at first but nope, both my friend and I noticed his attitude. When asked if they had a mocktail list he laughed at me and said No. Honestly thought he was joking at first and he just stared and then walked away. Ok, not a big deal, I'll just have a water. 

Minus him, great time here.

reviews.text: Loved it! Visited this restaurant while in town for a quick vacation. The atmosphere is very nice, the service was excellent, and the food was great. My favorite dish was the Branzino. reviews.text:
I'm over the luna for Luna. I'm not really a Giada fan, but I am a fan of so good Italian eats. 

The four of us came to Luna and had a pizza and booze night. The ladies chose to have a beer while I shared a bottle of Duckhorn with my bro. We also got a couple of salads on the side for balance and ended the meal with dessert. It was the perfect meal. 

My favorite bites came from the spicy sausage pizza, the arugula salad, and the limoncello souffle. There wasn't a bad bite, though, so you can't go wrong. 

Come to Luna. You won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: Michael W.

reviews.text:
Great new restaurant to join the Scottsdale lineup.

Beautiful decor, atmosphere, lighting,  top notch service (thank you Melanie) , topped off with great fresh food, that is interesting and delicious. 

Dinning at Luna in a a wonderful experience and Melanie and the rest of the wait staff were incredible.  Really brings you back to the level of service one could expect from high end dinning pre Covid!!!!  We loved the atmosphere, the views of the kitchen from the Luna room, and the overall atmosphere of the restaurant.  The menu is truly coastal Italian, but prepared with true craft, amazing flavors and great technic. 

Our party loved the Bronzino, lemon pizza and lemon ricotta cookies, but thought the pasta dishes feel a bit short. Not bad, just nothing to write home about.  The desserts were beautiful but not as fresh as the main menu food, and seemed to not have been made fresh that day

Overall lovely dinning experience and will be back again in the future.

reviews.text: What an amazing dining experience! From the moment we arrived, the service was top level at the bar and with our server Melanie. The drinks and food were one thing better than the next. reviews.author: Denise H.

reviews.text: Decided to do a date night at Luna and had a great experience. It's been cooler here so opted for the patio which has a great ambiance and views of the mountains. We started by ordering the Santa Margherita Pinto Grigio which was light and flavorful. For an appetizer we did the focaccia, which was arguably the best focaccia we've ever had. It was served warm and fluffy and was exploding with flavor. For the main entree, I had Giada's signature dish of Lemon Spaghetti with shrimp. The shrimp had amazing flavor and texture and was some of the best shrimp I've ever had and complimented the pasta beautifully. My wife had the Branzino which was equally great. Our server was knowledgeable and friendly and the staff from the hostess to the manager were great. A solid "A" experience at this great new Scottsdale spot!
reviews.author: Jeff W.

reviews.text: The absolute best experience! From our service with Gilbert to the amazing dishes. I can't recommend this place enough!
reviews.author: Hailey H.

reviews.text: The best tasting party in every bite!!! I thought I was in Italy. Our server Gilbert provided the most amazing excellent experience we've ever had.  Must be under new management because this was top notch experience!!! Giada you've outdone yourself!!
reviews.author: Dusty H.

reviews.text: We tried out Luna to celebrate a special occasion, and were not disappointed. Everything we ordered was delicious. You have to start with the focaccia. So good. I also recommend the crab arancini. We got the lemon pizza for the table, as well, because it sounded interesting. It was unique and delightful. I heard the lemon spaghetti was a must-try, so my daughter and I ordered it to share. There was still plenty for both of us. My son and his girlfriend shared the lobster bucatini for two, and had leftovers. I don't recall the sides or desserts being anything special. But the ambiance and service were excellent. It is a bit of a drive for us, but we will go back!

reviews.text: Amazing food, wonderful service. Melanie was lovely and looked after us very well. Will be back again soon.
reviews.author: Melissa D.

reviews.text:
Moon in Italian is "Luna" therefore it makes perfect sense to be Moonstruck with Luna by Giada! 

How can one not be mesmerized by  amazingly prepared food, terrific service all in a beautiful surrounding. Fly me to the Luna now! Cheesy I know. But wait till you order the fantastic dishes offered with grade "A" top notch ingredients...all prepared in an open kitchen. (please refrain from placing your nose on the glass divider) 

After trying to cajole and was finally able to drag in Joyce W to try Luna, we have pinky sworn (very solemn in our book) to come back over and over again. I KNEW SHE WOULD LOVE IT! ...thats for joycie to read. 

Service was like a well orchestrated symphony, ever present, without being obtrusive. Difficult to accomplish. I must make mention here of how impressive manager Kenny G (thats right!) was overlooking the staff Jay (tremendous!) and Damian (cool!)  ensuring diners are well taken care of and all is in order. Elegant simplicity accomplished.

Here's the skinny on the PHAT (pretty hot and tempting) incredible edibles we ordered:
Spoiler Alert! Everything was Magnifico! 

*Branzino was well prepared, flakey, not overcooked yet with a crusty skin and imo 5*stars
*Lemon Spaghetti cooked al dente, firm to the bite, with a fragrant essence of lemon. Plus we ordered extra Jumbo Shrimp. This was a WoW effect on the entire table!
*Bistecca alla Florentina Porterhouse is a hefty seasoned porterhouse perfectly charred outside temperature appropriate inside (to your liking) with a sauce to die for! 

 Our visit with Princess Joyce was much more serenely superb! On to the PIZZA'S we enjoyed in order of preference:

*Lemon Pizza- GET THIS! What a delight as 3 different cheeses are present. Clearly everyone's favorite in our group! 
*Sausage Pizza came in a close second place but still outrageously good! "Thatsa Spicy meatball!" is what I always exclaim although Miss Joyce says NO Italian says that jon!
*Classic Margherita Pizza- one of the best ever had and I've been to Paris!...Texas :( 
*Mortadella Bianca- it was ok but not a favorite as other pizza's on the table won the race! Note: Apparently this pizza will be 86'd off the menu. 

*Citrus Caesars salad- oddly different, wonderfully delicious. 
*Arugula salad- fried pancetta with "rocket" arugula greens and comes with two blankets of parmigiano cheese that everyone fought over. Next time I want my own blanket! 

***DESSERTS NOT TO BE MISSED***

*Limoncello soufflé- wiggles (like my belly) when you move it and maintains its form! You've entered the Twinkle Zone! Blueberry sauce that screams good accompanied by Lemon Biscotti. Use up all the sauce or I'm coming to get your leftover! 
*Mascarpone Brownie Cheesecake- 
Al Capone approved! See Photo! Order Ahead! SELLS OUT! Whew I need a drink! Did someone say drink?

A Wine List that will rival an "E" Ticket at Disneyland! Plus excellent beers and marvelous cocktails galore that will...well you know. Cheers to all! 

**Valet Parking available
**Self Parking available as well

As Always, Thank You For Reading!
Enjoy life while staying safe!

reviews.text:
If we have been Yelp friends for while, you would know that one of the things I hate the most in this world is for my arch-nemesis, Jon H., to be right. On top of that, he has been going off, non-stop about how disappointed he was over my man, Bobby Flay's, restaurant. So when I tell ya I came into Luna by Giada, Giada De Laurentiis being Jon's honey-babe, just waiting to hate on this place, you best believe it. I will now sit here and say that I'm not even a fan; I'm an air conditioner!

The four of us ordered two beers (Huss Blonde Ale and The Shop Crispy --- Yay to Arizona drafts), a bottle of Duckhorn wine, the Arugula Salad, The Citrus Caesar Salad, all four pizza offerings, Limoncello Souffle, and the Mascarpone Brownie Cheesecake.

Arugula Salad (Crispy Pancetta, Candied Lemons & Parmigiano Reggiano): This has pancetta. What else do you need? You can't go wrong with a peppery arugula salad.

Citrus Caesar Salad (Citrus Caesar Dressing, Parmigiano Reggiano, Focaccia Croutons & Crispy Capers): Had I been wearing a skirt, this salad would have made it flip. This is the salad that I would order for myself and eat it with a side of fries. Flavorful, cheesy, and oh so good. That subtle brightness of the citrus is oh so pleasing.

Signature Margherita (Roasted Campari Tomatoes, Basil & Mozzarella): I judge a pizza place by their margherita. It's a simple and classic combination and if you can do this right, you know the rest will be amazing. This was perfection. The sauce had a pleasant sweetness that you just can't compare.

Lemon Pizza (Mozzarella, Garlic Creme Sauce & Caciocavallo Cheese): My favorite of the four pizzas easily. I love a good pucker and this pizza is all about balance. Cheese on cheese on cheese, garlic, cream, lemon... these are all my favorite things on a perfectly charred crust. My mouth has turned into a waterfall just typing this out.

Mortadella Bianca (Parmigiano Reggiano, Shaved Mortadella & Pistachio): We learned that they will be taking this off the menu soon for a mushroom pizza. Sad. Jon H. was going on and on about how he had a hankering for some Oscar Mayer bologna after eating this. ;D I kid. If I were to be honest, out of the four pizzas, this one shined the dullest. I was expecting it to be the winner as another pizzeria in town does a similar pizza with pistachio, parmesan, and red onions and it's one of my favorites. The Mortadella Bianca wasn't bad. Girl was just got lost in a star-studded pizza family.

Spicy Sausage (Roasted Peppers, Scamorza & Oregano): Now that's a spicy meatball! (Jon H.: No one Italian really says that, Joyce!) It's not really spicy for a walking chili pepper like me but I like a bite. If something bites me, Imma bite back! This was my second favorite slice of the night. 

Limoncello Souffle (Blueberry Anglaise & Candied Lemon Biscotti): Get your camera out and be prepared to record. What my girl Giada and I lack in height (short girls unite), this souffle makes up for. Is this a skyscraper!? The taller the souffle, the closer to God. Great flavors and good balance. A dessert that's light and not too sweet? It's my kinda dessert.

Mascarpone Brownie Cheesecake (Vanilla Bean Cheesecake, Brownie, Espresso Caramel & Mascarpone Whipped Cream): We were told this cheesecake gets sold out nearly every night and I can see why. As a big cheesecake fan, this hit all the right notes. Speaking of notes...

Every time a gentleman in a sharp suit walked by, the sensual notes of a saxophone permeated the air. I later found out that Kenny G is their manager. KENNY G! Don't believe me? Ask the staff! Tell them Jon H. said so! ;D

The food was spectacular and the staff was amazing. A big shout out to Jay and Damian for the amazing service.

reviews.text:
We were really excited to try this place, and love Giada. I will say, the ambience is pretty cool and the service was very nice. From the hostess, who sat us who was friendly (but not overbearing) and our server.. who had a beautiful accent and was all smiles... that, was all lovely. The food, however, was underwhelming. The charcuterie board was nothing special; I design more interesting ones myself at home. We shared the citrus Caesar salad which was boring; needed salt. My husband and I split the pork saltimbocca and while the portion for both salad and pork were large enough for us to share, neither were fabulous. Just mediocre. We didn't bother to take the leftovers. 

The sav blanc on "spécial" (which the server pushed) was awful. They just have been trying to get rid of their stock. 

Our friends shared the branzino and said it was good but certainly not earth shattering; they also shared the lemon spaghetti with shrimp which they liked but again, nothing wowed any of us. I think for the price, it's just not worth it; as such, I doubt  we'll try it again. Oh and when Jose (?) asked if we wanted still or sparkling water we said "still/tap" but he brought us bottles and charged us twice for it. We just wanted tap! But his English was a bit broken and he was hard to communicate with. So, we also got charged for water. Phooey! All things considered (and we are foodies who dine out frequently and have lots of favorites!, I am sad to say Luna will not make our list.
reviews.author: cara j.

reviews.text:
I am soooo disappointed at my experience here at this restaurant. From the minute we walked in, it started off bad. The customers service was awful. 
To start, we had reservations at 8:30 (I thought they were 8) so we came down as we were staying at the hotel. I let them know we were early cuz I thought they were at 8, the host said no problem but they were probably not going to be able to seat us until closer to 8:30, which was not a problem because that's obviously when our reservation was at. So they tell us we can grab a drink at the bar....we go to the bar and the bartenders there were awesome, I will say this was the only great customer service we received the entire time. 
Here's where I started getting very irritated. We were the first people at the bar....around 8:20-8:30 there were THREE other couples that came, all waiting at the bar as well for their table. There was also one group of 3 girls. Now I do not know what time their reservations are, but I do know that ours is approaching and as you can clearly see we were the first ones there and had been waiting for 30 minutes, why would you not come seat us first. But no, what do these host do? They grab EVERY SINGLE other person who has JUST arrived to go sit. I'm getting irritated because I think it's rude, but I do not say a word....but guess who does? The amazing bartender. She sends the manager over to go check when we would be sat....they said 5 more min....so about 5-10 min later we finally get sat. The fact that the bartender alone can see what is happening as every one else but us is getting called is a problem. I'm going to spare you the reason why I think we weren't called, but let's just say we didn't look like everyone else around here. 
Then we get sat and it takes our server 10 min to come greet us, take our drink order, anything. Then it felt so rushed, it felt like he was trying to get us in and out, I felt comfortable even being there. I will say the only thing that saved them was the food. It was actually good but the service turned me off so bad that I would never recommend anyone come here. When we got our food, it took our server so long to come and check on us. We ordered the filet and sausage pizza. Both were good. Service was awful.
reviews.author: Adriana C.

reviews.text: Went for my birthday. Took 45 min to be seated after our reso time, the restaurant was dead. They literally forgot about us at the bar our table had been sitting there ready no one came and got us. Then the manager starts scrambling to fix the issues it was just a mess. Over cooked a $200 steak im talking it came out medium well and we asked for it med rare. The whole table was done eating by the time the re fire came out. Server was awkward kept circling around the table giving us weird looks. Everything on the menu had way too much lemon. Just a very bleh experience sadly... to say the least.
reviews.author: Christy C.

reviews.text: I had the best dining experience of my life at Luna tonight. Shereese was our waitress and the service was amazing! She's was so knowledgeable and friendly. The whole staff made us feel especially welcomed and cared for. Chef Austin M made sure to check in at our table. 10/10 for the service food and ambiance. Shereese is in a league of her own and that women deserves a raise! I will be sure to return with friends and family often.
reviews.author: Alyssa J.

reviews.text: I will start by saying that this is one of those places that you mark on your list as been there done that.  My friend had seen the reviews and wanted to go for months so I made reservations, we had a 8:30 reservations, we showed up 5 minutes early and proceeded to wait another 25 minutes for our table.  We get seated and wait for our server, she finally comes and we order starters, this seems to take an incredible long time, after we get our bread and salad she finally comes back so we can order, but during this time she is buzzing around to other tables without a second glance at us. ( I guess we were not in her preferred social status to give us her best service.) We finally are able to order dinner and the dish I choice is no longer available, meaning they dont serve it any longer... So why still have it on the menu??? I choose something else but ask for no quail egg, I also ask for my steak to be Medium well. When it finally comes mind you it is now 9:50p, there is an egg on top and it is rare... they take it back and she tells me it will take a bit longer as they are making a new one.  The manager comes over and Apologies, says they will make it right, I'm like ok thank you. But what comes back is not a new stake but my old one now well done. At this point I am ready to go, but I'm here for my friend and I know she wants to try there tiramisu, we get that and it's like chocolate pudding and a small middle of substance. I was not crazy about the place, it was loud, the service was horrendous, side note, the men were dressed nice and professionally the women all had there chests on display, I guess if that for more tips,but just seemed like a bad version of Hooters.  I would not make the journey back again. I only gave it 2 stars for the bread which was good and the manager making right on bad food preparation.
reviews.author: Sonya L.

reviews.text: Had such a wonderful dinner tonight celebrating my birthday the day after Giada's! From the moment we arrived the stay was so welcoming and friendly.  Our server Brandi was so attentive, knowledgeable and friendly! We started with the focaccia which was so delicious! our group also had the mean spaghetti, Nodi Marini Alla Vodka, Risotto and the Bronzino.  Each dish was exceptional! We finished with the Lemon Souffle and Lemon Ricotta gelato.  The whole experience was exceptional and we cant wait to go back!
reviews.author: Bree J.

reviews.text: Very disappointed! The ambience is beautiful, and waiters were okay. We sat near the bathroom area where there was a fishy smell so the manager kindly moved us. The food was so disappointing. Everything covered with cheese and lacking in flavor besides the taste of cheese. I had the crab arancini with almost no crab inside, the lemon signature pasta which I must say was cold so it just tasted like an expensive Mac and cheese with punches of lemon and shrimp on the side. The dessert was too disappointing with cold brownie and cheesecake on top. This was hubby and I 16th year anniversary and we left HUNGRY! And to add from previous yelp pictures it seems portion size seems smaller.
reviews.author: Tiff M.

reviews.text:
We were so excited to learn Giada was opening a location in Scottsdale as we love her restaurant in Las Vegas! In fact, it is one of our favorite restaurants and we eat there every single time we are in Las Vegas. 

We arrive and we are warmly greeted. Every single person we encounter is friendly and outgoing - so far we are loving our experience. The manager, Kenny, tells us that Giada picked out every single thing in this restaurant - glassware, tile on the floors, etc.  The restaurant is very large and it is lovely. 

Our server, Lynnette, is wonderful and accommodating. We order drinks and appetizers (arancini balls and focaccia bread) and they arrive timely. The focaccia bread is served with 3 different smears - lemon butter (amazing), pesto and olive oil. The arancini balls are just okay; mushy texture maybe because of the crab? We definitely would not order again. I ordered the pasta with vodka sauce and my husband had the special of the night which was the same exact pasta and vodka sauce only it included a lobster tail. Both of our pastas arrived overcooked, the sauce was lackluster as in no flavor and he said the lobster was just okay. 

We might come back again but there are so many amazing restaurants in this area, it would be quite some time before we would want to give it a second chance. 

This restaurant was such a disappointment. I would give it two stars for the food and five stars for the service.

reviews.text: The food is absolutely amazing! Melanie was very helpful in deciding our menu. We will definitely be back!

reviews.text: I just went there for my ABSOLUTE FAVORITE THING ON THE MENU- The Lemon Ricotta and Salted Chocolate Chip cookies. I will come back to try the food. I really enjoyed the Vegas restaurant which is where I feel in love with the service, mood and overall hospitality. Luna by Giada gave me the same vibe so I can't wait to come back.

reviews.text: The meal was delicious. I did not have a bad bite! We had the private room and it was beautiful. Brandi was an amazing server who was accommodating of food allergies and preferences and even took photos of our group. Highly recommend this restaurant and please ask for Brandi if you want 5 star service!!

reviews.text: Brandi was absolutely AMAZING!   The food was second to none  and atmosphere was impeccable!
reviews.author: Sarah R.

reviews.text: Outstanding food and service. Menu is not robust but everything that's on there is very good. Lemon pasta is a must, spicy sausage pizza was crazy good and the focaccia bread is the best I've ever had. Our waitress was Sherrece...she was fantastic.
reviews.author: Greg R.

reviews.text:
Highly disappointing experience from hotel to dining.  When we saw Luna opening at a Cesar Resort we were so excited. The moment we could book a stay and dinner we did. A fun staycation night with our friends was the plan. 

I'll I'm you the highlights. First our hostess was very unhappy person. The table she placed us at was dirty there was cheese and bread crumbs all over, she didn't seem to care when I pointed it out. Then when our server came over she was annoyed that I wanted the table wiped down. Not once did anyone apologize. Finally the GM came over asked what was going on and he moved us to a clean table with a wonderful server. The GM apologized and provided some comped appetizers. The appetizers were great! We have the focaccia, bacon wrapped dates and crab balls. They need to add the crab balls pompadour sauce to the main menu! The GM did come back at the end of the meal and apologized again which I do appreciate. He was sincere in his efforts and our second waitress was amazing! 

Then we ordered; the lemon spaghetti was very one note there was too much cream to lemon ratio. It drowned out the favor I think they were going for. I think it was supposed to be a splash of cream for fat and not lemon cream sauce. 2 of us had the scallop risotto. It was ok, scallops cooked perfect but the rice was over cooked and very mushy just this side of paste. Another had a rib eye (evening special) the steak was cook perfect and it was enjoyed. The side of corn with the steak was terrible! It was like someone made corn soup with leftover Thanksgiving sausage from the stuffing.  Think sweet cream corn then add Italian sausage chunks. When we read the description I think we thought savory corn with crispy sausage crumbles not chunks of sausage. Even the waitress said it looked soupier than normal.  There was sausage grease floating on top too. Just not good combo, we all disliked it. Our drinks were well crafted. We didn't order dessert because the meal was disappointing for the location and price point. 

We had issues with the hotel too, but I won't go into that. Overall very disappointing staycation from start to finish. We definitely won't be coming back to the hotel or Luna. Maybe my expectations were too high for a Cesar's hotel, a new restaurant with Giada's name and a Scottsdale location.

reviews.text: Really disappointed with this place. (And I was really hyped because I love Giada.) Took my husband here for his birthday. They completely ignored special requests upon reservation to surprise him with a dessert. Long wait. And very mediocre food and service. Super overpriced for what it was. Go to your local pizza place and save yourself the money. Mall parking lot = Mall Food - LAME AF - Won't be going back,

reviews.text:

We had the focaccia, Caesar salad and seafood tower.  D-LISH!
