Crab arancini
Bacon wrapped dates
Branzino
Lemon pizza
Lemon pasta
Every dessert 
Our server, Shereese, was awesome too!
We will be back
reviews.author: John R.

reviews.text: I took my brother here for his 70th Birthday. The manager came to our table and welcomed us, that was a very nice touch. The staff was amazing and paid so much attention to detail!  Our server Melanie, is one of the best waitress's I have had anywhere.  She could easily work at Dominick's or the Monarch. I think many of the staff member could. Managements must treat them right for them to be so professional. The food was good. My brother said the bread was the best he ever had.  The oysters were small but fresh and tasty. The salads where unique and fresh and quite good, but do not closely resemble Caesar or Caprese. I think the one called Caprese, my brother had, may have been better than a traditional caprese salad. My salad was not a Caesar salad, they should call it something else IMHO, but it was exactly as Melanie described to me, so I was not surprised nor disappointed when I got it.  Light Lemon dressing was refreshing for the summer.  For my cocktail I had the "LA STRADA" Stoli Cucumber Vodka, Belle de Brillet, Re'al Kiwi puree, Lemon Juice & Club Soda. My brother has 2 Mocktails of it.  It was delicious and refreshing. Perfect for summer.  When it came time for dessert, I explained to Melody I wanted a desert as well, and my brother does not share his food (not kidding) so she brought me a birthday dessert as well. Wow! I never expected that! LOL! Melanie ROCKS!!! The entire staff does. We sat in the Jade room because we a bit older and needed a quiet place to hear each other's conversation. By the time the restaurant was full, we could no longer hear each other at all unfortunately.   But it was very good, I had the Lemon Spaghetti with scallops instead of Shrimp. The scallops were a bit underdone, a bit translucent in the middle, but I did not mention it. I'll fix it when I make the left overs. My brother's rare ribeye was excellent he said, and he raved about the corn and sausage side dish. The gelato and cookie dessert were heaven!  Thank you, Melanie and staff, at Luna for making my brothers 70th birthday so great.
reviews.author: Shannon H.

reviews.text: Overall so happy with our experience. Our waitress shereese was amazing! The food was truly amazing and the atmosphere was very nice. Flavorful food, amazing staff, and I would ignore the bad reviews, this restaurant is awesome. Bacon wrapped dates were a great appetizer. Lemon pasta and pizza was probably my favorite entree and the cheesecake and cookies were the best desserts.
reviews.author: Emma G.

reviews.text: Absolutely Delicious!!! Great service and atmosphere. Try the Lemon Pasta and Branzino.
reviews.author: Camille C.

reviews.text: A great experience! Our neighbor suggested it and we're so glad she did-we had a wonderful time. We had a reservation for 8:15 and were seated promptly. Our server Rae was pleasant, knowledgeable and helpful. We had perfect cocktails; martinis and a Manhattan. We split an order of crab arancini which was rich and delicious. My neighbor and I had the Noda Martini pasta with shrimp for her and chicken for moi. Excellent! My wife had the Branzino which was outstanding. We had a side of corn and spicy sausage (which sounds odd) but which was outstanding. We followed dinner with delicious desserts and had a great time. We'll be back. Pronto!
reviews.author: Mark M.

reviews.text: We went here for my wife's birthday and had a great time! Our waitress had excellent recommendations and we loved it all!
reviews.author: Dave L.

reviews.text: Had such a wonderful dinner with girlfriends here tonight! From the moment we sat down Brandi took excellent care of us. She walked us through the menu while giving great descriptions and suggestions. We started with the focaccia, caprese and bacon wrapped dates - all of them were delicious! Brandi told us the focaccia was a must and we were very happened we listened to her because she was definitely right! We then ordered the lemon pasta and margarita pizza which were both wonderful as well and tasted super fresh. To finish it off Brandi brought out two desserts  to celebrate the birthdays at the table. We had the brownie cheesecake and lemon soufflé and again both were really great but I think the cheesecake was the table favorite!
reviews.author: Lauren D.

reviews.text: Love this place! The food was great and Brandi was an awesome server. She knew so much about the menu and gave great suggestions. Will definitely be back for another girls night!
reviews.author: Emily K.

reviews.text: Amazing all around- service, food, ambiance- lemon pasta with shrimp was delicious! I dream about the bread....
reviews.author: Sara A.

reviews.text: I wish I could give 5 stars. Honestly, the food, service, ambiance were perfect! The foccaccia was best I've ever had. The lemon pizza and lemon spagetti were amazing. BUT...the not optional 3.5% "Venue Admin Fee" put such a bad taste in my mouth. It's misleading to have prices on the menu that are acutally 3.5% higher than stated.
reviews.author: Melanie P.

reviews.text:
Fabulous! great food and just a wonderful waiter named Gilbert!  
Beautiful  surroundings, big, wide open bar! 
 Make sure you ask for Gilbert!
reviews.author: Robin F.

reviews.text: We came for dinner and loved it! The ambiance was great and our server was so friendly and helpful. The food was also delicious. Like others have mentioned, there is a lot of lemon but we really liked it. They also have gluten free pasta which was super exciting for me. We will definitely come back!
reviews.author: Kayla D.

reviews.text: We had the pleasure of celebrating our 24th anniversary here. The dinner was exquisite and Shereese made the experience so memorable! We are looking forward to our next date night so we can go again!
reviews.author: Jordan L.

reviews.text: Our party of 11 women were celebrating a birthday and were able to reserve the private room in the back of the restaurant. Our server Sharesse was top tier. The perfect mix of professionalism and personable. She was fun energetic and suggested her favorites from the menu that did not disappoint. We agreed we would all return for the food and service! Brody was a fun addition to the evening!
reviews.author: Yelp G.

reviews.text: What a place!  The restaurant is so much bigger than you would think and beautifully decorated.  They have a private room that you can reserve for groups of 10 or less that has glass doors and is a private comfortable setting.  We had a great table by a window and our server, Brandi, was amazing!  After starting out with a coupe of martinis and glasses of wine, we went to the first round and had rhetorical Caesar salad.  It was a nice light twist from a traditional Caesar dressing and was delicious.  For our entrees, Brandi recommended the Lemon Spaghetti and the Branzino so we followed her lead.  The Lemon Spaghetti with Shrimp had a presentation that was worthy of being in an art studio!  The flavor was everything you can imagine with a lemon cream sauce.  The Branzino was not the presentation of the head and tail of the fish but was two beautiful filets that were perfectly seasoned and moist.  Just when we thought we couldn't eat another bite, Brandi took us on another adventure with some Limoncello and Lemon soufflé that was presented with a blueberry sauce.  That soufflé is world class and a must.  Do not eat here without experiencing the Soufflé.  It is light and will make all of your senses tingle with delight!  I highly recommend you try Luna and ask for Brandi when you make your reservation.  You will not be disappointed!  Thanks Brandi for taking great care of us.  We will be back. Enjoy!
reviews.author: Tim O.

reviews.text:
Excellent service and food. We suggest splitting the lemon pasta it is a lot and more than enough to divide.
The Bread is a must overall order sensible, and you can enjoy a great night without breaking your bank book.
The actual room to eat in was rather noisy and distracting but not a reason to leave this restaurant off your list.
Ambiance was modern casual a beautiful hotel before you enter this establishment.
reviews.author: Chuck 7.

reviews.text:
Food was just okay. Pricey for what you get. Noise level was high. Service was slow. 
Probably would go again.
reviews.author: Beth G.

reviews.text:
The food here is really good!!! the portion sizes are small for something that is sooooo pricey. I understand it's the location and ambience but it's not a place I would visit multiple times. The crab aranchine, frito misto, lemon spaghetti and branzino were great!! Cocktails also very pricey but my cucumber cocktail was great. 
Def worth a try once for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Jeny P.

reviews.text: It was alright! Service and ambiance were great, but none of the food really blew me away. We split a caesar salad which was fine, and I got the lemon spaghetti which was a bit disappointing considering it's one of their signature dishes. It didn't really have any depth of flavor and just tasted like lemon pasta. My boyfriend got the pesto which was much better.
reviews.author: Lauren J.

reviews.text: I have enjoyed dinner at Giada's in Las Vegas 4 times. I was very happy that she now has a location in Scottsdale. It was great. The food was amazing. We had dinner at Luna's twice in 5 days. I think that says it all.
reviews.author: Andrea R.

reviews.text:
Service was terrible!!!! Food was poor to awful... overcooked, undercooked. 
Chef and manager promised to make it up and totally flaked. Never followed up after multiple emails. I'll never go back! Complete disappointment!!!
reviews.author: Carole R.

reviews.text: You are given fair warning by the decor of all plastic plants everywhere and not a fresh flower  anywhere.  Read the New Times review and believe it.  Noisy and chairs wifh no arms and waiters in jeans- the food  is in keeping with the atmosphere and the only high note- a very very high note is the prices.  The staff tried hard too bad the kitkchen didn't help much.  Oh well hard to complain or talk- too noisy
reviews.author: Carl R.

reviews.text: The restaurant is super cool! I loved the vibe. We sat in the main dining room. Kendall was our server. She was fantastic. She was helpful with ordering and gave us time to enjoy, while checking in periodically. We can't wait to come back and will request Kendall in the future !
reviews.author: Mandy V.

reviews.text: By far one of the best meals I have ever had in my life, nothing was short of excellent. The lemon spaghetti was incredible. We had three appetizers and there isn't a single thing I can say about any of them that would be negative. Perfect ambience exceptional attention to detail, great wine menu. The servers were on point. Everyone was friendly.
reviews.author: Katie M.

reviews.text: Atmosphere is uninviting. Great staff. Apps were good. Entrees bland and overcooked. Unless you love tiramisu, the dessert is Olive Garden quality . This place is very overpriced and they add a 3.5% service charge on top of it like they do in Vegas
reviews.author: Paul M.

reviews.text: I'll be thinking about this meal for a while. Everyone working was incredibly welcoming, attentive, pleasant, and just plain wonderful. Please order yourself the lemon spaghetti. Start with the caprese salad and the focaccia. Order a cocktail. Your future self will thank you.
reviews.author: Howard W.

reviews.text: Service and Ambiance was great. Food was not good, either over power by lemon or very Blane. The pizza was soggy and undercooked. For the money there are so many other places to go . Very disappointed.
reviews.author: Dina A.

reviews.text: Great time at Luna in Scottsdale.  The service (including our main server Jay) was tremendous.  We started with the focaccia and crab arancini (both were delicious especially the focaccia).  For our two main entrees, we had the signature lemon spaghetti and agnolotti.  Both were very good but I preferred the lemon spaghetti.  And for dessert, we had the cookies which was another highlight.  A little pricey but delicious nonetheless.
reviews.author: Robert V.

reviews.text: Amazing food and service to match, thank you Ray, Brody and Chef Austin!!! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Angela C.

reviews.text: Walking into the restaurant was interesting it's very long and they sat us all the way in the back.. it was very much a hotel restaurant. The lobby was beautiful but the structure of the restaurant was strange. We then were seated and had terrible service... 30 min wait to get water ... the server was nice just seemed like it was under staffed.  We placed drink orders and waited another 20 mins. By this time we were hungry and luckily someone brought us food to our table that wasn't ours as we were waiting for our drinks. By that time we were so hungry we ate it. Finally our drinks came but the food runner had no idea which table so we watched him ask other tables until he finally figured it out and came to us. We told the waiter we needed to leave due to an "emergency" then paid for the below average calamari, one beer, one terrible espresso martini and it was $70. Walked to Nobu after to get our money's worth. I swear you can't make this shit up lol
reviews.author: Lauren A.

reviews.text: At first, the place looked really nice and we were seated quickly. We ordered drinks but only half of them came and we had to ask again for the other drinks. We then ordered appetizers which came well and believed that the main course would be as good as the appetizers. We were wrong. The pizza was burnt. We were also told that the pasta sizes were personal but they were huge leading to us being unable to finish the pasta. The pasta was also very bland as if it were missing salt and there was no taste to it. In addition to this, we told our waitress we were celebrating a birthday and she completely disregarded it by not bringing even a small dessert for the table while other tables were receiving cakes with candles for their birthdays. When we asked our waitress to box the food, no one came and we had to ask again as other waiters came to pick up dirty plates. Overall, the main course was distasteful and the service was not good at all.
reviews.author: Jia T.

reviews.text:
Truly a 5-Star Dining Experience!

Our server, Shereese, was honestly what made the dinner so memorable. Without a doubt, she is the best server you will ever encounter anywhere! (Seriously! It was so remarkable that my husband, who dines at numerous restaurants worldwide, was absolutely blown away.) Not only is she impeccably professional with honest recommendations and a deep knowledge of every detail of the menu, but she also possesses a genuinely poised and clever personality. She checked on us so many times and always at the perfect moments (even though the restaurant was packed). Her phrasing was so refined, like when she said, "I feel like I'm stealing your plate, but it looks as if you are finished," instead of asking, "Are you finished?" or when she said, "I won't hold you hostage; I'll get you the check," always in such a refreshing yet respectful manner. She just exuded joy & positivity.

The BUGATTI FOCCIA bread board is a must; I think anyone will tell you that! The focaccia bread is served with a special creamy butter, fresh pesto, and a balsamic & olive oil mix--it was an extraordinary start. Shereese suggested spreading a touch of the creamy butter on the bread before dipping it into one of the other dishes, and that truly elevated the experience. I can see why Giada's olive oil and balsamic vinegar are famous, because the pesto and the "balsamic & oil" dips were both on a whole different level. I'm planning to return with my friends and make a meal of that and the Caprese Salad!

The CAPRESE SALAD was phenomenal--an absolute must-try. Instead of mere mozzarella, it featured creamy stracciatella cheese, and the bite-sized wedges of multicolored tomatoes were incredibly fresh. An amazing balsamic and pesto drizzle surrounded it, with balsamic molecular gastronomy pearls literally bursting with incredible flavor.

For my entrée, I had Giada's SIGNATURE LEMON SPAGHETTI, which was perfectly twisted in a creamy mascarpone cheese lemon sauce, with crispy capers (which I absolutely loved), and two shrimp. As Shereese placed it before me, she said, "Chef Giada recommends tipping the pasta over into the sauce." My little tip is to have some freshly ground pepper added (from their cool 3-foot-high pepper grinders). My husband had the SCALLOP RISOTTO. The risotto was perfectly cooked and delicious, with peas, asparagus, Maryland crab, and topped with two scallops. Both dishes were generously sized and filling.

They offered several unique cocktails, many made with gin. I opted for "The Moderno," which included Smoke Wagon small batch bourbon, Giffard orgeat syrup, lemon juice, Bigallet China China liqueur, with a splash of Super Tuscan wine floating on top. Personally, I would have preferred more fruit-forward options that weren't as strong, so given the cocktail price of $21, I will order a soft drink next time. However, if you enjoy creative, well-crafted, strong cocktails made with premium spirits, you will find excellent options here.

For dessert, Shereese brought us their famous round cheesecake-on-brownie, beautifully decorated and garnished. It was so incredible that we ate as much as we could at the restaurant and the rest at home.

Paul, the general manager, was incredibly personable and came over to wish us a happy anniversary after we received the check. He ensured that we enjoyed everything and that the dessert was comped, which Shereese had already taken care of.

They obviously informed the valet when we were ready to leave, because our car was waiting at the door, and one of the (all very special) valets said, "We appreciate you."

Everything (and everyone) was exceptional, but requesting Shereese as your server is a must.

We will definitely return!
reviews.author: Laurie V.

reviews.text: We were walked in and were greeted happily by the hostesses. Decided to have a drink at the bar to start out evening. The espresso martini is the best in the city. We ordered the crab arancini, focaccia and cheese pizza for an appetizer. I opted for the lemon pasta dish and my husband had the pasta Bolognese made special by Paul, the manager. We had the A-Team for servers who were Amanda and Brody. All three of them really made our night special. For dessert, we chose the amaretto chocolate cake and the lemon soufflé with the blueberry sauce. It also came with two biscotti's. Everything there is five star. This is now a permanent go to for Italian night.
reviews.author: Julie U.

reviews.text:
Food was delicious, service was friendly & professional. Somewhat overpriced ( 2 Shrimp $20.) however what was surprising is when we received are bill. It had a 3.5% Venue Admin. charge which wasn't communicated upfront or on the restaurant's website. It's like a charge to help pay for the rent they pay. The meal was very good, however this extra charge I will not be going back . The meals were expensive enough than charging an extra cost to cover their expenses. 
Not a good way to run a business, at least tell us upfront about the charge, so we can make a decision if we want to go there.
reviews.author: Rich H.

reviews.text: Modern, elegant ambience. Welcoming staff. Excellent food albeit a bit pricey. Service was outstanding & food was presented beautifully & delicious
reviews.author: Patti J.

reviews.text: This place was ok-not great. Pasta was too hard and slightly cold. Servers were nice but took a long time and it didn't really feel like a high end restaurant but they have very high prices. I did really enjoy the Lemon Pizza and the Arugula salad.
reviews.author: Lauren B.

reviews.text:
Brody made our night! the food was amazing. everyone should try the brownie cheesecake and lemon spaghetti! 

ask for Natalia at the bar she'll make you a great drink and is super seeet
reviews.author: Tom R.

reviews.text: Four people shared two appetizers and three entrees Everything was super great from the great service . The pasta was to die for. All there drinks super . The dining room it self is big well. Lots of room for a big crowd  With more room
reviews.author: Mark M.

reviews.text:
10/10 experience! The food was amazing. Beef carpaccio, caprese salad, lemon spaghetti and the cheesecake. Everything was so well done in presentation and taste. 

The interior of the restaurant is classy, clean, modern and it didn't feel like we were in Scottsdale! 

Gilbert was our server and was so knowledgeable about the menu, coursed the meal out perfectly and had great recommendations. 

We will definitely be back many many times being local and having this delicious spot so close by!
reviews.author: Vicky C.

reviews.text:
The service was excellent! Brody was fun, congenial and attentive.  Food was ok, nothing to write home about.  The menu was very lemon forward.  Each course had a lemon theme, obviously you could choose not to order that. We had the HEIRLOOM TOMATOES, STRACCIATELLA CHEESE, BASIL & BALSAMIC PEARLS salad. Very small, the  is not made in house. It was tasty but small. Not really to be shared. CRAB ARANCINI was very good. MEDITERRANEAN BRANZINO was tasty, though not much Mediterranean to it, I might include  some of the Mediterranean vegetables with it.  I peeled off the skin as that does  not appeal to me.  PORK CHOP SALTIMBOCCA was tasty, that was a larger portion, my companion enjoyed it.  Sides of 

CORN & SAUSAGE was ok, again not as good as hyped to be.  Also had the side of 

ROASTED BROCCOLINI which was a bit bitter, that would have benefited, with the squeeze of lemon 
LEMON SMASHED POTATOES these also were Ok, not something In would order again. 
 
The special steak was a enjoyed by another colleague as well 

Overall, it was a nice meal, nice ambiance, good service.  The meal itself was average, a bit overpriced.  I came, I had , but would not likely return.  Being a Giada fan, I was  hoping for something really special .
reviews.author: Holly H.

reviews.text:
This was my second time at this restaurant, and the quality had stopped after just a few months of being open.
We ordered several terrible dishes: the pizza and bread burned, the salmon was overcooked, and the pasta was cold. The service was awful, and the waitress did not know the menu. My friend told her she was allergic to nuts before she ordered, and she brought her a dish based on nuts. 
After my experience, I will take back the high recommendation I have before.
reviews.author: Lillester B.

reviews.text: We ate here today for Father's Day.  The service and our meals were exceptional.  I had the mezza rigatoni with an arugula salad.  My husband ordered the lemon spaghetti with the same salad.  The food was awesome!!!!!!!!  It is noisy in this restaurant but so worth it for the food and service.
reviews.author: Ann S.

reviews.text:
I love Giada and have watched her show for years. I was so excited to try Luna as I live in Scottsdale. First off I have to compliment Shereese our server. She was phenomenal and made our experience amazing!!! I would ask for her again if I was to go back.  

We ordered the Focaccia and it was amazing! However, I would say for the size it should've been comped. Small portion for the money. Food was good but not for the money spent. Which was disappointing because I wanted this to be a place we come back to often and bring friends. On a side note this is a little pet peeve of mine. I'm 5'3" and the chair was too low for the table. Felt like I needed a booster seat. 

I'm glad to be able to have experienced Luna's. However I'm not sure if it would be my first choice to go back. 

Everything was 5 star except for the price. It was over priced.
reviews.author: Elann G.

reviews.text: Amazing food and service, Kendall gave great recommendations and everything exceeded our expectations.  Great drinks, highlights were the calamari, caprese, lemon pasta.
reviews.author: Brianne H.

reviews.text: We sat in the Jade room and the atmosphere was amazing, service even better (ask for Brandi) and the food was top notch. Run, don't walk. So many choices for fine dining in Scottsdale and this is among the top.
reviews.author: Laura H.

reviews.text: Delicious food, great experience and very fast service! Would definitely recommend, we sat in the bar and it was great
reviews.author: Ashley S.

reviews.text:
Service was not even adequate!  We had to ask management to get service as we continually waited for response.  Food was okay; wine pricing was exorbitant compared to other "high end restaurants".  
Ambience way too noisy; difficult to hear across a table for four!
Food was just okay; nothing I would  return for especially at the prices they charge.
reviews.author: Stuart S.

reviews.text: My local friends recommended we eat here for dinner. This is a newly opened hotel and restaurant located off the hotel lobby. This was my first time here at the hotel lobby and Luna by Giada restaurant. Luna by Giada, Luna Bar and Pronto by Giada are all situated within the vibrant Caesars Republic Scottsdale, a new lifestyle-hotel experience and the first non-gaming hotel from Caesars Entertainment in the United States. Located adjacent to Scottsdale's premier luxury retail destination, Scottsdale Fashion Square, the new concept taps into the unique pulse of the surrounding city to form a one-of-a-kind experience. The large lobby here is quite impressive. A wide range of wines are on display in their refrigerator. Giada De Laurentiis also has a restaurant in The Cromwell Hotel that offers Italian fare and views of the Las Vegas strip. Food and service here was average at best.
reviews.author: Tony J.

reviews.text: Almost every dish had lemon in it so if that is not your cup of tea just know that going in. With that being said every dish we had was very good and decent in portion size! Shereese was our waitress and made the dining experience very enjoyable! She was attentive and friendly!
reviews.author: Alexis C.

reviews.text: I dined at Luna with a group of six and all of us were very disappointed with our experience. Our server seemed to be rushing us. Our plates did not come out at the same time leaving food to get cold. Do not order the lobster for two. It was only half a lobster with mounds of pasta. What a rip off! Also check your bill before signing. They add random fees. Definitely will not be returning or recommending Luna to anyone.
reviews.author: Genevieve L.

reviews.text: Our group of 6 was a bit disappointed with our experience at Luna. Appetizers of oysters and focaccia bread came out quickly. The entrees didn't all come at once, leaving some plates to get cold. Branzino is not the whole fish type, but two small fillets ($47). Filet mignon was good, but you can do better across the street for the price ($67). Bucatini lobster for two includes 1/2 of a lobster and lots of pasta ($97). The $47 rigatoni was the only sizable dish, but only after adding sausage for an additional $9. Gratuity was included without our being told. Glad I looked at the bill closely. 3.5% venue admin fee? WTF?
reviews.author: Tom G.

reviews.text:
Service was awesome.   The restaurant is very very loud so get ready.    Misto and focaccia was fab.  
My husband ordered the Tripolini, very salty and one wad cold in middle. Gnodi was delish.
reviews.author: Susan H.

reviews.text:
So, here's the thing about Phoenix. Phoenix is a Michelin star dining scene that is widely mislabeled as an "honorable mention" -- and I think out-of-town restaurateurs mistakenly believe they can come in and wow this city with a halfhearted effort. It doesn't work. 

You have to bring your foodie A-game and you have to polish it constantly to stay relevant. 

We found the service excellent, the decor fantastic, but the entrees only OK, not up to par relative to their pricing. Which is a shame. Given the address, Luna is going to have to charge these prices to balance the books. They don't have the option to just rebrand as a mid-tier hangout restaurant. They NEED to hit it out of the park, because they MUST charge $100/plate, because rent and buildout costs were too high.

So it's time to double down and put Giada in the kitchen with a residence, or expect to shutter in a year once the hype stops bringing in traffic.
reviews.author: Lou M.

reviews.text: I was visiting Scottsdale a few weeks ago and a friend suggested we try Luna. AMAZING. Our server was Suz and she was one of the best servers I've encountered. Super knowledgeable, great recommendations and very helpful!  Food was great as expected and I can't wait to return!
reviews.author: Tracy W.

reviews.text: Food was average, but our server, Suzannah was amazing, and made up for the disappointing food. She went above and beyond to put a smile on our face, despite the cold and flavorless food.
reviews.author: Lenny P.

reviews.text: What a fantastic experience our family had dining at Luna!! Our server, Melanie, and busser, Jose, were incredibly friendly, informative, and so attentive!! Dishes were very lemon forward, and pasta was cooked perfectly al dente. Stand out dishes included focaccia, crab arancini, mortadella pizza, and seafood risotto. Highly recommend this spot as a wonderful new Italian option. Thanks, Luna, we will return soon for another wonderful meal!!
reviews.author: J. B.

reviews.text: The focaccia and the crab arancini were the best bites of my year.  Worth going just for that.  Arugula salad also really solid.  However all the pastas were just ho hum.  We tried 3 - they were all under sauced or dry somehow and just ok.  Expected much more from this establishment and for the price point.
reviews.author: Aundrea J.

reviews.text: My friend and I recently went here for dinner.  The restaurant is new--just opened in March.   The atmosphere was amazing.  We loved the beautiful decor including the tile work and pizza oven as you passed to go into the dining room.  The plates with a cursive L and the red water glasses added just the right touch.  The selection of cocktails and wine was wonderful.  Tony was a server and he was great.  He made appropriate recommendations and gave us time to enjoy our drinks and appetizers before getting our dinner order.  He was very knowledgeable about the menu and made our dining experience enjoyable.  It was the perfect cadence-not too fast but attentive. I would highly recommend this place. We will definitely be back and request to sit in Tony's section!
reviews.author: Heather W.

reviews.text: We dined outside on the patio. The view of Camelback mountain was beautiful especially as the sun set behind it. Our waiter Tony was great, very attentive and informative. The food was amazing as usual. We had the Sicilian Focaccia which was made to perfection along with the caprese salad which was different than the norm...highly recommended. The lemon spaghetti was to die for and the margherite pizza. My husband and I celebrated our 27th anniversary and they surprised us with the lemon soufflé for dessert. All I can say is amazing. Brava Giada
reviews.author: Frank M.

reviews.text: Food was pricey but delicious! Service couldn't be better. The staff was friendly and went above expectations. Brody kept us entertained and Jay knew everything about the food and helped us order exactly what we wanted. I got lemon spaghetti, my kids got the pasta and Vida sauce with chicken, and scallops with risotto.  Appetizers were the crab rolls with red sauce-to die for, and we got the focaccia which was incredible. For my son's birthday they brought us a complimentary gelato and cookie which was so yummy! Everything tasted fresh and we had such a fun time because of our servers Jay & Brody! We'll be back for sure!
reviews.author: Nancy G.

reviews.text: We tried this restaurant last night for our 27th wedding anniversary & we're definitely going to be back! Everything was delicious. We tried the bacon wrapped dates, caprese salad, lobster bucatini for 2, balsamic asparagus and mascarpone brownie cheesecake. Husband had the cucumber cocktail. Great service, beautiful ambience, and they did not rush us. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Amy G.

reviews.text: Had a great dinner here with my wife. Brody, our busser was great and made our experience fun and enjoyable - ask him for the special deal of the night haha
reviews.author: Constantin B.

reviews.text:
My husband and I had dinner at Luna last evening due to a recommendation we had received from a friend. We had high expectations and unfortunately, we were disappointed. 
Food:  We ordered the lemon spaghetti with shrimp because it was the "signature dish" per the menu. The spaghetti did not have that distinctive taste of fresh homemade pasta.  And we each only received 2 shrimp!  So the dish just included a pile of spaghetti noodles in a creamy lemon sauce and 2 shrimp- nothing else.  It was just average and we couldn't believe there were only 2 shrimp- one on each side of the plate!  I will say, however, that the appetizer we ordered of bacon-wrapped dates was very good.  For dessert, we had the chocolate gelato which was not the best gelato I've had (Pomo is much better).
Service: Our server was very friendly and personable, but also very inattentive.  We felt ignored the majority of the evening. After we were seated and given water, it took a really long time for the server to come to our table to give us menus. Eventually, we ordered an appetizer.  After the appetizer was delivered and eaten and cleared away by someone else, it then took a REALLY long time for our server to come back to take our order. We also went without water for a REALLY long time to the point that I almost got up to get the pitcher of water myself from the server station.  We had tried flagging people down, but felt completely ignored.  When it was time for the bill, we waited again; we made sure to give him our card when he brought the bill so that we wouldn't have another long wait for him to pick it up.
Environment/ambience:  It was VERY loud, so loud that we couldn't hear each other and couldn't have much of a conversation which made the evening unenjoyable.
We don't plan to come back to Luna.
reviews.author: Colette K.

reviews.text: Went to Luna's last night and it was amazing!  The focaccia bread was out of this world!  Our meal was delicious, service was great and the decor was lovely.   The only disappointment was the wine selection but overall it was a fantastic evening.
reviews.author: Cristin K.

reviews.text: We had an amazing dinner at Luna for my mother's birthday.  The restaurant decor is beautiful.  The food was delicious.  Our server, Sherese, was helpful, attentive, and knowledgeable.  She made great suggestions.  She also made my mom's birthday great with a surprise desert and a candle so we could sing.  Sherese definitely elevated the experience.
reviews.author: Emily M.

reviews.text: Our experience at Luna was so disappointing. We had a reservation for 8 people and were seated in a back/semi-private room (not by request). The group (4 women, 4 men) decided to each order something different and share so we could each try more of the menu. Sadly, most of the dishes were just gross. Here's the breakdown. Focaccia was fine, basic, but fine. The citrus Caesar was okay, but very very lemony. That will be a theme in the review. Average dishes included the sausage pizza (undercooked), rigatoni (undercooked) and risotto (lemon again).  The lemon spaghetti was okay, and for being the dish that was actually  described as lemon, was more cheesey than lemony. However, the sauce was broken so it had a grainy texture. The nodi was hands down the best dish we tried, but very basic. There were two dishes that were absolutely inedible: tripolini and the agnolotti. Tripolini was just a mouthful of hard noodles and way too much pesto. The agnolotti was the worst. It was described as small meat filled pasta with an herbaceous sauce. In reality, it was meat filled pasta in a bowl of lemon juice and got worse with each bite. We passed on dessert. Service was also disappointing. Took nearly 30 minutes for drinks to arrive and very spotty throughout the meal. I know it's a new place, so perhaps they are working out some kinks in the kitchen. I hope others have a better experience, but with that said, we will not be returning.
reviews.author: Annie D.

reviews.text: Brody and Kenneth were fantastic!! The food was DELICIOUS!! Kenneth was very knowledgeable and provided great suggestions! The lemon spaghetti was amazing and I can't wait to go back to try the lemon pizza! Brody was engaging and fun and made sure to capture our amazing meal in pictures for us! Great experience!
reviews.author: Nicki F.

reviews.text: Our first visit here was amazing! We all enjoyed the Lemon Spaghetti, Lemon Pizza, Cesar Salad, and Signature Margherita Pizza. We had Kenneth and Brody whom both gave us wonderful customer service! Thank you so much for making our dinner such a great experience! We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Venecia H.

reviews.text: Dined here this evening for the first time and absolutely loved it. Food was fabulous and service was excellent. Our server Shereese & Emmy were very knowledgeable and made our experience that much better. Brody was also kind enough to share his recommendations and even offered to take photos of our whole table! There's just nothing better than great service when enjoying a meal!
reviews.author: Avery C.

reviews.text: Want sure what to expect after reading reviews on here but WOW, we were wow'ed!! Delish food, great service, amazing atmosphere, tasty manhattan drinks (not pictured) & a very thoughtful cookie/gelato birthday treat comped! If you aren't a big lemon fan ( I'm not ) just ask which items don't have lemon flavor and you'll be wow'ed too! We will be back, bravo!!
reviews.author: Whitney L.

reviews.text: Food and service was excellent. My wife raved about the risotto. We came to celebrate our anniversary. No disappointments here. A special shout out to Brody. He spent time talking with us. He was very personable, friendly and made our day even more special.
reviews.author: Frank K.

reviews.text: 4 couples. Everyone hated their dish. Pizza was a few dough balls. Agnolotti was lemon soup pasta.  Server said he ran an errand during our meal. Seated in awkward ball room. Run don't walk from this place.
reviews.author: Daniel D.

reviews.text: What a wonderful evening!! The food was magnificent and being that I was just in Italy I felt like I had returned there. The lemon spaghetti was off the charts. Tony and Melanie were our servers. They were both a complete delight. The most wonderful thing was how excited and inspired they were about the food and being of service to us. I loved hearing how the lighting in this magical restaurant was designed as the stars were aligned at the birth of Giada's  only daughter. I am so looking forward to another special meal at Luna. I have already recommended it to everyone I see. Thank you, Nina Heller
reviews.author: Nina H.

reviews.text: Delicious food in a beautiful space.  Their housemade focaccia was incredible.  Pasta was delicious as well as our salad with pancetta.  Looking forward to going again soon.
reviews.author: Marlo B.

reviews.text:
Where do I begin. Tonight my husband and I celebrated our 25 wedding anniversary dinner. I am still in awe with the dining experience. 
We sampled some of Giada's signature dishes. The Lemon Pizza. OMG!!! 
The Lemon pasta with Shrimp. All The flavors exploded in my mouth. Dessert we chose the Ameretti cake with the orange flavoring.

The best part of the evening was Brandi our server and Cody her helper were fantastic.

I felt like I had known these 2 people for along time. They are both very kind. 
Brandi is on top of her game. Very well versed on preparations and ingredients. 
Great recommendations and suggestions. 
Cody was eager to please for being a new kid on the block. 
We will definitely go back for date night.

The only thing that was a tad disappointing was that our Milestone Anniversary was never mentioned. 

I had put in special requests on Open Table. 
complimentary cookies would of been a nice touch. 
Just sayin.

Dawn and Mark 
Scottsdale
reviews.author: Dawn P.

reviews.text: One of the best dining experiences we have ever had.   The staff was amazing.  Every single staff member starting with hostesses to waitress to bus boy was professional, warm and friendly, - right up to the end when walking out and the Manager asked us how the experience was.   Dani was our waitress and Brody was our bus boy and both were exceptional.   The appetizers, main course - Lobster Brucatini - and desert were amazing.   Just an amazing evening from start to end.   Exceptional staff, food, and atmosphere!   Highest recommendation, and we will be back!!
reviews.author: Glen C.

reviews.text: The food and service were to die for! Highly recommend the focaccia and their lemon spaghetti is amazing! Ask for Gilbert he provided amazing service and I will definitely be back again!
reviews.author: Kelsey Z.

reviews.text: Paul and Gilbert were absolutely amazing. The service was incredible. The focaccia bread and the Lemon pasta were so delicious.
reviews.author: Illyssa G.

reviews.text: Food was okay, definitely not what I imagined from Giada. Although, our server was AMAZING Gilbert was so sweet and recommended the best drink, Mornings in Venice. I would high recommend if you come that you ask for Gilbert as your server. He was the best. Jose Luis was also very attentive to our needs, we never felt the need for anything as those two had it covered.
reviews.author: Lauren N.

reviews.text: Came back to celebrate a friends birthday. Ordered the crab arancini and the lemon pizza again and they were to die for! It's my favorite pizza in PHX! Had to try the Lemon Spaghetti signature and oh my god delicious. It's cheesy and lemony and has plenty of capers - which describes my perfect pasta! Others at the table also ordered the sausage pizza and the caprese salad. We left with absolutely no crumbs on our plate. We also had an amazing server Gilbert which made our experience so fun!
reviews.author: Dylan O.

reviews.text:
I don't know how this restaurant isn't rated 5 stars! The ambience was amazing, the hotel is fabulous. Our server, Gilbert, was so attentive, charming, and helpful! We were here for a girls dinner for a birthday, and he had us laughing all dinner. The food though.... DIVINE!!!!!! The hint of lemon in the crab appetizer was a perfect touch. The lemon pizza is a MUST. You can't get that anywhere else!! So unique and different. But the cherry on top was the lemon spaghetti. The presentation was insane but the taste was unreal! Another super amazing dish, recommended by Gilbert. 

You must try Luna if you are staying at Cesar's Republic, or in the area.
reviews.author: Keeley C.

reviews.text:
Holy service and amazing food! I can't say enough about this place! It is glitz and glamour- all the pretty people were there! This restaurant is on the lower bottom level of the Ceasers Scottsdale & the whole place is a show stopper!! 
I enjoyed the salmon, so savory and YUM! We all walked away happy, full and with a doggy box!
reviews.author: Tanya B.

reviews.text:
Restaurant service was good, bar service in the lobby was not great. Risotto with scallops were ok, although two small scallops were a little meager for the cost. I heard the flatbread was subpar from our friend and the branzino was just decent with not a ton of flavor. 

The bacon wrapped figs were delicious and by far the best part of the meal. Their version (forgot the name) of the espresso martini was really good. 

One thing to watch out for is the added "venue fee" of 3.5%. When I drop $700 on a meal for four people, it feels like a greedy move to gouge you for more. We brought it up to the manager and he removed it as they couldn't really explain why they're charging it. 

The restaurant itself is a well designed and beautiful setting with good lighting. I didn't find the acoustics to be as troublesome as some reviewers have noted. The 7 Bar upstairs was interesting as well and true to Scottsdale if you're into that kind of experience.
reviews.author: Kyle M.

reviews.text: I visited for a second time last night and was delighted with the entire experience.  My waitress, Deva, took great care of helping me with the menu and choosing a cocktail and wine.  The food and the ambiance are very much on-point:  beautiful.
reviews.author: Jonathan D.

reviews.text: You're going for the name.. I was excited to try this new Italian restaurant but was soon left feeling meh. The ambiance of the restaurant is cute. For it being in the Mecca of Scottsdale I was surprised that the waitstaff wore jeans and sneakers. So really no need to dress up for this casual location. We ordered the facacia which came with lemon butter, pesto oil and a weird tasting oil & balsamic. I ordered the Pasta alla Vodka which was pretty flavorless. My husband ordered the risotto and scallops which he enjoyed. By the way, pretty much everything has lemon in it. For dessert I ordered the lemon soufflé which came out tasting like scrambled eggs so a huge miss!! My husband ordered the cheesecake with brownie which was a 3 out of 5. At one point I saw a friend a couple of feet away from me and went greet her. A random waiter picked up my purse and was getting ready to walk away with it. My phone and husbands phones were still on the table so that really rubbed me the wrong way. Lastly, we got our bill. Looking at it I noticed they snuck in a "3.5% Venue Admin Fee" which not one person told us about so that made it super shady! If you want to go to say you've eaten there then that's what you should do but for the overall experience and taste I'd say not a fan.
reviews.author: Krista H.

reviews.text: Me and my girlfriends went to Luna for a girls night out and we were immediately welcomed by BRODY! The food was amazing but Brody was the best. He was our busser but should've been our server! He always checked in on us and gave us good laughs. If you go to Luna request to be sat in Brodys section and get the bread.
reviews.author: Hannah S.

reviews.text: Had the most amazing evening at Luna. Rae was our server and she was just delightful and incredibly tuned into the menu! Go to Luna and ask for Rae!
reviews.author: Michael S.

reviews.text: Good news, the Bar was really nice!  Great bartenders and a really nice ambiance.  However, the main dinning room was very average.  The service was spotty.  Not one manager stopped by to see how me and my date were doing.  The Lemon Spaghetti was average and the Branzino was dry and over-cooked. Dessert was the best part of the meal - the sorbet and brownie cheesecake were very good.   For a $400 check - not even close to worth it.  Giada, I expected so much more from your brand.
reviews.author: Adam L.

reviews.text: I absolutely loved our experience last night. The managers were so nice and the waiter really did an awesome job. The food was very good and unique. The steak was exceptional and very well seasoned. The corn and sausage is one of my favorite sides in Scottsdale. Great job guys keep up the good work!
reviews.author: J Y.

reviews.text:
Beware of strange fees!  $55 for a half size pour glass of champagne. Credit card usage fee of 3.5%. Had to wait 30 minutes past reservation time for table. The food was good but very overpriced!  Casual decor. Slow service then brought salads before appetizer. Had to ask and wait for pepper and water. Will not go again.

Warning #2 Check credit card receipt against credit card statement.  Server doubled the tip I left!  Spoke with manager who said would investigate and call back but never did!  

Poor service, poorly run, shady extra charges, thieving staff!
reviews.author: Nancy R.

reviews.text:
My husband and I had a spontaneous date night on a recent Saturday and decided to go meet another couple for dinner / drinks at Luna by Giada...

I'd been in once before for a hard hat tour before the restaurant opened, so I was prepared for the beautiful ambiance, chic decor, fun vibe, etc... but seeing it in action proved even better than I expected.  The service was attentive and friendly (thanks to our waiter, Paul, and many staff members who refilled our drinks, stopped by to check on how we were enjoying the food, etc... )

I enjoyed one of their speciality cocktails, a Caesar Salad with Shrimp, a taste of steak, and some shared sides of broccolini and asparagus. We skipped dessert and headed up to the 7th floor bar for an after dinner drink and people watching... it was quite entertaining!

I cannot speak to the bill as our friends picked up the tab, but I'm sure it was extremely pricey.  All in all, this place is worth a visit. I'm sure it will continue to attract a high end business crowd in addition to locals looking for a quality meal.
reviews.author: Gabi M.

reviews.text:
A few bright spots outshined by the negatives. We went to Luna for the first time on Saturday with a group of 5 people and were expecting a much better experience given that the restaurant is so new and carries a big name with Chef Giada. 

First off, the drinks and a couple of the apps that we had were excellent. The Crab Arancini and bacon wrapped dates were very addicting and could've eaten those for my meal to be honest. Those were the bright spots..now for the negatives. 

1.) Far too expensive! 48 bucks on average for pasta. My wife had the risotto with scallops and they were incredibly bland, zero taste. I had the Marini Alla Vodka with chicken and I could've made it better at our house. Again, not much flavor, far too expensive for below average pasta dishes. On average, including food, drinks, tips, we spent 300 dollars per couple. 

2.)My buddy ordered the petit filet medium rare and the steak came out well done. They were accommodating and nice about it but that is a very rookie mistake to overcook a steak that much. 

3.) We were sat in a booth and it was very rickety, almost like it wasn't put together properly. If you had to shimmy out to go to the bathroom it felt like the booth was going to collapse. 

4.) No music in the dining room? Zero ambiance. It felt like we were eating in a lunch room cafeteria. 

5.) The kitchen is fully in view and the management decided that a group of guests could go back in the kitchen and take pictures with the staff/pizza oven. I'm sorry, but when your bill is 800 dollars for dinner it is very unappealing to see a group of Scottsdale girls go take selfies where your food is being prepared. 

6.) the lights in the dining room kept turning on and off, full brightness then incredibly dim. There's obvious kinks they need to work out. 

Overall, we will not be coming back here for dinner. Maybe for drinks/apps then going elsewhere. If you are looking for true Italian cooking at a reasonable price there are many other great options in the area. Not worth the hype!!
reviews.author: Kevin A.

reviews.text: This place was gorgeous and has the best atmosphere. Tony was an amazing server and helped with all of our choices be each one was delicious. To start the foccacia was light, airy with the right amount of crispy.  We could have eaten 2 of these but wanted to experience desert.  The Lemon pasta was so creamy and has a light lemon flavor and the crispy capers were a splendid touch!  The pizza and red pasta dish were also top notch and will be ordered again when we come back. To finish we tried the signature soufflé was very light and airy and has a slight lemon taste which was pairs with a blueberry sauce which was heaven.  We will be back and we will for sure ask for Tony he is very knowledgeable and is very attentive.  Thank you for a great Mother's Day experience!!
reviews.author: Amy H.

reviews.text: Where to even began, from the very start we were greeted with the friendliest maitre d' and got seated at what I thought was best seat in house, right next to the kitchen. It's a glass wall so you can see the phenomenal chef's and kitchen staff in action. It is a work of art they way they are operating, it was a joy to watch. Our waiter; Tony was incredible. He was beyond friendly and truly cared about us and delivered an extrodinary experience. He was on it and made us feel like the only people in the restaurant. During our time multiple staff members checked on us and made sure we were good and having a good time. It's refreshing to see how friendly everyone was. Last but not least, the food! It was truly a culinary experience that did not disappoint! Each item you can tell was made with love, as cliche as that sounds you can really tell as the food was simply amazing!  We got the SICILIAN FOCACCIA, BISTECCA ALLA FIORENTINA FOR TWO, PAN SEARED SALMON, ROASTED BROCCOLINI and LEMON SMASHED POTATOES. Again, everything is incredible! You MUST end the night with the Limoncello soufflé it was mind blowing. Thank you for making this experience one we will never forget. I am so thankful we got to celebrate my mom at Luna!
reviews.author: Patrick G.

reviews.text: I have been to Gilda's restaurant at the Cromwell and this is every bit as good if not better than that stellar restaurant. The branzino was to die for and Suzannah was everything I could ask for in a server. Luna is lucky to have her.  Luna is a keeper in my list of go-to restaurants.
reviews.author: Eric M.

reviews.text: Went to Luna and had an amazing experience. The  atmosphere is inviting, our server Suzannah was incredible and the food was delicious. Suzannah took great care of us, she knew the menu inside and out and made the perfect suggestions. I always ask for server recommendations at a new place, because they know their favorites and the most ordered dishes. Suzannah did not disappoint, her recommendations were on point, she was also very attentive and there's a nice selection of wines. I can't wait to come back and try additional items and some specialty cocktails. Thank you Ceasar's Republic & Giada.
reviews.author: Kelly S.

reviews.text: Excellent Italian experience, our waiter (Gilbert) was amazing and so knowledgeable about the menu.  The design was perfect and the ambiance was perfect.  Do not leave without trying g the focccia bread and lemon butter as well as the lemon cookies.  All entries seemed well presented.
reviews.author: Matt H.

reviews.text: Loved this place, our server was Gilbert!! He was so nice, inviting, and such an amazing guy. Best server I've ever had. Food was excellent, came out fast and hot. Must try the lemon ricotta cookies they are so Devine. Another shout out to our server Gilbert he was amazing
reviews.author: Kerstyn H.

reviews.text: We had dinner at Luna this evening and the only thing great about this restaurant, in my opinion, was the General Manager. He asked how we liked our food and wanted to hear our opinions. We were honest and let him know that we didn't love the food. The GM listened to everything we had to say and we very much appreciated his care and concern. We ordered four different pasta dishes. I thought the pasta was very pricey.  We loved our cocktail and the Focaccia Bread but the salads were mediocre. Our service was excellent. I probably won't make a point to go back any time soon but kudos to the GM for sharing his time with us. He's a keeper!
reviews.author: Judy P.

reviews.text: I wanted to love this place but it's way overpriced and nothing to talk about. Wine was good but again way overpriced!
reviews.author: Bal D.

reviews.text: We sat at the bar last night and Jeff was our bartender/server.  I think he maybe had just started but you would never know that he hadn't been working there since it opened.  He was super helpful and accommodating.  He even made me a custom drink because I was unsure of what I wanted.  We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Stacie R.

reviews.text: Luna is fine dining high-end Italian. You're going to get service from the hostess to the server. Make sure to have a reservation. I highly recommend the lemon pizza and the lemon spaghetti. Both were delicious, especially the pizza. It was unique in flavor. In my opinion, it was a better pizza than Pizzaria Bianco. Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience.
reviews.author: david l.

reviews.text: Food was delicious but definitely over priced! Service was slow. We had a reservation at 6:00 and waited almost 45 mins to be seated.
reviews.author: Gina S.

reviews.text:
The hotel was less than impressive walking in the front doors.  We had a 7:15pm dinner reservation but we came early to check out the rooftop bar on the 7th floor.  When we arrived off the elevator, we seated ourselves at a small table.  There were several cocktail waitresses scurrying about but none of them came over to take our drink order.  In regard to the waitresses, I must comment on their "R" rated outfits.  The shorts they wore were so skimpy that their butt cheeks were partially hanging out.  We finally waved at the bartender and he came over to our table and took our order. The drinks were fine, generous portions, and well made.  My wife asked for a cocktail napkin which should have come initially with the drinks.  The bartender promptly came back with one napkin for her but none for me.  The view from the 7th floor was quite nice if you walked out and stood at the glass safety barrier.  However, the glass barrier had a wide horizontal metal strip running down the middle of it which blocked the view if your were sitting down at a table.   A very poor design compromising what could have been a nice feature for the rooftop bar.  

At 7:10pm we went back downstairs to be seated in the LUNA Restaurant on the first floor.  There are two greeters behind a desk at the entrance that took a very long time to acknowledge our presence.   Once they did, we were told our table was not available and there would be a 10-15 minute wait. We waited 15 minutes and then were finally seated.  The restaurant was very busy and the crowd noise in the room was deafening.  It was hard for us to have a discussion at our table.  Why can't architects design dining spaces which incorporate some noise muting properties??

For such a renown chef (Giada DeLaurentis) the LUNA menu was rather mundane. I had grilled salmon and my husband ordered the scallops served on risotto.  He said his dish was tasty but it came with only two scallops.  The salmon was a large portion and it was served with a mixture of beans that were not included in the description on the menu.  We also ordered a side dish of asparagus ($17 for 4 asparagus !) that was served to us very undercooked, almost raw.  We sent it back to the kitchen and had it taken off our bill.  

Bottom line, we were very underwhelmed at both the hotel and the LUNA restaurant.
reviews.author: Cheryl K.

reviews.text:
Warning. This is a long one. lol. 

Growing up I learned how to cook from watching Giada on tv.  We loved her restaurants in Vegas so when they announced a few years back they were opening a restaurant in Scottsdale I was so excited! 
Because of covid it took longer than anticipated but I made reservations for our wedding anniversary as soon as they opened on open table.  
When we were sat the first thing we noticed was the extremely loud music and a weird smell.  Really put my finger on it but being Asian and knowing the smell, it smelt like fish sauce! lol just funky and didn't fit the restaurant. So I thought my nose was playing tricks on me. The music made it hard to talk and hear my
Husband that sat in front of me and we were at a small two seater table.  
Our waitress was a nice gal but she was so quiet we didn't hear anything she said. 
We ordered the fritto Misto, pizza, lemon spaghetti, and dessert. Our waitress mentioned that the portions were small so we might want to order more, but we said we would order more if we were still hungry later.  
While we waited for what seemed like extra long, I people watched. I noticed a lot of people sending their pizza back. Some not even touched.  Table behind us ordered a seafood tower. Again my nose was smelling something bad.  I am a huge seafood lover. So I feel like I know the difference between fresh and rotten. But this seafood smelled rancid. I even told my husband I wanted to turn around and tell the woman, please don't eat that. Sure enough she took a bite. Spit it out and they had the server return it immediately.  
Our fritto misto was okay. The calamari was super rubbery. And the aioli was just straight mayo with no flavor.  
Later our pizza came out. Strike two.  It was burnt.  I was told that's how wood fired pizza is.  I know what wood fired pizza is. And I don't like it charred to the point literally all I tasted was burn. My next assumption was they don't clean the pizza oven in between orders because it was just super bitter.  
Last, even though we ordered them as entrees they came out after each other. Was the famous lemon spaghetti.  I was so excited for this one. 
Wow. Another final disappointment.  The lemon was extremely bitter and that's all you tasted.  The two shrimp you get was on its last life because part of the shrimp was good but other parts tasted like it was going bad.  
Finally, our two hour meal ended with a chocolate dessert. Now that was delicious.  Not super sweet.  
All I kept thinking was Giada would have been so disappointed with what was put out that night. I am still a fan of her. Just disappointed. Maybe I just had too high expectations.
reviews.author: Elaine B.

reviews.text: Had a wonderful evening at Luna!  Food was fantastic. We had the Arancini, Fritto Misto, Lemon Spaghetti and Cheesecake for dessert!  Tony took amazing care of us!
reviews.author: Marcia W.

reviews.text:
We paid 370.00 for our dinner and it was terrible. 
We could have fed 5 people with the leftovers. 
I could have made better pasta from my one sur La tab cooking classes. 

Had the res booked 5 weeks out - yes the place is pretty - but it ain't that pretty. 

I eat lemons with salt - just straight up salt and sometimes lime salt - I put lemons in my sun flower seeds - I make lemon bars - I make lemonade. 

But this place - make pizza that taste like lemons - rice balls that taste like lemons - pasta that taste like lemons. Everything is just a giant lemon. I mean I ordered all the lemon dish but your whole identity is a lemon? It's not an accompanying flavor but the whole flavor. 

Nothing was good or exciting about this the ambiance is the bottom floor of a huge hotel with the same ol photos we've seen from wal mart about some Italian movie. We ate dessert some other place because we didn't want to spend any more money.
reviews.author: Kiki L.

reviews.text: Fantastic dining experience. Excellent food with service that went above and beyond thanks to head server Rae, who offered spot-on recommendations and dish descriptions. Beautiful dining environment and 10/10 highly recommend. Best Branzino and lemon pasta in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Allen J.

reviews.text:
My wife and I enjoyed a wonderful dinner with friends while visiting Scottsdale.  Making reservations was easy and when we arrived we politely directed to the bar by the hostess, Grace, who checked in on us to update us on the wait for our table.  We were seated at a table with a waiter named Kenneth who was not only friendly but extremely knowledgeable about the menu.  We had a lot of questions and he was very patient with us.  His suggestions were on par.

My friend and I were having trouble deciding on a bottle of wine as we all kept changing our minds about what we wanted to order.  Kenneth brought over the wine manager, Preston, who gave us some good suggestions.  

We ended up ordering the lemon spaghetti, crab arancini, bacon wrapped dates, pork chop saltimbocca (suggested by Kenneth) and the agnolotti and we all shared with tasty Pinot.  The food was delicious, the ambiance of the restaurant delightful and the staff we interacted with were warm and professional.  We'll eat here again on our next visit to Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Bryan S.

reviews.text:
Birthday dinner - a week ago I attempted to make a reservation and the app said they were booked from 6:30-8:45. We arrived around 7:45 and many restaurant tables were empty. WTH 
We like eating at the bar - also with many available seats,  The wait staff were terrific. The food was fantastic. I would give it a 5 except I don't trust the reservation system and wonder how many other places do this and miss out on real people who want to enjoy a new dining experience. 
Have the lemon pasta and if you're feeling fancy switch it up with lobster!  Also the $14 focaccia is worth the calories.
reviews.author: Mary C.

reviews.text:
I went there today with 2 of my friends and the service was great. We sat at the bar and I immediately noticed one of the bartenders who used to work at the Village Tavern. He was absolutely horrible there. The first ever time I only gave a $1.00 tip to anyone., He had ignored me the whole time I was in the tavern, and when I finally asked him to please bring my bill, he gave bills to others, but instead of giving one to me, he walked away somewhere. Totally ignored me, and I never had that experience there as I have gone there regularly. Very odd. After waiting for several minutes another waiter walked by and was kind enough to run my bill. First time I ever gave anyone $1.00 tip which I explained on the bill. Thankfully he had nothing to do with us tonight but I would really recommend you watch his super cocky disrespectful attitude. It took me awhile to go back to Village Tavern because of my horrible experience with him.
Anita
reviews.author: Anita C.

reviews.text: My husband and I were looking forward to dinner here for our anniversary. The service was great unfortunately the food was awful. There are so many other places to go that have amazing food and experience if we are spending $200+ for dinner. We won't be back. Also, ditch the 3.5% BS venue fee, whatever the heck that is.
reviews.author: Chaz V.

reviews.text: I live a couple blocks from the new restaurant so I decided to check out the celebrity chefs place. From watching Giada on TV she seems like a very nice person. Unfortunately her restaurant is lousy.  I had the fritto as an appetizer which was suggested by my waitress and the signature lemon pasta. The fritto was completely tasteless. It just tasted like over fried dough. The lemon pasta wasnt much better. It came with 2 pieces of shrimp that were fine but the pasta was a disaster. Horrible taste. Oh, and the prices are crazy. All in all, just about the worst meal I have ever had.
reviews.author: Charles M.

reviews.text: Was invited to the grand opening and it was a great experience. The lemon pasta with shrimp was extremely light yet flavorful. The staff was very friendly and overall their first day was a hit.
reviews.author: Kenneth T.

reviews.text:
FIRST: I *drove* here from Modesto on my way to St. Louis for Boo's baby's GRADUATION.

SECOND: I was treated with PRESTIGE and GRACE at Luna.  I felt like THE Queen of Italy, which was very calming after 2024 in "America". THANK YOU, "Miss Kim" I was told.  It made the expensive GASOLINE worth it.  Cheaper in AZ?

THIRD EXHIBIT: 

Part I: FOOD A++++. The "person" (BOT!) claiming the food was small and the price too much should learn GRACE and some manners, frankly.  I had leftovers for DAYS!  Very high quality focaccia!  OOOOOH!

Part II: AMBIANCE.  Yes, PLEASE.  Very nice.  I enjoyed my SEAT in the "back" where it was SERENE.  I was not interrupted once by the drunk women visiting from IOWA.  The bathroom was SAFE!

Yes, I recommend LUNA any time of the DAY or NIGHT even though Luna means Lunar which means MOON.

Bye!
